07loa1knthf.text: The lifts in Menara Sinar go from 13 to 15. Last night a man came down past all of them.
07loa1knthf.en: The lifts in Menara Sinar go from 13 to 15. Last night a man came down past all of them.

dir.say: [low, ominous] The lifts in Menara Sinar go from thirteen to fifteen. [long-break] [cold, quiet] Last night a man came down past all of them.
[low, fierce, possessive] Yang ini, [break] aku punya.

1ib57wuzdn7.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1ib57wuzdn7.text: Dato' Rashid Osman. Group Finance Director, Sinar Holdings. He lay on that pavement through the whole storm before anybody called it in. His fist was closed. This was in it.
1ib57wuzdn7.en: Dato' Rashid Osman. Group Finance Director, Sinar Holdings. He lay on that pavement through the whole storm before anybody called it in. His fist was closed. This was in it.

dir.say: [clipped, professional, tired] Dato' Rashid Osman. Group Finance Director, Sinar Holdings. [break] [angry, controlled] He lay on that pavement through the whole storm before anybody called it in. [break] [quieter] His fist was closed. [break] This was in it.

1gxkfk7qfo6.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1gxkfk7qfo6.text: You know whose this is. Do not tell me. Not yet.
1gxkfk7qfo6.en: You know whose this is. Do not tell me. Not yet.

dir.say: [low, urgent, almost pleading] You know whose this is. [break] Do not tell me. [break] [softer] Not yet.

2dz0vzlnob3.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2dz0vzlnob3.text: Colombo put out a red notice for a K. Rajan, on your word. Immigration says he landed at KLIA nine days ago. My superintendent read it before I did.
2dz0vzlnob3.en: Colombo put out a red notice for a K. Rajan, on your word. Immigration says he landed at KLIA nine days ago. My superintendent read it before I did.

dir.say: [dry, pointed] Colombo put out a red notice for a K. Rajan, on your word. Immigration says he landed at K L I A nine days ago. [break] [bitter, low] My superintendent read it before I did.

0gdj72cq286.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0gdj72cq286.text: Herath sent me the last page of a gem cutter's book. Every valuation for the Office of the Chairman. That page is the only reason I am allowed to stand on this pavement.
0gdj72cq286.en: Herath sent me the last page of a gem cutter's book. Every valuation for the Office of the Chairman. That page is the only reason I am allowed to stand on this pavement.

dir.say: [measured, grim] Herath sent me the last page of a gem cutter's book. Every valuation for the Office of the Chairman. [break] [low, firm] That page is the only reason I am allowed to stand on this pavement.

20daoledmxx.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
20daoledmxx.text: Herath says the gem cutter's book was collected from Fort station by a man with a sun on his shirt. So I have nothing that gets me past that lobby. Except you.
20daoledmxx.en: Herath says the gem cutter's book was collected from Fort station by a man with a sun on his shirt. So I have nothing that gets me past that lobby. Except you.

dir.say: [flat, frustrated] Herath says the gem cutter's book was collected from Fort station by a man with a sun on his shirt. [break] So I have nothing that gets me past that lobby. [long-break] [dry, reluctant] Except you.

069zujougj5.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
069zujougj5.text: And Westport says a Sri Lankan reefer technician walked off a Sinar Cold Chain feeder on Friday night and never walked back on. Scratches on both arms.
069zujougj5.en: And Westport says a Sri Lankan reefer technician walked off a Sinar Cold Chain feeder on Friday night and never walked back on. Scratches on both arms.

dir.say: [businesslike, uneasy] And Westport says a Sri Lankan reefer technician walked off a Sinar Cold Chain feeder on Friday night and never walked back on. [break] [cold] Scratches on both arms.

121i45dt8ms.speaker: Narrator
121i45dt8ms.text: Menara Sinar is thirty-eight storeys of green glass on Jalan Ampang, four hundred metres from the twin towers, with a brass sun on its crown that catches the morning before anything else on the street.
121i45dt8ms.en: Menara Sinar is thirty-eight storeys of green glass on Jalan Ampang, four hundred metres from the twin towers, with a brass sun on its crown that catches the morning before anything else on the street.

22x7o8r1bs5.speaker: Narrator
22x7o8r1bs5.text: Count the floors from the pavement and you run out of numbers. A third of the way up there is one storey of black glass with no light behind it. Above it, Level 15. Below it, Level 13.
22x7o8r1bs5.en: Count the floors from the pavement and you run out of numbers. A third of the way up there is one storey of black glass with no light behind it. Above it, Level 15. Below it, Level 13.

dir.say: [slow, observant] Count the floors from the pavement and you run out of numbers. [break] A third of the way up there is one storey of black glass with no light behind it. [break] Above it, Level fifteen. [break] Below it, Level thirteen.

23e8fj7my1m.speaker: Narrator
23e8fj7my1m.text: He landed under the black glass.
23e8fj7my1m.en: He landed under the black glass.

dir.say: [long-break][quiet, grave] He landed under the black glass.

0lbbm3iaw8t.speaker: Narrator
0lbbm3iaw8t.text: At the tape, a young woman with a press lanyard that nobody will let her use. Nurul Ain. His daughter.
0lbbm3iaw8t.en: At the tape, a young woman with a press lanyard that nobody will let her use. Nurul Ain. His daughter.

dir.say: [gentle, sober] At the tape, a young woman with a press lanyard that nobody will let her use. [break] Nurul Ain. [break] [soft] His daughter.

16zb18lq0rr.speaker: Nurul Ain
16zb18lq0rr.text: Everybody keeps telling me he jumped. Maybe he did. He stopped sleeping in September. He said he had signed things he could not unsign.
16zb18lq0rr.en: Everybody keeps telling me he jumped. Maybe he did. He stopped sleeping in September. He said he had signed things he could not unsign.

dir.say: [numb, brittle, holding it together] Everybody keeps telling me he jumped. [break] Maybe he did. [break] He stopped sleeping in September. [voice catching] He said he had signed things he could not unsign.

0owxnz8253e.speaker: Nurul Ain
0owxnz8253e.text: At 11:43 he sent me two words.
0owxnz8253e.en: At 11:43 he sent me two words.

dir.say: [quiet, shaking] At eleven forty-three he sent me two words.
[long-break][barely holding back tears, whispering] Maafkan Abah.

13gtsmkdy4g.speaker: Nurul Ain
13gtsmkdy4g.text: And last week he said a strange thing. If a man who folds paper animals ever comes to you, Ain, help him.
13gtsmkdy4g.en: And last week he said a strange thing. If a man who folds paper animals ever comes to you, Ain, help him.

dir.say: [sniffing, puzzled, searching your face] And last week he said a strange thing. [break] [softer, quoting her father] If a man who folds paper animals ever comes to you, Ain, help him.
[brusque, dismissive, loud] Tekanan kerja. [break] Dia terjun.

1d87031v768.speaker: Supt. Khairul Anuar
1d87031v768.text: By Wednesday this file is closed, Farah. And your friend from Brickfields is not police.
1d87031v768.en: By Wednesday this file is closed, Farah. And your friend from Brickfields is not police.

dir.say: [condescending, warning] By Wednesday this file is closed, Farah. [break] [cold, contemptuous] And your friend from Brickfields is not police.

1wij22p4ixh.speaker: Narrator
1wij22p4ixh.text: When he has gone, Farah says one word, Wednesday, the way you say the name of a river you have to cross.
1wij22p4ixh.en: When he has gone, Farah says one word, Wednesday, the way you say the name of a river you have to cross.

1zchgvi0xje.speaker: Narrator
1zchgvi0xje.text: The lobby is black marble with a brass sun set in the floor, so that everybody who comes in has to walk across it.
1zchgvi0xje.en: The lobby is black marble with a brass sun set in the floor, so that everybody who comes in has to walk across it.

0vv8ydpfgxy.speaker: Zulkifli Hamid
0vv8ydpfgxy.text: Welcome to Menara Sinar. Anything you need, you ask me first. Inspector. Long time.
0vv8ydpfgxy.en: Welcome to Menara Sinar. Anything you need, you ask me first. Inspector. Long time.

dir.say: [smooth, polite, quietly controlling] Welcome to Menara Sinar. Anything you need, you ask me first. [break] [warmer, knowing] Inspector. [break] Long time.

0o5r4w2ciy5.speaker: Narrator
0o5r4w2ciy5.text: Behind him an old man in grey overalls has a lift panel open. 12, 13, 15. He catches you counting.
0o5r4w2ciy5.en: Behind him an old man in grey overalls has a lift panel open. 12, 13, 15. He catches you counting.

dir.say: [low, wry] Behind him an old man in grey overalls has a lift panel open. [break] Twelve, thirteen, fifteen. [break] He catches you counting.

0f0il7yv0bh.speaker: Uncle Wong
0f0il7yv0bh.text: Sap sei lau? Mou sap sei lau gaa.

dir.say: [old man, gruff, amused] 十四樓？[break] 冇十四樓㗎。
[low, superstitious, serious] 十四。[break] 實死。

22nez3tem8x.speaker: Narrator
22nez3tem8x.text: Dang Wangi amends its file on the morning of the third night's tahlil. Not a fall. Pushed, from the fourteenth floor of a building with no fourteenth floor.
22nez3tem8x.en: Dang Wangi amends its file on the morning of the third night's tahlil. Not a fall. Pushed, from the fourteenth floor of a building with no fourteenth floor.

dir.say: [measured, sober] Dang Wangi amends its file on the morning of the third night's tahlil. [break] Not a fall. [quiet, grave] Pushed, from the fourteenth floor of a building with no fourteenth floor.

2b0xj7u9oxu.speaker: Nurul Ain
2b0xj7u9oxu.text: They say it is finished. My editor says it is finished. Everybody is very sure about everything except what happened.
2b0xj7u9oxu.en: They say it is finished. My editor says it is finished. Everybody is very sure about everything except what happened.

dir.say: [hollow, bitter] They say it is finished. My editor says it is finished. [break] [quiet, weary] Everybody is very sure about everything except what happened.

0d1q031mkmw.speaker: Narrator
0d1q031mkmw.text: Vivian Chua flies to Singapore on Thursday morning on a Sinar jet. At Seletar a woman in a grey dress is waiting for her on the tarmac. Sinar Holdings thanks its Company Secretary for twenty-seven years of service.
0d1q031mkmw.en: Vivian Chua flies to Singapore on Thursday morning on a Sinar jet. At Seletar a woman in a grey dress is waiting for her on the tarmac. Sinar Holdings thanks its Company Secretary for twenty-seven years of service.

2brqif9djq6.speaker: Narrator
2brqif9djq6.text: Vivian Chua flies to Singapore on Thursday morning on a Sinar jet. Sinar Holdings thanks its Company Secretary for twenty-seven years of service.
2brqif9djq6.en: Vivian Chua flies to Singapore on Thursday morning on a Sinar jet. Sinar Holdings thanks its Company Secretary for twenty-seven years of service.

dir.say: [dry, sardonic] Vivian Chua flies to Singapore on Thursday morning on a Sinar jet. [break] [flat, bitter] Sinar Holdings thanks its Company Secretary for twenty-seven years of service.

0n36s4xj54w.speaker: Narrator
0n36s4xj54w.text: By Friday the Office of the Chairman has a new secretary. Her name is at the bottom of the letter Sinar's lawyers send to Bukit Aman: Melissa Ong.
0n36s4xj54w.en: By Friday the Office of the Chairman has a new secretary. Her name is at the bottom of the letter Sinar's lawyers send to Bukit Aman: Melissa Ong.

dir.say: [low, ominous] By Friday the Office of the Chairman has a new secretary. Her name is at the bottom of the letter Sinar's lawyers send to Bukit Aman: [break] [emphasis] Melissa Ong.

1ocvxin7etj.speaker: Narrator
1ocvxin7etj.text: Zulkifli Hamid is made Head of Security at Sinar Cold Chain, Westport. He leaves Menara Sinar on Wednesday with a cake from the night guards.
1ocvxin7etj.en: Zulkifli Hamid is made Head of Security at Sinar Cold Chain, Westport. He leaves Menara Sinar on Wednesday with a cake from the night guards.

dir.say: [flat, bitter] Zulkifli Hamid is made Head of Security at Sinar Cold Chain, Westport. [break] [dry, sour] He leaves Menara Sinar on Wednesday with a cake from the night guards.

2e5f11uqxr3.speaker: Narrator
2e5f11uqxr3.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is suspended. The murder charge is dropped on Friday. The envelope is not. On Monday somebody at Bukit Aman starts returning Farah's calls.
2e5f11uqxr3.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is suspended. The murder charge is dropped on Friday. The envelope is not. On Monday somebody at Bukit Aman starts returning Farah's calls.

dir.say: [measured, dry] Superintendent Khairul Anuar is suspended. The murder charge is dropped on Friday. [break] The envelope is not. [break] [faintly hopeful] On Monday somebody at Bukit Aman starts returning Farah's calls.

2fuv6q0tssx.speaker: Narrator
2fuv6q0tssx.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar gives the press conference himself, thanks his officers, and does not look at Farah once.
2fuv6q0tssx.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar gives the press conference himself, thanks his officers, and does not look at Farah once.

14typxmppw2.speaker: Narrator
14typxmppw2.text: Bomba seals the fourteenth floor for fire-safety breaches. It is the only charge in Kuala Lumpur that Sinar's lawyers cannot argue away by lunch.
14typxmppw2.en: Bomba seals the fourteenth floor for fire-safety breaches. It is the only charge in Kuala Lumpur that Sinar's lawyers cannot argue away by lunch.

dir.say: [measured, faintly wry] Bomba seals the fourteenth floor for fire-safety breaches. [break] [dry] It is the only charge in Kuala Lumpur that Sinar's lawyers cannot argue away by lunch.

1nmero4zpi3.speaker: Narrator
1nmero4zpi3.text: DBKL's file says what it has said since 1997. Level 14 of Menara Sinar is a plant floor: pumps, ducts, transformers. Nobody at DBKL can find who signed the plans.
1nmero4zpi3.en: DBKL's file says what it has said since 1997. Level 14 of Menara Sinar is a plant floor: pumps, ducts, transformers. Nobody at DBKL can find who signed the plans.

dir.say: [flat, sardonic] D B K L's file says what it has said since 1997. Level fourteen of Menara Sinar is a plant floor: pumps, ducts, transformers. [break] [low, uneasy] Nobody at D B K L can find who signed the plans.

117nvjo7mp2.speaker: Narrator
117nvjo7mp2.text: The shelves are bare. The chair still faces the window, and the telescope beside it still points south-west, at Brickfields.
117nvjo7mp2.en: The shelves are bare. The chair still faces the window, and the telescope beside it still points south-west, at Brickfields.

dir.say: [hushed, uneasy] The shelves are bare. [break] The chair still faces the window, [break] [cold, quiet] and the telescope beside it still points south-west, at Brickfields.

1mw05yfzhty.speaker: Vivian Chua
1mw05yfzhty.text: You think Floor 14 was his office. It was his memory. You have only seen the part he chose to forget.
1mw05yfzhty.en: You think Floor 14 was his office. It was his memory. You have only seen the part he chose to forget.

dir.say: [calm, precise, faintly pitying] You think Floor fourteen was his office. [break] It was his memory. [break] [cool, quiet] You have only seen the part he chose to forget.

22xt8w2unon.speaker: Narrator
22xt8w2unon.text: Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, 4 AM on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. Serial RU-19.
22xt8w2unon.en: Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, 4 AM on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. Serial RU-19.

dir.say: [low, tense] Azman sends Farah a photograph from the cab of a crane at Westport, four in the morning on Thursday: a reefer unit going aboard a Singapore feeder. [break] [ominous] Serial R U nineteen.

2gdb4aai5pi.speaker: Narrator
2gdb4aai5pi.text: The export permit for RU-19 is stamped at Westport. Officer: N. SALLEH.
2gdb4aai5pi.en: The export permit for RU-19 is stamped at Westport. Officer: N. SALLEH.

dir.say: [flat, cold] The export permit for R U nineteen is stamped at Westport. [break] Officer: [emphasis] N. Salleh.

1w1f0gpw0ad.speaker: Narrator
1w1f0gpw0ad.text: The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, and four healing scratches on each forearm.
1w1f0gpw0ad.en: The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, and four healing scratches on each forearm.

dir.say: [low, ominous] The man who drove the reefer van down to the loading bay at three on Monday morning had a Sri Lankan seaman's pass, [break] [cold] and four healing scratches on each forearm.

120ptioibj6.speaker: Narrator
120ptioibj6.text: Farah sends one car and no radio. Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.
120ptioibj6.en: Farah sends one car and no radio. Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.

dir.say: [hushed, tense, dawn] Farah sends one car and no radio. [break] Mak Teh rolls up the warung shutter before anybody knocks, and points up the stairs without a word.

19l1fzxaevq.speaker: Narrator
19l1fzxaevq.text: He is at the window with two glasses of teh. He has drunk one. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.
19l1fzxaevq.en: He is at the window with two glasses of teh. He has drunk one. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

dir.say: [slow, overwhelmed, tender] He is at the window with two glasses of teh. [break] He has drunk one. [long-break] [voice thick] He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

2duubb8sas0.speaker: Daniel Raj
2duubb8sas0.text: You are late, machan. Five years late. I am not complaining.
2duubb8sas0.en: You are late, machan. Five years late. I am not complaining.

dir.say: [warm, tired, a crooked smile in the voice] You are late, machan. [break] Five years late. [break] [soft laugh] I am not complaining.

0c0c96oli88.speaker: Daniel Raj
0c0c96oli88.text: In 2021 they gave me a choice. Stay dead, and the detective lives. Come back, and the detective burns next. So I stayed dead.
0c0c96oli88.en: In 2021 they gave me a choice. Stay dead, and the detective lives. Come back, and the detective burns next. So I stayed dead.

dir.say: [low, quiet, confessing] In 2021 they gave me a choice. [break] Stay dead, and the detective lives. [break] Come back, and the detective burns next. [long-break] [aching, simple] So I stayed dead.

06nibxeog87.speaker: Daniel Raj
06nibxeog87.text: You gave the boy in Bay 3 his name back. Wei Jie. I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.
06nibxeog87.en: You gave the boy in Bay 3 his name back. Wei Jie. I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.

dir.say: [grieving, ashamed] You gave the boy in Bay three his name back. [break] Wei Jie. [break] [voice breaking] I watched them bury him as me, and I said nothing.
[long-break][close to tears, very quiet] மன்னிச்சிடு, [break] மச்சான்.

0kzjs91clpm.speaker: Narrator
0kzjs91clpm.text: You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. He pushes it back. Its twin is in his pocket. He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.
0kzjs91clpm.en: You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. He pushes it back. Its twin is in his pocket. He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.

dir.say: [tender, quiet] You put the silver lighter on the sill between the glasses. [break] He pushes it back. [break] Its twin is in his pocket. [long-break] [wistful, almost smiling] He bought two in 2016, one each, for two people who never smoked.

240o14w3rec.speaker: Narrator
240o14w3rec.text: Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.
240o14w3rec.en: Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.

dir.say: [quiet, relieved, bittersweet] Farah takes him to a house whose address she gives nobody, not even you. [break] [gentle] He goes down the wooden stairs with his hands in his pockets, like a man going to buy bread.

1aqxr8nxpq8.speaker: Narrator
1aqxr8nxpq8.text: Your office door is locked, the way you left it. The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.
1aqxr8nxpq8.en: Your office door is locked, the way you left it. The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.

dir.say: [tense, hushed] Your office door is locked, the way you left it. [break] [cold, slow] The folder on your desk is not the way you left anything.

1qqlu4921sa.speaker: Narrator
1qqlu4921sa.text: Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. On the tab, typed, your name. Opened 2016.
1qqlu4921sa.en: Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. On the tab, typed, your name. Opened 2016.

dir.say: [slow, dread] Grey archive board, a small embossed sun on the cover. [break] On the tab, typed, your name. [long-break] [whispering] Opened 2016.

02c36nue1x4.speaker: Narrator
02c36nue1x4.text: Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table 6 in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. August 2021, the week before the fire.
02c36nue1x4.en: Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table 6 in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. August 2021, the week before the fire.

dir.say: [low, shaken] Inside, one photograph: you and Daniel at table six in Restoran Bala, taken from across Jalan Tun Sambanthan. [long-break] [aching, quiet] August 2021, the week before the fire.

0kfwmjqqgei.speaker: Narrator
0kfwmjqqgei.text: And one typed list. H. Goh. Lim Chee Keong. P. Yogeswaran. Rashid Osman. Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.
0kfwmjqqgei.en: And one typed list. H. Goh. Lim Chee Keong. P. Yogeswaran. Rashid Osman. Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.

dir.say: [slow, grave, a roll call] And one typed list. [break] H. Goh. [break] Lim Chee Keong. [break] P. Yogeswaran. [break] Rashid Osman. [long-break] [cold] Every name struck through by hand, in blue ink.

0hsq723ts3c.speaker: Narrator
0hsq723ts3c.text: Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. The first is Daniel's. The second is yours.
0hsq723ts3c.en: Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. The first is Daniel's. The second is yours.

dir.say: [whispering, afraid] Under them, two names nobody has struck through yet. [break] The first is Daniel's. [long-break] [very quiet] The second is yours.

0x5ndmvtmz8.speaker: Narrator
0x5ndmvtmz8.text: Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning has a light on in it.
0x5ndmvtmz8.en: Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning has a light on in it.

dir.say: [long-break][hushed, ominous, slow] Across the city, on Jalan Ampang, one storey of black glass that Bomba sealed this morning [break] has a light on in it.

0ks1y6c6s9p.speaker: Narrator
0ks1y6c6s9p.text: Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.
0ks1y6c6s9p.en: Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.

dir.say: [flat, rueful] Farah's team searches your office while Bala Anne watches from the stairs with a ladle in his hand. [break] [quiet, hollow] They find your kettle, your files, and nobody.

22h0k3dx6js.speaker: Narrator
22h0k3dx6js.text: By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.
22h0k3dx6js.en: By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.

dir.say: [heavy, slow] By the time anybody thinks of Kampung Baru it is evening. Mak Teh is sitting on the warung steps. [break] [low, dread] At noon, she says, two men in polo shirts with a little sun on the pocket went up, and came down with a third man between them. [break] [quiet, sick] A van was waiting at the end of the Saloma bridge.

0iyvlzdtam6.speaker: Mak Teh
0iyvlzdtam6.text: Dia suruh saya jangan menangis. Saya menangis juga.
0iyvlzdtam6.en: He told me not to cry. I cried anyway.

dir.say: [old woman, crying softly] Dia suruh saya jangan menangis. [break] [sobbing] Saya menangis juga.

298imfraqhd.speaker: Narrator
298imfraqhd.text: Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. Engraved inside the lid: D.R.
298imfraqhd.en: Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. Engraved inside the lid: D.R.

dir.say: [hushed, stricken] Upstairs, a chair on its side, two glasses of teh across the floorboards, [break] and in the tea a silver flip-top lighter, the twin of the one in your pocket. [long-break] [whispering] Engraved inside the lid: D. R.

04ppanp04tb.speaker: Narrator
04ppanp04tb.text: The warrant in his name stays open. Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.
04ppanp04tb.en: The warrant in his name stays open. Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.

dir.say: [bitter, low] The warrant in his name stays open. [break] Whether he ran or was taken, he is a wanted man now, [break] [quiet, guilty] and nobody looks hard for a wanted man who has disappeared.

1uo4kurcjqo.speaker: Narrator
1uo4kurcjqo.text: Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at KLIA. Seat 14A is empty. It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.
1uo4kurcjqo.en: Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at KLIA. Seat 14A is empty. It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.

dir.say: [tense, flat] Farah's people walk the length of the morning flight to Colombo at K L I A. [break] Seat fourteen A is empty. [break] [cold, realizing] It was booked from a Sinar travel account at four on Monday morning.

1ap0pxa5w3z.speaker: Narrator
1ap0pxa5w3z.text: Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.
1ap0pxa5w3z.en: Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.

dir.say: [flat, hollow] Bomba opens the fourteenth floor for Farah a second time. [break] [quiet, uneasy] There is nobody on it but the two of you, and a chair facing the window.

0ilwb3o75xm.speaker: Narrator
0ilwb3o75xm.text: Farah does not send anybody anywhere.
0ilwb3o75xm.en: Farah does not send anybody anywhere.

0g8vsq1rvha.speaker: Narrator
0g8vsq1rvha.text: A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.
0g8vsq1rvha.en: A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] A warrant for murder goes out in the name of K. Rajan. [long-break] [quiet, aching] Under it, in pencil, where only she will see it, Farah writes the other name.

1hps9upsofg.speaker: Nurul Ain
1hps9upsofg.text: They say it was the man with the paper animals. Abah told me to help him. I do not know which one of them was lying to me.
1hps9upsofg.en: They say it was the man with the paper animals. Abah told me to help him. I do not know which one of them was lying to me.

dir.say: [hurt, confused] They say it was the man with the paper animals. [break] Abah told me to help him. [break] [bitter, breaking] I do not know which one of them was lying to me.

25ii5q3yqi1.speaker: Narrator
25ii5q3yqi1.text: Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.
25ii5q3yqi1.en: Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.

dir.say: [heavy, clipped] Farah sends four cars, because the warrant says murder. [break] [sorrowful] Mak Teh stands in the warung doorway with her hand over her mouth.

1cmmeeggu7b.speaker: Narrator
1cmmeeggu7b.text: He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.
1cmmeeggu7b.en: He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

dir.say: [slow, stricken] He comes down the wooden steps with his hands held out in front of him before anybody asks. [long-break] [voice thick] He looks older than five years, and exactly the same.

17c5mco4k83.speaker: Daniel Raj
17c5mco4k83.text: Machan. You did right, with what they gave you.
17c5mco4k83.en: Machan. You did right, with what they gave you.

dir.say: [calm, gentle, forgiving] Machan. [break] You did right, with what they gave you.

1l13j6cbvb9.speaker: Narrator
1l13j6cbvb9.text: He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.
1l13j6cbvb9.en: He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.

dir.say: [flat, low, dread] He is remanded at Sungai Buloh, [break] in a block where Sinar's lawyers already have three clients.

14wtmlb7k93.speaker: Narrator
14wtmlb7k93.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar signs the remand order himself.
14wtmlb7k93.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar signs the remand order himself.

23efd1082au.speaker: Narrator
23efd1082au.text: Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B1, in front of his own monitors. He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.
23efd1082au.en: Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B1, in front of his own monitors. He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Zulkifli Hamid is arrested in the control room on B one, in front of his own monitors. [break] [slower, sad] He takes the earpiece out himself, coils the wire, and puts it in Farah's hand. [break] [quiet, bitter] "You still drop your left shoulder when you shoot," he tells her.

1pecmomnc1t.speaker: Narrator
1pecmomnc1t.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. The murder charge will not last the week. The envelope in his glovebox, RM 8,000 in fifties, will.
1pecmomnc1t.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. The murder charge will not last the week. The envelope in his glovebox, RM 8,000 in fifties, will.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman in front of his own officers. [break] The murder charge will not last the week. [break] [dry, pointed] The envelope in his glovebox, eight thousand ringgit in fifties, will.

0ziizqyzuk2.speaker: Nurul Ain
0ziizqyzuk2.text: You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.
0ziizqyzuk2.en: You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.

dir.say: [dry, tired, sceptical] You arrested a superintendent. My editor cleared the whole front page for it. [break] [sad, knowing] Abah would have read it twice and asked who was still upstairs.

0tj6oku1s49.speaker: Narrator
0tj6oku1s49.text: Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.
0tj6oku1s49.en: Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Vivian Chua is arrested at her house in Bukit Tunku at five in the morning. [break] [uneasy] She is dressed, with her handbag on her knee, as if she has been waiting for a car. [break] [quiet, cold] She asks for one telephone call, and does not make it.

149rdips4t8.speaker: Nurul Ain
149rdips4t8.text: He did not jump. He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. I can write that now. I can write both of those.
149rdips4t8.en: He did not jump. He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. I can write that now. I can write both of those.

dir.say: [tearful, steadying] He did not jump. [break] He was pushed while he was trying to undo something. [break] [quiet, fierce, grateful] I can write that now. I can write both of those.

2czgavzhvxy.speaker: Narrator
2czgavzhvxy.text: Bala Anne comes up the stairs himself, which he never does after closing, with a page torn from his order pad.
2czgavzhvxy.en: Bala Anne comes up the stairs himself, which he never does after closing, with a page torn from his order pad.

dir.say: [low, late-night, uneasy] Bala Anne comes up the stairs himself, [break] which he never does after closing, [break] with a page torn from his order pad.

26ryfuwogb5.speaker: Bala Anne
26ryfuwogb5.text: Thambi. Unakku oru phone vandhuchu. Rendu naal munnaadi.
26ryfuwogb5.en: Boy. A phone call came for you. Two days ago.
26ryfuwogb5.tts: தம்பி. உனக்கு ஒரு ஃபோன் வந்துச்சு. ரெண்டு நாள் முன்னாடி.

dir.say: [out of breath from the stairs, sheepish] தம்பி. [break] உனக்கு ஒரு ஃபோன் வந்துச்சு. [break] [guilty, quieter] ரெண்டு நாள் முன்னாடி.

2fv73j8mh7u.speaker: Bala Anne
2fv73j8mh7u.text: An old Malay man, very polite. He asked for the detective from the fire. He made me promise to give it to you tonight and not before. I promised. Do not look at me like that.
2fv73j8mh7u.en: An old Malay man, very polite. He asked for the detective from the fire. He made me promise to give it to you tonight and not before. I promised. Do not look at me like that.

dir.say: [defensive, gruff, uneasy] An old Malay man, very polite. He asked for the detective from the fire. [break] He made me promise to give it to you tonight and not before. [break] I promised. [long-break] [bristling, embarrassed] Do not look at me like that.

1kjnr2ey1zj.speaker: Narrator
1kjnr2ey1zj.text: On the page, in his capitals: BAY 3. KHAMIS. 12 MALAM. 5 TAHUN. SAYA BAWA GAMBAR. I.B. Bay 3, Thursday, midnight, five years. I will bring photographs.
1kjnr2ey1zj.en: On the page, in his capitals: BAY 3. KHAMIS. 12 MALAM. 5 TAHUN. SAYA BAWA GAMBAR. I.B. Bay 3, Thursday, midnight, five years. I will bring photographs.

dir.say: [slow, reading aloud, cold dread rising] On the page, in his capitals: [break] Bay three. Khamis. Dua belas malam. Lima tahun. Saya bawa gambar. I. B. [long-break] [quiet] Bay three, Thursday, midnight, five years. [break] I will bring photographs.

0bazpo5c003.speaker: Narrator
0bazpo5c003.text: Across Jalan Tun Sambanthan a grey sedan is parked where nobody parks after eleven. WXY 1408. By the time you come down with your keys, it has gone.
0bazpo5c003.en: Across Jalan Tun Sambanthan a grey sedan is parked where nobody parks after eleven. WXY 1408. By the time you come down with your keys, it has gone.

dir.say: [low, wary] Across Jalan Tun Sambanthan a grey sedan is parked where nobody parks after eleven. [break] W X Y, one four oh eight. [break] [flat] By the time you come down with your keys, it has gone.

1q9nd8blbsz.speaker: Narrator
1q9nd8blbsz.text: You make Port Klang in thirty-five minutes, which is not possible, and see the glow from the Pulau Indah bridge, which is.
1q9nd8blbsz.en: You make Port Klang in thirty-five minutes, which is not possible, and see the glow from the Pulau Indah bridge, which is.

dir.say: [tense, driving, clipped] You make Port Klang in thirty-five minutes, which is not possible, [break] [dread] and see the glow from the Pulau Indah bridge, which is.

0u80fw0xhxl.speaker: Narrator
0u80fw0xhxl.text: The sky over the port is orange. You know which bay it is before you can see it.
0u80fw0xhxl.en: The sky over the port is orange. You know which bay it is before you can see it.

dir.say: [hushed, sick with certainty] The sky over the port is orange. [break] You know which bay it is before you can see it.

1fncjbqg25z.speaker: Narrator
1fncjbqg25z.text: Five years to the night, you watch Bay 3 burn again. This time you are on the right side of the tape.
1fncjbqg25z.en: Five years to the night, you watch Bay 3 burn again. This time you are on the right side of the tape.

dir.say: [low, shaken, bitter] Five years to the night, you watch Bay three burn again. [break] This time you are on the right side of the tape.

1d2jr2rmqq3.speaker: Narrator
1d2jr2rmqq3.text: The new roof goes the way the old one went: all at once, with a sound like a long breath let out.
1d2jr2rmqq3.en: The new roof goes the way the old one went: all at once, with a sound like a long breath let out.

dir.cue: [slow, haunted, almost a whisper at the end]

28uih9uvcjl.speaker: Narrator
28uih9uvcjl.text: Your chest is a fist. Count the cranes. One. Two. Three.
28uih9uvcjl.en: Your chest is a fist. Count the cranes. One. Two. Three.

dir.say: [breathing hard, panicking, forcing calm] Your chest is a fist. [break] Count the cranes. [break] One. [break] Two. [break] Three.

1w5uy1plk2v.speaker: Narrator
1w5uy1plk2v.text: And under the roar, something you have never let yourself remember: a voice outside the smoke, calm as a man ordering tea, saying a name you did not know then.
1w5uy1plk2v.en: And under the roar, something you have never let yourself remember: a voice outside the smoke, calm as a man ordering tea, saying a name you did not know then.

dir.say: [hushed, dreamlike, afraid of the memory] And under the roar, something you have never let yourself remember: [break] a voice outside the smoke, calm as a man ordering tea, [break] saying a name you did not know then.

0qbwdnyr5j8.speaker: A voice
0qbwdnyr5j8.text: Biarkan, Tuan Ismail. Biar dua-dua sekali.
0qbwdnyr5j8.en: Let it burn, Tuan Ismail. Both of them.

dir.say: [calm, unhurried, quietly courteous, utterly cold] Biarkan, Tuan Ismail. [break] Biar dua-dua sekali.

0encacbvans.speaker: Narrator
0encacbvans.text: At first light Bomba walk in on the black floor. One body, on its side by the old reefer sockets, where the other one lay in 2021.
0encacbvans.en: At first light Bomba walk in on the black floor. One body, on its side by the old reefer sockets, where the other one lay in 2021.

dir.say: [grey, quiet, sombre] At first light Bomba walk in on the black floor. [break] One body, on its side by the old reefer sockets, [break] where the other one lay in twenty twenty-one.

0sng748vff9.speaker: Narrator
0sng748vff9.text: Beside its right hand, a silver flip-top lighter.
0sng748vff9.en: Beside its right hand, a silver flip-top lighter.

dir.say: [long-break][very quiet, ominous] Beside its right hand, a silver flip-top lighter.

04w8yirrxur.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
04w8yirrxur.text: Engraved inside the lid. D.R. Klang Selatan read it before I did.
04w8yirrxur.en: Engraved inside the lid. D.R. Klang Selatan read it before I did.

dir.say: [tight, controlled, angry underneath] Engraved inside the lid. [break] D. R. [break] [bitter] Klang Selatan read it before I did.
[low, reluctant, she hates asking] Mana kau punya?

1h9sr3qbvcq.speaker: Narrator
1h9sr3qbvcq.text: Your hand is already in your pocket. You put Daniel's lighter on the bonnet of her car, and she looks at the two of them side by side for a long time.
1h9sr3qbvcq.en: Your hand is already in your pocket. You put Daniel's lighter on the bonnet of her car, and she looks at the two of them side by side for a long time.

dir.say: [quiet, steady] Your hand is already in your pocket. [break] You put Daniel's lighter on the bonnet of her car, [break] and she looks at the two of them side by side for a long time.

1hrrsaqsksk.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1hrrsaqsksk.text: Daniel's twin is in his pocket, in a house I have not told you about. My man watched him take it out at five this morning. He was there all night.
1hrrsaqsksk.en: Daniel's twin is in his pocket, in a house I have not told you about. My man watched him take it out at five this morning. He was there all night.

dir.say: [low, measured, reassuring despite herself] Daniel's twin is in his pocket, in a house I have not told you about. [break] My man watched him take it out at five this morning. [break] He was there all night.

08shfxlkz0s.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
08shfxlkz0s.text: Daniel's twin is in a property bag at Sungai Buloh, sealed, with his belt and his shoelaces. I rang the prison at five.
08shfxlkz0s.en: Daniel's twin is in a property bag at Sungai Buloh, sealed, with his belt and his shoelaces. I rang the prison at five.

dir.say: [flat, tired, faintly guilty] Daniel's twin is in a property bag at Sungai Buloh, sealed, with his belt and his shoelaces. [break] I rang the prison at five.

20e656daj72.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
20e656daj72.text: Daniel's twin is in my evidence locker at Bukit Aman. I took it out of a glass of tea in Kampung Baru with my own hands.
20e656daj72.en: Daniel's twin is in my evidence locker at Bukit Aman. I took it out of a glass of tea in Kampung Baru with my own hands.

dir.say: [quiet, raw, steadying her voice] Daniel's twin is in my evidence locker at Bukit Aman. [break] I took it out of a glass of tea in Kampung Baru [break] with my own hands.
[long-break][very quiet, chilled] So that makes three.

1lc2p2jztn0.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1lc2p2jztn0.text: Klang Selatan have a superintendent at Bukit Aman telling them you were here at twelve forty. You were. They want you for twenty-four hours. They are not getting you.
1lc2p2jztn0.en: Klang Selatan have a superintendent at Bukit Aman telling them you were here at twelve forty. You were. They want you for twenty-four hours. They are not getting you.

0do7583wm6b.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0do7583wm6b.text: Khairul is suspended, so for once nobody is ringing Klang about me. I have a week. After that they will want you for twenty-four hours.
0do7583wm6b.en: Khairul is suspended, so for once nobody is ringing Klang about me. I have a week. After that they will want you for twenty-four hours.

dir.say: [dry, a flicker of grim satisfaction] Khairul is suspended, so for once nobody is ringing Klang about me. [break] I have a week. [break] [serious] After that they will want you for twenty-four hours.

2b66uswkhyd.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2b66uswkhyd.text: And Azman rang me from his crane. He says the reefer that went aboard the Singapore feeder in the spring, RU-19, swung like an empty box. He has lifted ten thousand. He knows the swing.
2b66uswkhyd.en: And Azman rang me from his crane. He says the reefer that went aboard the Singapore feeder in the spring, RU-19, swung like an empty box. He has lifted ten thousand. He knows the swing.

1bd2rporg35.speaker: Narrator
1bd2rporg35.text: Penolong Penguasa Bomba Rosli drives down from Kuala Lumpur without being asked, still in yesterday's uniform.
1bd2rporg35.en: Penolong Penguasa Bomba Rosli drives down from Kuala Lumpur without being asked, still in yesterday's uniform.

0gibxxqp1n2.speaker: Fire Officer Rosli
0gibxxqp1n2.text: I know whose watch that is. Tuan Ismail Bakar. Thirty-seven years in Bomba. He taught me to read a floor.
0gibxxqp1n2.en: I know whose watch that is. Tuan Ismail Bakar. Thirty-seven years in Bomba. He taught me to read a floor.

0esw796g96l.speaker: Fire Officer Rosli
0esw796g96l.text: In 2021 he wrote this bay up as an electrical fault. He was the best fire investigator in Selangor. The best do not get that wrong by accident.
0esw796g96l.en: In 2021 he wrote this bay up as an electrical fault. He was the best fire investigator in Selangor. The best do not get that wrong by accident.

25784giqtnx.speaker: Fire Officer Rosli
25784giqtnx.text: When the coroner gave your boy in Cheras his real name back, Tuan Ismail stopped coming to the station on Fridays. He said he could not pray in a row with honest men.
25784giqtnx.en: When the coroner gave your boy in Cheras his real name back, Tuan Ismail stopped coming to the station on Fridays. He said he could not pray in a row with honest men.

2f1sbhd0d4i.speaker: Fire Officer Rosli
2f1sbhd0d4i.text: He retired in 2023 and never set foot in the station again. Not once. Not even for the Hari Raya open house.
2f1sbhd0d4i.en: He retired in 2023 and never set foot in the station again. Not once. Not even for the Hari Raya open house.

dir.say: [puzzled, sad] He retired in twenty twenty-three and never set foot in the station again. [break] Not once. [break] Not even for the Hari Raya open house.

1497aydkj8q.speaker: Narrator
1497aydkj8q.text: Bomba amend two reports in one week. Bay 3, 2026: deliberate. Bay 3, 2021: deliberate, in Ismail Bakar's own words from his carbon copy, countersigned by Rosli.
1497aydkj8q.en: Bomba amend two reports in one week. Bay 3, 2026: deliberate. Bay 3, 2021: deliberate, in Ismail Bakar's own words from his carbon copy, countersigned by Rosli.

2dln225u85i.speaker: Puan Rohana
2dln225u85i.text: They say it is finished. Ismail always said a fire is never finished until you have found where it started.
2dln225u85i.en: They say it is finished. Ismail always said a fire is never finished until you have found where it started.

0kprg4kqpks.speaker: Narrator
0kprg4kqpks.text: Kamal Ariffin is moved to Sinar Cold Chain's depot at Bloemendhal, Colombo, as fire safety officer. Herath sends you a photograph of him at the depot gate, with no message.
0kprg4kqpks.en: Kamal Ariffin is moved to Sinar Cold Chain's depot at Bloemendhal, Colombo, as fire safety officer. Herath sends you a photograph of him at the depot gate, with no message.

0yt7esge2at.speaker: Narrator
0yt7esge2at.text: Jeffrey Ho takes early retirement after thirty-nine years. On his last day a black car with no plates waits for him at the Warehouse 6 gate, and the guards stand up.
0yt7esge2at.en: Jeffrey Ho takes early retirement after thirty-nine years. On his last day a black car with no plates waits for him at the Warehouse 6 gate, and the guards stand up.

234f3o06tx2.speaker: Narrator
234f3o06tx2.text: Klang Selatan close the file on a diesel thief with a grudge. Ah Fook's mother stops selling kuih at Pandamaran market. People look at her too long.
234f3o06tx2.en: Klang Selatan close the file on a diesel thief with a grudge. Ah Fook's mother stops selling kuih at Pandamaran market. People look at her too long.

1k14cx7vqtd.speaker: Narrator

1k14cx7vqtd.en: Ah Fook stands outside the cemetery gate with his bandaged hands in his pockets and will not come in.

1ukmyken59g.speaker: Ah Fook

1ukmyken59g.en: The old man… I could not pull him out.

15p61yujwyc.en: Amirul stands at the back with the Bomba men, on bail, and his mother does not turn round.

dir.say: [cold, quiet] A wreath arrives from the Office of the Chairman with no name on the card. [break] The florist's invoice is signed Melissa Ong.

2dim659vscp.text: Somewhere a prime mover is pulling the Chairman's memory down a road that is not on any map of his.
2dim659vscp.en: Somewhere a prime mover is pulling the Chairman's memory down a road that is not on any map of his.

10ys2qoci0g.speaker: Narrator

1nbmjo1ru0z.speaker: Narrator

1nbmjo1ru0z.en: Farah drives you there with a scarf over your eyes for the last ten minutes, and apologises for it twice.

17qbxpz8he6.speaker: Narrator

17qbxpz8he6.en: Daniel holds Ismail's photograph under the kitchen bulb for a long time, the way he used to hold a receipt he did not believe.

0ykzlk8r40i.speaker: Daniel Raj
0ykzlk8r40i.text: Table seven. August 2016, the week we opened. An old man in a white shirt sat behind us for an hour, paid for our teh, and left before we could thank him.

0oc4oqycsq4.text: I said, machan, rich uncles like detectives. You laughed. I bought the lighters the next day.

0mtbbym3xds.speaker: Daniel Raj
0mtbbym3xds.text: He has been sitting behind us for ten years.
0mtbbym3xds.en: He has been sitting behind us for ten years.

dir.say: [long-break][very quiet, cold realisation] He has been sitting behind us for ten years.

2fl4wsp38rm.text: Through the glass Daniel looks thinner, and calmer than you. You press Ismail's photograph flat against your side of the partition.
2fl4wsp38rm.en: Through the glass Daniel looks thinner, and calmer than you. You press Ismail's photograph flat against your side of the partition.

0iouzn6yfxy.speaker: Daniel Raj
0iouzn6yfxy.text: Get me out of here, machan. Not for me. He knows exactly which block I am in.
0iouzn6yfxy.en: Get me out of here, machan. Not for me. He knows exactly which block I am in.

00ecw5v1rjk.speaker: Narrator
00ecw5v1rjk.text: Superintendent Khairul's signature is still on the remand order. Nobody has thought to take it off.
00ecw5v1rjk.en: Superintendent Khairul's signature is still on the remand order. Nobody has thought to take it off.

1u4k23cafq4.speaker: Narrator
1u4k23cafq4.text: Wherever RU-07 went, it went with everything that was in it.

0189jgfms8j.speaker: Narrator
0189jgfms8j.text: At midnight something slides under your office door: a paper kancil folded from an orange cargo tag. RU-07. Set point, eighteen degrees.
0189jgfms8j.en: At midnight something slides under your office door: a paper kancil folded from an orange cargo tag. RU-07. Set point, eighteen degrees.

00898x3qxwf.speaker: Narrator
00898x3qxwf.text: Nobody else alive folds a kancil that way. He is alive. He is still theirs. They wanted you to know both.
00898x3qxwf.en: Nobody else alive folds a kancil that way. He is alive. He is still theirs. They wanted you to know both.

1skve32ezi4.speaker: Narrator
1skve32ezi4.text: After closing you tell Bala Anne about the tape, because there is nobody else awake to tell.
1skve32ezi4.en: After closing you tell Bala Anne about the tape, because there is nobody else awake to tell.

06jwm17r1yr.speaker: Narrator
06jwm17r1yr.text: He listens with the old photograph of his father's stall in his hands, the one that has hung over the till since 1979, and does not put it back on its nail.
06jwm17r1yr.en: He listens with the old photograph of his father's stall in his hands, the one that has hung over the till since 1979, and does not put it back on its nail.

dir.say: [slow, tender, watchful] He listens with the old photograph of his father's stall in his hands, the one that has hung over the till since nineteen seventy-nine, [break] and does not put it back on its nail.

1slkeoi5ouq.speaker: Bala Anne
1slkeoi5ouq.text: My father used to say, in this town every fire has an owner. Do not look for the match, thambi. Look for the owner.
1slkeoi5ouq.en: My father used to say, in this town every fire has an owner. Do not look for the match, thambi. Look for the owner.

0ejwqtl9vmn.speaker: Narrator
0ejwqtl9vmn.text: Five years you called it a dream. Now it is on a tape in Farah's locker: a calm voice at the edge of a fire, saying both of them.
0ejwqtl9vmn.en: Five years you called it a dream. Now it is on a tape in Farah's locker: a calm voice at the edge of a fire, saying both of them.

1w6p1rx37vf.speaker: Narrator

1w6p1rx37vf.en: Upstairs, the grey folder is where you locked it. Under Rashid Osman, in fresh blue ink, somebody has typed one more name and struck it through by hand: I. Bakar.

01dw2kjeolb.speaker: Narrator

01dw2kjeolb.en: At ten past two the old telephone on the wall by the till rings: the line with the paper tag in Port Klang.

0lybg386x4f.speaker: Narrator
0lybg386x4f.text: Bala Anne answers it in his singlet, listens, and puts the receiver down on the counter in front of you. Then he steps back into the dark, as if the voice on it could see him.
0lybg386x4f.en: Bala Anne answers it in his singlet, listens, and puts the receiver down on the counter in front of you. Then he steps back into the dark, as if the voice on it could see him.

0hwkartaei4.text: The prime mover is parked behind the depot office with its plates off. In the cab, a Sri Lankan seaman's pass: Kasun Ranaweera.
0hwkartaei4.en: The prime mover is parked behind the depot office with its plates off. In the cab, a Sri Lankan seaman's pass: Kasun Ranaweera.

dir.say: [businesslike, pointed] The prime mover is parked behind the depot office with its plates off. [break] In the cab, a Sri Lankan seaman's pass: [break] Kasun Ranaweera.

22ag31fmkdp.speaker: Narrator
22ag31fmkdp.text: Taped inside RU-07's door, an export permit for Monday night, Port Klang to Colombo. Officer: N. SALLEH.
22ag31fmkdp.en: Taped inside RU-07's door, an export permit for Monday night, Port Klang to Colombo. Officer: N. SALLEH.

dir.say: [dry, pointed] Taped inside R U oh seven's door, an export permit for Monday night, Port Klang to Colombo. [break] Officer: N. Salleh.

07kp0h5wkfh.speaker: Narrator
07kp0h5wkfh.text: At the back of RU-07, behind the last pallet of cartons, Farah's torch found a man sitting on the floor with his knees up and a carton of water, blinking. Three days in the dark at eighteen degrees, with the Chairman's memory for company.
07kp0h5wkfh.en: At the back of RU-07, behind the last pallet of cartons, Farah's torch found a man sitting on the floor with his knees up and a carton of water, blinking. Three days in the dark at eighteen degrees, with the Chairman's memory for company.

dir.say: [soft, overwhelmed, holding it together] At the back of R U oh seven, behind the last pallet of cartons, Farah's torch found a man sitting on the floor with his knees up and a carton of water, blinking. [break] Three days in the dark at eighteen degrees, [break] with the Chairman's memory for company.

2b1op4d7jda.speaker: Daniel Raj
2b1op4d7jda.text: You are late again, machan. I am still not complaining.
2b1op4d7jda.en: You are late again, machan. I am still not complaining.

dir.say: [weak, hoarse, a tired smile] You are late again, machan. [break] I am still not complaining.

0ej06hpd2cn.speaker: Daniel Raj
0ej06hpd2cn.text: He came to the cold room once, on the first night. He did not come in. He stood in the doorway and smoked, and asked me if I still had my lighter.
0ej06hpd2cn.en: He came to the cold room once, on the first night. He did not come in. He stood in the doorway and smoked, and asked me if I still had my lighter.

dir.say: [quiet, haunted] He came to the cold room once, on the first night. [break] He did not come in. [break] He stood in the doorway and smoked, [break] [cold] and asked me if I still had my lighter.

29rqm2w9f4l.speaker: Narrator
29rqm2w9f4l.text: You put Farah's evidence bag on the blanket, with the twin from Kampung Baru inside it. She pretends not to see him take it out.
29rqm2w9f4l.en: You put Farah's evidence bag on the blanket, with the twin from Kampung Baru inside it. She pretends not to see him take it out.

09n3fa91nxv.speaker: Narrator
09n3fa91nxv.text: The warrant from Menara Sinar is still open. Farah lays her own jacket over his wrists so that nobody photographs the cuffs.
09n3fa91nxv.en: The warrant from Menara Sinar is still open. Farah lays her own jacket over his wrists so that nobody photographs the cuffs.

0hc5c7rn3fk.speaker: Narrator
0hc5c7rn3fk.text: The marine police stop Ah Seng's ice barge off Pulau Ketam at one in the morning. It is carrying ice, and Ah Seng, and a great deal of language.
0hc5c7rn3fk.en: The marine police stop Ah Seng's ice barge off Pulau Ketam at one in the morning. It is carrying ice, and Ah Seng, and a great deal of language.

dir.say: [dry, deflated, a trace of dark humour] The marine police stop Ah Seng's ice barge off Pulau Ketam at one in the morning. [break] It is carrying ice, and Ah Seng, [break] and a great deal of language.

1ld6zjft4ux.speaker: Narrator
1ld6zjft4ux.text: Tan Kok Fook is charged with murder in the Klang sessions court with both hands still in bandages. His mother brings him a flask of herbal tea and is not allowed to give it to him.
1ld6zjft4ux.en: Tan Kok Fook is charged with murder in the Klang sessions court with both hands still in bandages. His mother brings him a flask of herbal tea and is not allowed to give it to him.

dir.say: [clipped, formal, then sad] Tan Kok Fook is charged with murder in the Klang sessions court with both hands still in bandages. [break] [quiet] His mother brings him a flask of herbal tea and is not allowed to give it to him.

1j0m2puddje.speaker: Puan Rohana
1j0m2puddje.text: They say it was a diesel thief with a grudge. Ismail put out fires for thirty-seven years. He would have laughed at that, a little.
1j0m2puddje.en: They say it was a diesel thief with a grudge. Ismail put out fires for thirty-seven years. He would have laughed at that, a little.

dir.say: [tired, faintly wry, grieving] They say it was a diesel thief with a grudge. [break] Ismail put out fires for thirty-seven years. [break] [soft] He would have laughed at that, a little.

0vb5z52oz23.speaker: Narrator
0vb5z52oz23.text: Kamal Ariffin is arrested at the Warehouse 6 guardhouse in his reflective vest. He asks Rosli, who has come to watch, whether they are going to take his old Bomba boots as well. Rosli says yes.
0vb5z52oz23.en: Kamal Ariffin is arrested at the Warehouse 6 guardhouse in his reflective vest. He asks Rosli, who has come to watch, whether they are going to take his old Bomba boots as well. Rosli says yes.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Kamal Ariffin is arrested at the Warehouse six guardhouse in his reflective vest. [break] He asks Rosli, who has come to watch, whether they are going to take his old Bomba boots as well. [break] [quiet, hard] Rosli says yes.

0ikg4grmoyr.speaker: Narrator
0ikg4grmoyr.text: Amirul Ismail is arrested at his office in Bukit Tinggi in front of the show-flat brochures. His mother does not come to the station. She is at the mortuary, waiting to take his father home.
0ikg4grmoyr.en: Amirul Ismail is arrested at his office in Bukit Tinggi in front of the show-flat brochures. His mother does not come to the station. She is at the mortuary, waiting to take his father home.

dir.say: [clipped, then heavy] Amirul Ismail is arrested at his office in Bukit Tinggi in front of the show-flat brochures. [break] His mother does not come to the station. [break] [quiet, sad] She is at the mortuary, waiting to take his father home.

15sqexjg8ao.speaker: Puan Rohana
15sqexjg8ao.text: My husband is in the ground and my son is in a cell. Tell me which one of them I should pray for first.
15sqexjg8ao.en: My husband is in the ground and my son is in a cell. Tell me which one of them I should pray for first.

dir.say: [broken, accusing, very quiet] My husband is in the ground and my son is in a cell. [break] [voice cracking] Tell me which one of them I should pray for first.

1ii480916px.speaker: Narrator
1ii480916px.text: Jeffrey Ho is arrested at his house in Klang at five in the morning, in a pressed shirt, with a packed bag by the door. He has been ready for thirty-nine years.
1ii480916px.en: Jeffrey Ho is arrested at his house in Klang at five in the morning, in a pressed shirt, with a packed bag by the door. He has been ready for thirty-nine years.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Jeffrey Ho is arrested at his house in Klang at five in the morning, in a pressed shirt, with a packed bag by the door. [break] [quiet, uneasy] He has been ready for thirty-nine years.

0klip05bj7b.speaker: Puan Rohana
0klip05bj7b.text: He went there to give back what he took. You made them write that down. That is all I wanted on his stone.
0klip05bj7b.en: He went there to give back what he took. You made them write that down. That is all I wanted on his stone.

dir.say: [tearful, steadying, grateful] He went there to give back what he took. [break] You made them write that down. [break] [soft] That is all I wanted on his stone.

1jh2fr0tp58.speaker: Narrator
1jh2fr0tp58.text: The courier will not come in out of the rain. He hands Bala Anne a black envelope across the counter, a small brass sun pressed into its flap, and waits to watch it opened.
1jh2fr0tp58.en: The courier will not come in out of the rain. He hands Bala Anne a black envelope across the counter, a small brass sun pressed into its flap, and waits to watch it opened.

2cuhi62erk6.speaker: Narrator
2cuhi62erk6.text: Sinar Holdings Berhad, forty years. Saturday, 14 November, Level 15, Menara Sinar. The Chairman will address his guests. Table 6. For two.
2cuhi62erk6.en: Sinar Holdings Berhad, forty years. Saturday, 14 November, Level 15, Menara Sinar. The Chairman will address his guests. Table 6. For two.

dir.say: [reading aloud, flat, faintly ironic] Sinar Holdings Berhad, forty years. [break] Saturday, fourteen November, Level fifteen, Menara Sinar. [break] The Chairman will address his guests. [long-break] [quiet] Table six. [break] For two.
[gruff, worried, almost pleading] தம்பி. [break] போக வேண்டாம்.

12mqx2rqunm.speaker: Bala Anne
12mqx2rqunm.text: Table six. That is my table. Now he is taking my tables also.
12mqx2rqunm.en: Table six. That is my table. Now he is taking my tables also.

1opb8s2w0f7.speaker: Narrator
1opb8s2w0f7.text: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's appeal has been put off again, to next year. Bala Anne does not even look up.
1opb8s2w0f7.en: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's appeal has been put off again, to next year. Bala Anne does not even look up.

1sd10pop503.speaker: Bala Anne
1sd10pop503.text: That durian man Ravi says if you go to the big party, bring him back a piece of cake. I told him come and eat here like a human being.
1sd10pop503.en: That durian man Ravi says if you go to the big party, bring him back a piece of cake. I told him come and eat here like a human being.

0hwdn0nhrv8.speaker: Narrator
0hwdn0nhrv8.text: Pinned by the till, a postcard from Pandamaran with no message, only a drawing of two hands in bandages. Ah Fook's trial is in January.
0hwdn0nhrv8.en: Pinned by the till, a postcard from Pandamaran with no message, only a drawing of two hands in bandages. Ah Fook's trial is in January.

19e5b34ol02.speaker: Narrator
19e5b34ol02.text: Pinned by the till, three lines from Puan Rohana in Klang: Amirul is out on bail. He sleeps in his old room and does not speak.
19e5b34ol02.en: Pinned by the till, three lines from Puan Rohana in Klang: Amirul is out on bail. He sleeps in his old room and does not speak.

2f9tll9zk7d.speaker: Narrator
2f9tll9zk7d.text: Tonight Menara Sinar is lit amber from the pavement to the brass sun on its crown, all but one storey, a third of the way up, that stays black.
2f9tll9zk7d.en: Tonight Menara Sinar is lit amber from the pavement to the brass sun on its crown, all but one storey, a third of the way up, that stays black.

09qs4dinu6z.speaker: Narrator
09qs4dinu6z.text: In the drop-off lane, a grey sedan with its engine running. WXY 1408. The driver wears a white shirt and does not look at you, which is how you know he has been looking.
09qs4dinu6z.en: In the drop-off lane, a grey sedan with its engine running. WXY 1408. The driver wears a white shirt and does not look at you, which is how you know he has been looking.

dir.say: [low, tense] In the drop-off lane, a grey sedan with its engine running. [break] WXY one four zero eight. [break] The driver wears a white shirt and does not look at you, [break] [cold] which is how you know he has been looking.

13p789g9s1z.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
13p789g9s1z.text: Table six, for two. He knew I would come. Officially I am here for the deputy minister. Unofficially I am your plus one, and I am not dancing.
13p789g9s1z.en: Table six, for two. He knew I would come. Officially I am here for the deputy minister. Unofficially I am your plus one, and I am not dancing.

dir.say: [dry, clipped, guarded] Table six, for two. He knew I would come. [break] Officially I am here for the deputy minister. [break] [deadpan] Unofficially I am your plus one, and I am not dancing.

2gbkzc3llbv.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2gbkzc3llbv.text: My superintendent is at table two with the deputy minister. Khairul has a new watch. I have not asked him where from.
2gbkzc3llbv.en: My superintendent is at table two with the deputy minister. Khairul has a new watch. I have not asked him where from.

2bpckmeuyut.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2bpckmeuyut.text: Khairul is suspended, and he is still invited. Table thirty, by the kitchen door. Sinar never forgets a friend.
2bpckmeuyut.en: Khairul is suspended, and he is still invited. Table thirty, by the kitchen door. Sinar never forgets a friend.

1ukmipsdnw0.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1ukmipsdnw0.text: Ninety officers at Bukit Aman are still reading the cartons from Jugra. Half the names on tonight's guest list are in them.
1ukmipsdnw0.en: Ninety officers at Bukit Aman are still reading the cartons from Jugra. Half the names on tonight's guest list are in them.

25dile91u10.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
25dile91u10.text: Every name on tonight's guest list was in a carton I never got to open. They will all shake my hand.
25dile91u10.en: Every name on tonight's guest list was in a carton I never got to open. They will all shake my hand.

0gyn9j5b8ua.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0gyn9j5b8ua.text: Daniel is in a house I have not told you about, with two of my men and the television on. He asked me to tell you one thing. Do not drink anything you did not order.
0gyn9j5b8ua.en: Daniel is in a house I have not told you about, with two of my men and the television on. He asked me to tell you one thing. Do not drink anything you did not order.

dir.say: [low, careful, protective] Daniel is in a house I have not told you about, with two of my men and the television on. [break] He asked me to tell you one thing. [break] [serious] Do not drink anything you did not order.

229mt0bua3l.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
229mt0bua3l.text: Daniel is in Sungai Buloh, Block C, with the radio on. His lawyer says February. He asked me to tell you one thing. Do not drink anything you did not order.
229mt0bua3l.en: Daniel is in Sungai Buloh, Block C, with the radio on. His lawyer says February. He asked me to tell you one thing. Do not drink anything you did not order.

dir.say: [low, tired, careful] Daniel is in Sungai Buloh, Block C, with the radio on. His lawyer says February. [break] He asked me to tell you one thing. [break] [serious] Do not drink anything you did not order.

1ewb27zqsoe.speaker: Narrator
1ewb27zqsoe.text: Nobody has seen Daniel since August. Every few weeks a paper kancil comes under your office door, folded from something of theirs. You keep them in the drawer, and Farah does not ask.
1ewb27zqsoe.en: Nobody has seen Daniel since August. Every few weeks a paper kancil comes under your office door, folded from something of theirs. You keep them in the drawer, and Farah does not ask.

107w3adn3gk.speaker: Narrator
107w3adn3gk.text: At the lift doors, a man in a dinner jacket with an earpiece and a policeman's stillness: Zulkifli Hamid, up from Westport for the night. As Farah passes him he says, very quietly, "Left shoulder, Inspector."
107w3adn3gk.en: At the lift doors, a man in a dinner jacket with an earpiece and a policeman's stillness: Zulkifli Hamid, up from Westport for the night. As Farah passes him he says, very quietly, "Left shoulder, Inspector."

dir.say: [low, tense, watchful] At the lift doors, a man in a dinner jacket with an earpiece and a policeman's stillness: [break] Zulkifli Hamid, up from Westport for the night. [break] As Farah passes him he says, very quietly, [whispering] "Left shoulder, Inspector."

0jsrcboye1w.speaker: Narrator
0jsrcboye1w.text: Level 15 has been emptied of its directors for one night and turned into a ballroom: three hundred guests at round tables, a band playing P. Ramlee, and at the far end, a screen.
0jsrcboye1w.en: Level 15 has been emptied of its directors for one night and turned into a ballroom: three hundred guests at round tables, a band playing P. Ramlee, and at the far end, a screen.

29oh7g0f8nc.speaker: Narrator
29oh7g0f8nc.text: Twelve panels of white silk, five metres high, with Sinar's sun painted across them in gold. Behind it the light is off. Everybody looks at it anyway.
29oh7g0f8nc.en: Twelve panels of white silk, five metres high, with Sinar's sun painted across them in gold. Behind it the light is off. Everybody looks at it anyway.

07ewpklq16g.speaker: Narrator
07ewpklq16g.text: Under your feet is the floor that is not there. Rosli stands at the fire exit in his dress uniform, because Bomba sealed Level 14 after Dato' Rashid fell, and somebody has to stand on top of the seal.
07ewpklq16g.en: Under your feet is the floor that is not there. Rosli stands at the fire exit in his dress uniform, because Bomba sealed Level 14 after Dato' Rashid fell, and somebody has to stand on top of the seal.

2333wh77ttv.speaker: Narrator
2333wh77ttv.text: At the door the Office of the Chairman's new secretary greets every guest by name. Melissa Ong. She greets you by yours, and does not offer her hand.
2333wh77ttv.en: At the door the Office of the Chairman's new secretary greets every guest by name. Melissa Ong. She greets you by yours, and does not offer her hand.

18419s81kyc.speaker: Narrator
18419s81kyc.text: On every table, a card from the Office of the Chairman in a secretary's copperplate. Vivian Chua writes them from Singapore now, Farah says, and they come up by courier.
18419s81kyc.en: On every table, a card from the Office of the Chairman in a secretary's copperplate. Vivian Chua writes them from Singapore now, Farah says, and they come up by courier.

0rbndan9atb.speaker: Narrator
0rbndan9atb.text: In the press pen, behind a velvet rope, a young woman with a camera she has been told not to raise: Nurul Ain, whose father fell from the floor below.
0rbndan9atb.en: In the press pen, behind a velvet rope, a young woman with a camera she has been told not to raise: Nurul Ain, whose father fell from the floor below.

1evlgfqf45w.speaker: Narrator
1evlgfqf45w.text: An old man in a white shirt, with a staff badge that has no name on it, sets a glass of teh tarik in front of you. Nobody at table six ordered it. It is made exactly the way Bala Anne makes it.
1evlgfqf45w.en: An old man in a white shirt, with a staff badge that has no name on it, sets a glass of teh tarik in front of you. Nobody at table six ordered it. It is made exactly the way Bala Anne makes it.

1fh7eajft3t.speaker: Muthu
1fh7eajft3t.text: Thambi. Vilakku anainjadhum, thiraikku pinnaadi paaru.
1fh7eajft3t.en: Boy. When the lights go out, look behind the screen.
1fh7eajft3t.tts: தம்பி. விளக்கு அணைஞ்சதும், திரைக்குப் பின்னாடி பாரு.

dir.say: [very soft, an old man's whisper, urgent and kind] தம்பி. [break] விளக்கு அணைஞ்சதும், [break] திரைக்குப் பின்னாடி பாரு.
[gentle, tired, a small sad smile] பாலா கிட்ட சொல்லு, [break] முத்து வந்தான்னு.

1mte2157sqy.speaker: Narrator
1mte2157sqy.text: Then he is gone through a service door beside the screen, hands behind his back, like a man who has walked through it all his life.
1mte2157sqy.en: Then he is gone through a service door beside the screen, hands behind his back, like a man who has walked through it all his life.

1c4wx78mwhs.speaker: Tan Sri Azhar
1c4wx78mwhs.text: Ladies and gentlemen. For the fortieth time: the man who made Sinar.
1c4wx78mwhs.en: Ladies and gentlemen. For the fortieth time: the man who made Sinar.

dir.say: [polished, grand, a practised master of ceremonies] Ladies and gentlemen. [break] [reverent] For the fortieth time: [break] the man who made Sinar.

1nddubix2wx.speaker: Narrator
1nddubix2wx.text: The room goes dark, and the screen lights from behind. On the silk, the shadow of a man in a high-backed chair, a cigarette in his hand.
1nddubix2wx.en: The room goes dark, and the screen lights from behind. On the silk, the shadow of a man in a high-backed chair, a cigarette in his hand.

2adf70r1syw.speaker: The Chairman
2adf70r1syw.text: Forty years ago I had one lorry, a yard in the oil palm under Bukit Jugra, and a sun painted on the gate. I have the gate still.
2adf70r1syw.en: Forty years ago I had one lorry, a yard in the oil palm under Bukit Jugra, and a sun painted on the gate. I have the gate still.

dir.say: [calm, unhurried, warm and courteous, utterly cold underneath] Forty years ago I had one lorry, [break] a yard in the oil palm under Bukit Jugra, [break] and a sun painted on the gate. [long-break] [softly] I have the gate still.

1rvys934ki4.speaker: The Chairman
1rvys934ki4.text: And at table six, a detective I have watched for ten years. Good evening, detective. You came. I knew you would be listening.
1rvys934ki4.en: And at table six, a detective I have watched for ten years. Good evening, detective. You came. I knew you would be listening.

dir.say: [calm, intimate, amused, speaking to one person in a crowded room] And at table six, a detective I have watched for ten years. [break] Good evening, detective. [break] You came. [long-break] [softly] I knew you would be listening.

0i2wsoeynay.speaker: Narrator
0i2wsoeynay.text: Three hundred people turn to look at you. On the silk the shadow lifts a lighter, and the flame comes up a beat after the snap, as if the hand were waiting to hear it.
0i2wsoeynay.en: Three hundred people turn to look at you. On the silk the shadow lifts a lighter, and the flame comes up a beat after the snap, as if the hand were waiting to hear it.

06zooufhvmp.speaker: The Chairman
06zooufhvmp.text: Empat puluh tahun. Empat puluh saat.

dir.say: [slow, ceremonial, quiet finality] Empat puluh tahun. [long-break] Empat puluh saat.

0r90bqqg58o.speaker: Narrator
0r90bqqg58o.text: Every light on Level 15 goes out at once: forty seconds of dark, one for each year. Three hundred people hold their breath, because that is what they were told to do.
0r90bqqg58o.en: Every light on Level 15 goes out at once: forty seconds of dark, one for each year. Three hundred people hold their breath, because that is what they were told to do.

25riblnit60.speaker: Narrator
25riblnit60.text: You are already walking, the way the old man asked, between the tables, toward the edge of the screen.
25riblnit60.en: You are already walking, the way the old man asked, between the tables, toward the edge of the screen.

2day707jhy6.speaker: Narrator
2day707jhy6.text: Two metres from the silk you hear a chair creak, and a sound like somebody breathing through a straw. Then a hand closes on your arm.
2day707jhy6.en: Two metres from the silk you hear a chair creak, and a sound like somebody breathing through a straw. Then a hand closes on your arm.

dir.say: [whispering, frightened] Two metres from the silk you hear a chair creak, [break] and a sound like somebody breathing through a straw. [long-break] [sharp] Then a hand closes on your arm.

1bnk3z3ujex.speaker: Bishnu Thapa
1bnk3z3ujex.text: Sorry, boss. Nobody goes behind the screen. Nobody.
1bnk3z3ujex.en: Sorry, boss. Nobody goes behind the screen. Nobody.

2g8rwndkvru.speaker: Narrator
2g8rwndkvru.text: The lights come up. The screen is white and empty. Three hundred people applaud. You go back to table six, and your teh has gone cold.
2g8rwndkvru.en: The lights come up. The screen is white and empty. Three hundred people applaud. You go back to table six, and your teh has gone cold.

0o05kupzadi.speaker: Narrator
0o05kupzadi.text: At fourteen minutes past ten Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin goes behind the screen, as he has every year since 1997, to thank an empty chair.
0o05kupzadi.en: At fourteen minutes past ten Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin goes behind the screen, as he has every year since 1997, to thank an empty chair.

0med27l7cma.speaker: Narrator
0med27l7cma.text: Three hundred telephones say it before he has finished: the Chairman of Sinar Holdings is dead.
0med27l7cma.en: Three hundred telephones say it before he has finished: the Chairman of Sinar Holdings is dead.

2evivs3ykrh.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2evivs3ykrh.text: Lifts off. Stairs shut. Nobody leaves this floor until I say so, Tan Sri. Not even you.
2evivs3ykrh.en: Lifts off. Stairs shut. Nobody leaves this floor until I say so, Tan Sri. Not even you.

2gazget7udz.speaker: Narrator
2gazget7udz.text: In the high-backed chair behind the silk, his head fallen to one side and a cigarette burnt down to the filter between his fingers, sits the old man who brought you your teh.
2gazget7udz.en: In the high-backed chair behind the silk, his head fallen to one side and a cigarette burnt down to the filter between his fingers, sits the old man who brought you your teh.

04c8xesjo1l.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
04c8xesjo1l.text: Three hundred people watched this man give a speech. He has no microphone. He has no earpiece. He has a staff badge with no name on it.
04c8xesjo1l.en: Three hundred people watched this man give a speech. He has no microphone. He has no earpiece. He has a staff badge with no name on it.

15spcc4x0ux.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
15spcc4x0ux.text: Whoever was talking to us tonight, it was not him.
15spcc4x0ux.en: Whoever was talking to us tonight, it was not him.

23wt13hm72z.speaker: Narrator
23wt13hm72z.text: His wallet says Muthusamy a/l Perumal, seventy-one, Jalan Thambapillay, Brickfields. Two streets from your office.
23wt13hm72z.en: His wallet says Muthusamy a/l Perumal, seventy-one, Jalan Thambapillay, Brickfields. Two streets from your office.

000mxoc4tr3.speaker: Narrator
000mxoc4tr3.text: At two minutes past eleven Sinar Holdings tells the press that the Chairman is well, and thanks his guests for a memorable evening.
000mxoc4tr3.en: At two minutes past eleven Sinar Holdings tells the press that the Chairman is well, and thanks his guests for a memorable evening.

111ytbozlfs.speaker: Narrator
111ytbozlfs.text: Hamidah Yusof reads the file twice and writes no charge against the man at the desk. "Bring me the man at the desk," she says, "and I will bring you the man on the telephone."
111ytbozlfs.en: Hamidah Yusof reads the file twice and writes no charge against the man at the desk. "Bring me the man at the desk," she says, "and I will bring you the man on the telephone."

0nhp0gi2atj.speaker: Narrator
0nhp0gi2atj.text: She reads "behind the screen", and crosses it out. "The man behind the screen is in the mortuary, detective."
0nhp0gi2atj.en: She reads "behind the screen", and crosses it out. "The man behind the screen is in the mortuary, detective."

0kj0fqw6xqf.speaker: Narrator
0kj0fqw6xqf.text: Under "and abetment by", the line stays blank, as it has stayed blank for three cases.
0kj0fqw6xqf.en: Under "and abetment by", the line stays blank, as it has stayed blank for three cases.

1qrhbzk0u10.speaker: Narrator
