1qrhbzk0u10.text: At Subang, customs clears a Sinar jet to Seletar at 7:15 on Sunday morning. One passenger, name withheld. Officer: N. SALLEH.
1qrhbzk0u10.en: At Subang, customs clears a Sinar jet to Seletar at 7:15 on Sunday morning. One passenger, name withheld. Officer: N. SALLEH.

1fpsy15m6g0.speaker: Narrator
1fpsy15m6g0.text: Farah's constable at Chow Kit saw the driver of the black car for two seconds: an older Chinese man in a white shirt, with a jade bangle on his wrist.
1fpsy15m6g0.en: Farah's constable at Chow Kit saw the driver of the black car for two seconds: an older Chinese man in a white shirt, with a jade bangle on his wrist.

1jc7t1xfkip.speaker: Narrator
1jc7t1xfkip.text: Farah's constable at Chow Kit saw the driver of the black car for two seconds: a Sri Lankan face, and four old scratches on his forearm.
1jc7t1xfkip.en: Farah's constable at Chow Kit saw the driver of the black car for two seconds: a Sri Lankan face, and four old scratches on his forearm.

20iarmf76qb.speaker: Narrator
20iarmf76qb.text: Rizal Hamdan resigns from Kawalan Sentosa on Monday by text message, and his telephone is switched off by lunchtime.
20iarmf76qb.en: Rizal Hamdan resigns from Kawalan Sentosa on Monday by text message, and his telephone is switched off by lunchtime.

1qow0j9diei.speaker: Narrator
1qow0j9diei.text: Workmen take the screen down panel by panel and roll the silk round cardboard tubes. The high-backed chair stays where it is, because nobody has been told what to do with it.
1qow0j9diei.en: Workmen take the screen down panel by panel and roll the silk round cardboard tubes. The high-backed chair stays where it is, because nobody has been told what to do with it.

1zuzebimb1x.speaker: Narrator
1zuzebimb1x.text: Sinar Holdings tells Bursa Malaysia that its Chairman is in good health and will not be taking questions. The share price closes up four sen.
1zuzebimb1x.en: Sinar Holdings tells Bursa Malaysia that its Chairman is in good health and will not be taking questions. The share price closes up four sen.

03lw9dvg4s0.speaker: Narrator
03lw9dvg4s0.text: Tan Sri Azhar's office on Level 15 is empty by noon. His succession memo is on the board's agenda on Thursday, under somebody else's initials.
03lw9dvg4s0.en: Tan Sri Azhar's office on Level 15 is empty by noon. His succession memo is on the board's agenda on Thursday, under somebody else's initials.

1zfqd5oauuo.speaker: Narrator
1zfqd5oauuo.text: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin chairs Monday's board meeting from the chair at the head of the table. It is noticed that he does not lean back in it.
1zfqd5oauuo.en: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin chairs Monday's board meeting from the chair at the head of the table. It is noticed that he does not lean back in it.

0qfzluj4ggl.speaker: Narrator
0qfzluj4ggl.text: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam hands Farah the file marked TUAN herself, and closes her clinic for a week. She says she will never again examine a patient whose name she does not know.
0qfzluj4ggl.en: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam hands Farah the file marked TUAN herself, and closes her clinic for a week. She says she will never again examine a patient whose name she does not know.

1vwl67svoc2.speaker: Narrator
1vwl67svoc2.text: The Malaysian Medical Council suspends Dr. Meera Rajaratnam. Her patients receive a letter. The old man with the bad heart keeps taking his tablets.
1vwl67svoc2.en: The Malaysian Medical Council suspends Dr. Meera Rajaratnam. Her patients receive a letter. The old man with the bad heart keeps taking his tablets.

1011kvlmn6l.speaker: Narrator
1011kvlmn6l.text: Desmond Yap goes back to work on Monday. On Wednesday morning the attendants find his car in Bay V1 on Basement 2 with the engine running and a hose from the exhaust. Dang Wangi call it a suicide. His headset is round his neck.
1011kvlmn6l.en: Desmond Yap goes back to work on Monday. On Wednesday morning the attendants find his car in Bay V1 on Basement 2 with the engine running and a hose from the exhaust. Dang Wangi call it a suicide. His headset is round his neck.

dir.say: [flat, cold] Desmond Yap goes back to work on Monday. [break] On Wednesday morning the attendants find his car in Bay V one on Basement two, with the engine running and a hose from the exhaust. [break] Dang Wangi call it a suicide. [long-break] [quiet] His headset is round his neck.

225z0by42bz.speaker: Narrator
225z0by42bz.text: Kamal Ariffin flies in from Colombo for the dinner and is seen at table twenty-eight in a borrowed suit. He flies back on Sunday before anybody thinks to ask him why.
225z0by42bz.en: Kamal Ariffin flies in from Colombo for the dinner and is seen at table twenty-eight in a borrowed suit. He flies back on Sunday before anybody thinks to ask him why.

0zvs1akunjd.speaker: Narrator
0zvs1akunjd.text: You tell Daniel about the old man with the teh, and the chair, and the forty seconds, and the dockets in Bala Anne's shoebox.
0zvs1akunjd.en: You tell Daniel about the old man with the teh, and the chair, and the forty seconds, and the dockets in Bala Anne's shoebox.

2b3be3dr21c.speaker: Daniel Raj
2b3be3dr21c.text: Table seven. August 2016. The old man in the white shirt who paid for our teh. That was Muthu?
2b3be3dr21c.en: Table seven. August 2016. The old man in the white shirt who paid for our teh. That was Muthu?

dir.say: [slow, stunned, remembering] Table seven. [break] August 2016. [break] The old man in the white shirt who paid for our teh. [long-break] [disbelieving] That was Muthu?

05ysbkew37e.speaker: Daniel Raj
05ysbkew37e.text: Ten years I have been sure of one thing, machan: that I had seen him once. I never saw him at all.
05ysbkew37e.en: Ten years I have been sure of one thing, machan: that I had seen him once. I never saw him at all.

dir.say: [quiet, shaken, rueful] Ten years I have been sure of one thing, machan: [break] that I had seen him once. [long-break] [whispering] I never saw him at all.

24ef3tqzm3x.speaker: Narrator
24ef3tqzm3x.text: He folds a kancil out of the gala's menu card while he talks, and does not seem to know he is doing it.
24ef3tqzm3x.en: He folds a kancil out of the gala's menu card while he talks, and does not seem to know he is doing it.

1ncmbghd1vf.speaker: Narrator
1ncmbghd1vf.text: Through the glass you tell Daniel about the old man with the teh, and the chair, and the forty seconds.
1ncmbghd1vf.en: Through the glass you tell Daniel about the old man with the teh, and the chair, and the forty seconds.

1nxz7uiodv9.speaker: Daniel Raj
1nxz7uiodv9.text: Then I have never seen him, machan. Not once. And he has seen me every day for ten years.
1nxz7uiodv9.en: Then I have never seen him, machan. Not once. And he has seen me every day for ten years.

dir.say: [quiet, cold dawning fear] Then I have never seen him, machan. [break] Not once. [long-break] And he has seen me every day for ten years.

19irf3wz3rw.speaker: Narrator
19irf3wz3rw.text: His trial has been moved to March, on an application signed by a superintendent at Bukit Aman.
19irf3wz3rw.en: His trial has been moved to March, on an application signed by a superintendent at Bukit Aman.

1w2asyqtngw.speaker: Narrator
1w2asyqtngw.text: Wherever the black car went after Chow Kit, it went with Daniel in the back of it.
1w2asyqtngw.en: Wherever the black car went after Chow Kit, it went with Daniel in the back of it.

1bfqfiia387.speaker: Narrator
1bfqfiia387.text: At midnight something slides under your office door: a kancil folded from a gala menu card, its gold border on the outside. Pricked along one fold with a pin: MASIH HIDUP. Still alive.
1bfqfiia387.en: At midnight something slides under your office door: a kancil folded from a gala menu card, its gold border on the outside. Pricked along one fold with a pin: MASIH HIDUP. Still alive.

dir.say: [hushed, tense, then a breath of relief] At midnight something slides under your office door: [break] a kancil folded from a gala menu card, its gold border on the outside. [break] Pricked along one fold with a pin: [long-break] masih hidup. [break] [soft] Still alive.

0qx3fn5ct9c.speaker: Narrator
0qx3fn5ct9c.text: He has been in the same car as the man. He has sat beside him in the dark. Whether he has seen his face, the kancil does not say.
0qx3fn5ct9c.en: He has been in the same car as the man. He has sat beside him in the dark. Whether he has seen his face, the kancil does not say.

0ljedlnjryu.speaker: Narrator
0ljedlnjryu.text: Ain lays her photograph on Mak Teh's table between two glasses of teh: an old man in a white shirt, lit from below, his mouth shut, while three hundred people heard him speak.
0ljedlnjryu.en: Ain lays her photograph on Mak Teh's table between two glasses of teh: an old man in a white shirt, lit from below, his mouth shut, while three hundred people heard him speak.

25jqj0zmb1u.speaker: Nurul Ain
25jqj0zmb1u.text: You let the man at the desk walk out of that building. He was three metres from my lens with his hand on his headset, and his lips were moving.
25jqj0zmb1u.en: You let the man at the desk walk out of that building. He was three metres from my lens with his hand on his headset, and his lips were moving.

1cfv9o1okx7.speaker: Narrator
1cfv9o1okx7.text: Muthu has no family left, so Bala Anne walks in front with the fire pot, barefoot, in a white veshti, the way a son would.
1cfv9o1okx7.en: Muthu has no family left, so Bala Anne walks in front with the fire pot, barefoot, in a white veshti, the way a son would.

1bu2ut5zmt2.speaker: Narrator
1bu2ut5zmt2.text: Two hundred men in white shirts stand in the heat. Drivers, mostly. Half of Brickfields knew him, and not one of them knew who he drove for.
1bu2ut5zmt2.en: Two hundred men in white shirts stand in the heat. Drivers, mostly. Half of Brickfields knew him, and not one of them knew who he drove for.

dir.say: [low, grieving, steady] முத்து [break] நல்ல மனுஷன்.

1frj1jprhz0.speaker: Narrator
1frj1jprhz0.text: Across the road in the Cheras cemetery, a headstone that said Daniel Raj for five years says Ong Wei Jie now.
1frj1jprhz0.en: Across the road in the Cheras cemetery, a headstone that said Daniel Raj for five years says Ong Wei Jie now.

02dkzitczd8.speaker: Narrator
02dkzitczd8.text: You smell the cigarette before you feel the hand. It settles on your right shoulder, light, in a white cuff, the way a man rests his hand on an old friend.
02dkzitczd8.en: You smell the cigarette before you feel the hand. It settles on your right shoulder, light, in a white cuff, the way a man rests his hand on an old friend.

dir.say: [whispering, very still, dread] You smell the cigarette before you feel the hand. [break] It settles on your right shoulder, light, in a white cuff, [break] the way a man rests his hand on an old friend.
[close to the ear, calm, almost tender, utterly cold underneath] Jangan tengok belakang, [break] detektif.

1hkpbusjrv2.speaker: The Chairman
1hkpbusjrv2.text: That is what your partner said to you in the fire. I was close enough to hear it.
1hkpbusjrv2.en: That is what your partner said to you in the fire. I was close enough to hear it.

dir.say: [close, quiet, courteous, amused] That is what your partner said to you in the fire. [break] [softly] I was close enough to hear it.

1uateshm825.speaker: The Chairman
1uateshm825.text: Muthu drove me for forty years and never once looked in the mirror. I need a new driver.
1uateshm825.en: Muthu drove me for forty years and never once looked in the mirror. I need a new driver.

dir.say: [close, unhurried, warm and courteous, utterly cold underneath] Muthu drove me for forty years and never once looked in the mirror. [long-break] I need a new driver.

1hzqkxrbny1.speaker: The Chairman
1hzqkxrbny1.text: The first of December. Ten past two. Outside Restoran Bala. You may look in the mirror as often as you like.
1hzqkxrbny1.en: The first of December. Ten past two. Outside Restoran Bala. You may look in the mirror as often as you like.

dir.say: [quiet, precise, an invitation that is an order] The first of December. [break] Ten past two. [break] Outside Restoran Bala. [long-break] [softly, amused] You may look in the mirror as often as you like.

18ljz2rwqvf.speaker: Narrator
18ljz2rwqvf.text: A lid snaps open by your ear, and shut. The hand lifts. When you turn round there are two hundred men in white shirts, and one of them is walking away, and you will never know which.
18ljz2rwqvf.en: A lid snaps open by your ear, and shut. The hand lifts. When you turn round there are two hundred men in white shirts, and one of them is walking away, and you will never know which.

dir.say: [whispering, shaken] A lid snaps open by your ear, [break] and shut. [break] The hand lifts. [long-break] When you turn round there are two hundred men in white shirts, [break] and one of them is walking away, [break] [flat] and you will never know which.

143do682873.speaker: Narrator
143do682873.text: In your jacket pocket, where his hand was, a car key on a ring with a small brass sun.
143do682873.en: In your jacket pocket, where his hand was, a car key on a ring with a small brass sun.

0er11ml1fty.speaker: Narrator
0er11ml1fty.text: Rosli breaks his own Bomba seal on Level 14 for a second look, and finds his own dust again. By noon Sinar's lawyers have the broken seal in a letter to DBKL.
0er11ml1fty.en: Rosli breaks his own Bomba seal on Level 14 for a second look, and finds his own dust again. By noon Sinar's lawyers have the broken seal in a letter to DBKL.

0fryg4wwztg.speaker: Narrator
0fryg4wwztg.text: Under it, "and abetment by", and for the first time in three cases she writes something after it: a person unknown, the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986, in a vehicle without registration plates, in Bay V1, Basement 2, Menara Sinar, at 9:51 PM.
0fryg4wwztg.en: Under it, "and abetment by", and for the first time in three cases she writes something after it: a person unknown, the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986, in a vehicle without registration plates, in Bay V1, Basement 2, Menara Sinar, at 9:51 PM.

dir.say: [slow, deliberate, quiet triumph held down] Under it, "and abetment by", and for the first time in three cases she writes something after it: [break] a person unknown, the user of prepaid line zero one one, two six zero four, one nine eight six, [break] in a vehicle without registration plates, in Bay V one, Basement two, Menara Sinar, [break] at nine fifty-one PM.

0ly2vvct271.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0ly2vvct271.text: It is not a name. It is a place, a time and a telephone. In this country men have gone to prison on less. Not men like him. Not yet.
0ly2vvct271.en: It is not a name. It is a place, a time and a telephone. In this country men have gone to prison on less. Not men like him. Not yet.

dir.say: [low, hard, tired] It is not a name. [break] It is a place, a time and a telephone. [break] In this country men have gone to prison on less. [long-break] [quiet] Not men like him. [break] Not yet.

1dabjzdf4bb.speaker: Narrator
1dabjzdf4bb.text: Sinar's studio in Damansara hands over its recordings of every Chairman's speech, very politely. None of them has last night on it, and none of them says "sekarang".
1dabjzdf4bb.en: Sinar's studio in Damansara hands over its recordings of every Chairman's speech, very politely. None of them has last night on it, and none of them says "sekarang".

0q0rjh6dxq6.speaker: Narrator
0q0rjh6dxq6.text: Nobody tells her where he was sitting.
0q0rjh6dxq6.en: Nobody tells her where he was sitting.

1lxo4ghabm8.speaker: Narrator
1lxo4ghabm8.text: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights in front of two photographers who were told exactly where to stand. By noon Sinar Holdings has a new Group Managing Director, and its share price has gone up.
1lxo4ghabm8.en: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights in front of two photographers who were told exactly where to stand. By noon Sinar Holdings has a new Group Managing Director, and its share price has gone up.

1enlyy7de90.speaker: Narrator
1enlyy7de90.text: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam is arrested at her clinic on Jalan Kia Peng between two patients. She asks Farah to tell the second one, an old man with a bad heart, that she is sorry, and that he must keep taking his tablets.
1enlyy7de90.en: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam is arrested at her clinic on Jalan Kia Peng between two patients. She asks Farah to tell the second one, an old man with a bad heart, that she is sorry, and that he must keep taking his tablets.

17ifz8pj6cb.speaker: Narrator
17ifz8pj6cb.text: Desmond Yap is charged on Monday morning in the magistrates' court on Jalan Duta. He asks for his headset back, and when they say no, he holds one hand over his right ear for the whole hearing, as if somebody might still speak into it.
17ifz8pj6cb.en: Desmond Yap is charged on Monday morning in the magistrates' court on Jalan Duta. He asks for his headset back, and when they say no, he holds one hand over his right ear for the whole hearing, as if somebody might still speak into it.

dir.say: [clipped, formal, then uneasy] Desmond Yap is charged on Monday morning in the magistrates' court on Jalan Duta. [break] He asks for his headset back, and when they say no, [break] [quiet] he holds one hand over his right ear for the whole hearing, as if somebody might still speak into it.

2gn6jo3pnq9.speaker: Narrator
2gn6jo3pnq9.text: Hamidah Yusof writes the charge against Desmond Yap herself: Section 302, murder.
2gn6jo3pnq9.en: Hamidah Yusof writes the charge against Desmond Yap herself: Section 302, murder.

1i1npmzj8mn.speaker: Nurul Ain
1i1npmzj8mn.text: The first photograph of the man behind the screen since 1997, and it is the wrong man. My editor wants it on the front page as the Chairman. I am going to put his real name under it. Muthusamy Perumal. Somebody should.
1i1npmzj8mn.en: The first photograph of the man behind the screen since 1997, and it is the wrong man. My editor wants it on the front page as the Chairman. I am going to put his real name under it. Muthusamy Perumal. Somebody should.

dir.say: [tired, fierce, grief steadied into purpose] The first photograph of the man behind the screen since 1997, [break] and it is the wrong man. [break] My editor wants it on the front page as the Chairman. [break] I am going to put his real name under it. [long-break] [firm] Muthusamy Perumal. [break] Somebody should.

0t35gz6dtoa.speaker: Narrator
0t35gz6dtoa.text: Nurul Ain is charged with murder in the same courthouse that heard her father's inquest. She has no camera. She asks the press on the steps to take her photograph, so that somebody does.
0t35gz6dtoa.en: Nurul Ain is charged with murder in the same courthouse that heard her father's inquest. She has no camera. She asks the press on the steps to take her photograph, so that somebody does.

28saf1tppjv.speaker: Narrator
28saf1tppjv.text: Ain's photograph is in a Dang Wangi evidence bag. Mak Teh has a print of it pinned behind her counter, where the calendar used to be, and tells anybody who asks that it is her uncle.
28saf1tppjv.en: Ain's photograph is in a Dang Wangi evidence bag. Mak Teh has a print of it pinned behind her counter, where the calendar used to be, and tells anybody who asks that it is her uncle.

0k81yq81t1u.speaker: Nurul Ain
0k81yq81t1u.text: You got the man at the desk. You also got somebody who was never behind that screen in the dark. Abah would have asked which one of those the Chairman wanted.
0k81yq81t1u.en: You got the man at the desk. You also got somebody who was never behind that screen in the dark. Abah would have asked which one of those the Chairman wanted.

25pphat3rwd.speaker: Narrator
25pphat3rwd.text: Bala Anne will not pull the shutter. He has wiped the same table four times, and he has not looked at the clock once, which is how you know he has been looking at it all night.
25pphat3rwd.en: Bala Anne will not pull the shutter. He has wiped the same table four times, and he has not looked at the clock once, which is how you know he has been looking at it all night.

1j0r2h7l1t7.speaker: Bala Anne
1j0r2h7l1t7.en: Boy. Don't get into that car.

dir.say: [low, grave, pleading] தம்பி. [break] அந்த கார்ல ஏற வேண்டாம்.

06itk5ng897.speaker: Narrator
06itk5ng897.text: Farah is at the counter in her jacket with her phone dead in her hand. It charges in the car, she says. She borrows Bala Anne's wall phone and rings her sergeant.
06itk5ng897.en: Farah is at the counter in her jacket with her phone dead in her hand. It charges in the car, she says. She borrows Bala Anne's wall phone and rings her sergeant.

00szusgpgj9.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
00szusgpgj9.text: Asri. Three cars behind, in my Waja. If he turns, I turn.
00szusgpgj9.en: Asri. Three cars behind, in my Waja. If he turns, I turn.

dir.say: [brisk, low, all business] Asri. [break] Three cars behind, in my Waja. [break] If he turns, I turn.

236sndo7e9a.speaker: Narrator
236sndo7e9a.text: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's appeal is listed for March. Bala Anne turns the sound down and leaves the picture on.
236sndo7e9a.en: On the television over the counter, Dr. Shanti Menon's appeal is listed for March. Bala Anne turns the sound down and leaves the picture on.

0j4zur6ztz5.speaker: Bala Anne
0j4zur6ztz5.text: That Ravi says if you are going for a drive, take him also. He wants to see a car with no number plate. I told him go and sell his durian.
0j4zur6ztz5.en: That Ravi says if you are going for a drive, take him also. He wants to see a car with no number plate. I told him go and sell his durian.

0vrybknwyzx.speaker: Narrator
0vrybknwyzx.text: A second postcard from Pandamaran beside the till, from Ah Fook: the bandages are off. His trial is in January.
0vrybknwyzx.en: A second postcard from Pandamaran beside the till, from Ah Fook: the bandages are off. His trial is in January.

1arhqj2tp6v.speaker: Narrator
1arhqj2tp6v.text: Puan Rohana has written again from Klang. Amirul has started to speak, she says, but only to the cat.
1arhqj2tp6v.en: Puan Rohana has written again from Klang. Amirul has started to speak, she says, but only to the cat.

11ccjg38mga.speaker: Narrator
11ccjg38mga.text: Ken Lim rang at ten to tell you Bobby Tan is selling phones on the third floor of Low Yat now, three shops from his, and waves at him every morning.
11ccjg38mga.en: Ken Lim rang at ten to tell you Bobby Tan is selling phones on the third floor of Low Yat now, three shops from his, and waves at him every morning.

19qwnqop6ky.speaker: Daniel Raj
19qwnqop6ky.text: Machan. Do not drink anything you did not order. And count his stops.
19qwnqop6ky.en: Machan. Do not drink anything you did not order. And count his stops.

dir.say: [on the phone, low, serious] Machan. [break] Do not drink anything you did not order. [break] [emphasis] And count his stops.

158f1wrt6at.speaker: Narrator
158f1wrt6at.text: Under the sugar jar, a letter from Sungai Buloh in Daniel's hand, folded into a kancil. Unfolded, it says only: Count his stops. Do not look back.
158f1wrt6at.en: Under the sugar jar, a letter from Sungai Buloh in Daniel's hand, folded into a kancil. Unfolded, it says only: Count his stops. Do not look back.

23x05baebb4.speaker: Narrator
23x05baebb4.text: Nothing from Daniel. Upstairs, in your drawer, the paper kancils that came under your door since August, one for every few weeks they have kept him.
23x05baebb4.en: Nothing from Daniel. Upstairs, in your drawer, the paper kancils that came under your door since August, one for every few weeks they have kept him.

23ui2ish6s3.speaker: Narrator
23ui2ish6s3.text: At ten to two Bala Anne pulls the shutter down to the pavement, and the light goes out behind it, and he does not come out again.
23ui2ish6s3.en: At ten to two Bala Anne pulls the shutter down to the pavement, and the light goes out behind it, and he does not come out again.

2fb36qx4q2e.speaker: Narrator
2fb36qx4q2e.text: Brickfields Road, the old men still call it. Tonight it is empty from the temple to the monorail: rain, a cat, and three shops down, a grey Proton Waja with its lights off and somebody sitting very still behind the wheel.
2fb36qx4q2e.en: Brickfields Road, the old men still call it. Tonight it is empty from the temple to the monorail: rain, a cat, and three shops down, a grey Proton Waja with its lights off and somebody sitting very still behind the wheel.

26hdvp2z98a.speaker: Narrator
26hdvp2z98a.text: A long black saloon comes up the street without a sound and stops at the kerb outside Restoran Bala. No plates. Engine running. The driver's door stands open, and the driver's seat is empty.
26hdvp2z98a.en: A long black saloon comes up the street without a sound and stops at the kerb outside Restoran Bala. No plates. Engine running. The driver's door stands open, and the driver's seat is empty.

dir.say: [hushed, tense] A long black saloon comes up the street without a sound and stops at the kerb outside Restoran Bala. [break] No plates. [break] Engine running. [break] The driver's door stands open, [break] and the driver's seat is empty.

0ejsv1qtp3a.speaker: Narrator
0ejsv1qtp3a.text: The back seat is not. Through the rain on the rear window, a shape: a man sitting very straight behind the driver's seat.
0ejsv1qtp3a.en: The back seat is not. Through the rain on the rear window, a shape: a man sitting very straight behind the driver's seat.

0c5cyl8e9a4.speaker: Narrator
0c5cyl8e9a4.text: In the rear-view mirror, on the left half of the back seat, a man with a cloth hood over his head and his hands tied in his lap. You know the shoulders.
0c5cyl8e9a4.en: In the rear-view mirror, on the left half of the back seat, a man with a cloth hood over his head and his hands tied in his lap. You know the shoulders.

dir.say: [hushed, shaken] In the rear-view mirror, on the left half of the back seat, a man with a cloth hood over his head and his hands tied in his lap. [long-break] [barely a whisper] You know the shoulders.

14syahcffkm.speaker: Narrator
14syahcffkm.text: You get in. The seat is warm, as if somebody has only just got out of it, or as if it has been kept warm for you.
14syahcffkm.en: You get in. The seat is warm, as if somebody has only just got out of it, or as if it has been kept warm for you.

1fxkqao86w2.speaker: Narrator
1fxkqao86w2.text: The rear-view mirror has been turned until it shows only the left half of the back seat. Whoever is behind you is sitting where it cannot see.
1fxkqao86w2.en: The rear-view mirror has been turned until it shows only the left half of the back seat. Whoever is behind you is sitting where it cannot see.

0glyzumoqqk.speaker: Narrator
0glyzumoqqk.text: A hand in a white cuff settles on your shoulder, light, the way it did at Cheras. Tobacco, and old hair oil.
0glyzumoqqk.en: A hand in a white cuff settles on your shoulder, light, the way it did at Cheras. Tobacco, and old hair oil.

0lmxnbeix0l.speaker: The Chairman
0lmxnbeix0l.text: Drive. Brickfields Road, then Birch Road. You will not need the mirror.
0lmxnbeix0l.en: Drive. Brickfields Road, then Birch Road. You will not need the mirror.

dir.say: [calm, close, unhurried] Drive. [break] Brickfields Road, then Birch Road. [break] You will not need the mirror.

27l8jhzrxhc.speaker: Narrator
27l8jhzrxhc.text: He calls Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman Batu Road, as if nobody had told him. Outside a shuttered shophouse with LEONG BROS. painted over the five-foot way, an old man stands at his door in a singlet, holding a parcel in brown paper.
27l8jhzrxhc.en: He calls Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman Batu Road, as if nobody had told him. Outside a shuttered shophouse with LEONG BROS. painted over the five-foot way, an old man stands at his door in a singlet, holding a parcel in brown paper.

0y3hg9pcext.speaker: Narrator
0y3hg9pcext.text: The rear left window goes down. A hand in a white cuff comes out of the dark of the car, takes the parcel, and goes back in. The old man does not bend to look.
0y3hg9pcext.en: The rear left window goes down. A hand in a white cuff comes out of the dark of the car, takes the parcel, and goes back in. The old man does not bend to look.

1q9ft87i88m.speaker: Leong Kam Wah
1q9ft87i88m.text: Tuan. Gin saam zou hou zo.

dir.say: [old, quiet, respectful] Tuan。[break] 件衫做好咗。

0b8v9kfupxy.speaker: The Chairman
0b8v9kfupxy.text: Mr. Leong has measured me in the dark since 1986. He has never asked for a light.
0b8v9kfupxy.en: Mr. Leong has measured me in the dark since 1986. He has never asked for a light.

dir.say: [calm, close, faintly amused] Mr. Leong has measured me in the dark since 1986. [break] He has never asked for a light.

1y902f6ji8r.speaker: Narrator
1y902f6ji8r.text: Four minutes, by the clock on the dashboard. Then: Mountbatten Road. Foch Avenue. Treacher Road. Streets that have not had those names since before you were at school.
1y902f6ji8r.en: Four minutes, by the clock on the dashboard. Then: Mountbatten Road. Foch Avenue. Treacher Road. Streets that have not had those names since before you were at school.

00krjsh6ywd.speaker: Narrator
00krjsh6ywd.text: The car slows, but does not stop, under Menara Sinar. A third of the way up, in the black band where a storey is not, one small lamp is burning.
00krjsh6ywd.en: The car slows, but does not stop, under Menara Sinar. A third of the way up, in the black band where a storey is not, one small lamp is burning.

2852alg9cr8.speaker: The Chairman
2852alg9cr8.text: Your prosecutor wrote my telephone number on a charge sheet. I have had it framed.
2852alg9cr8.en: Your prosecutor wrote my telephone number on a charge sheet. I have had it framed.

dir.say: [calm, dry, amused] Your prosecutor wrote my telephone number on a charge sheet. [break] I have had it framed.

2cxgqsgzvz9.speaker: Narrator
2cxgqsgzvz9.text: You are not here. Three cars back, Farah drives with her phone on its cable and one eye on the tail lights of a car with no plates.
2cxgqsgzvz9.en: You are not here. Three cars back, Farah drives with her phone on its cable and one eye on the tail lights of a car with no plates.

15cb04iowh6.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
15cb04iowh6.text: Asri. A black four-by-four with no lights is coming up on my left. If anything happens, it was not an accident.
15cb04iowh6.en: Asri. A black four-by-four with no lights is coming up on my left. If anything happens, it was not an accident.

dir.say: [on the phone, tense but steady] Asri. [break] A black four-by-four with no lights is coming up on my left. [break] [firm] If anything happens, it was not an accident.

15qrm12jfba.speaker: Narrator
15qrm12jfba.text: In her left mirror, coming up fast out of the dark of the slow lane, a shape with no lights at all.
15qrm12jfba.en: In her left mirror, coming up fast out of the dark of the slow lane, a shape with no lights at all.

0hzk3z4xy1v.speaker: Narrator
0hzk3z4xy1v.text: In your side mirror: headlights swerving, a shower of sparks, a car turning sideways into the concrete divider and spinning back across two lanes.
0hzk3z4xy1v.en: In your side mirror: headlights swerving, a shower of sparks, a car turning sideways into the concrete divider and spinning back across two lanes.

05f6caqppd9.speaker: Narrator
05f6caqppd9.text: Your foot comes off the pedal by itself.
05f6caqppd9.en: Your foot comes off the pedal by itself.

26vlcbxp1kx.speaker: The Chairman
26vlcbxp1kx.text: Do not stop. She will live. That was not mine.
26vlcbxp1kx.en: Do not stop. She will live. That was not mine.

dir.say: [calm, close, utterly unhurried] Do not stop. [break] She will live. [break] [quiet] That was not mine.

0taaedu4eqn.speaker: Narrator
0taaedu4eqn.text: You drive on. You will think about that for the rest of your life.
0taaedu4eqn.en: You drive on. You will think about that for the rest of your life.

dir.say: [hollow, quiet] You drive on. [long-break] [bitter, low] You will think about that for the rest of your life.

21ter0483a5.speaker: Narrator
21ter0483a5.text: The gate of Warehouse 6, the barrier down, the guard cabin dark. Behind you the lid snaps open and shut, and fresh smoke fills the car.
21ter0483a5.en: The gate of Warehouse 6, the barrier down, the guard cabin dark. Behind you the lid snaps open and shut, and fresh smoke fills the car.

1gqdd5bmtv3.speaker: The Chairman
1gqdd5bmtv3.text: Open your window. Look at Bay 3. I watched it burn twice.
1gqdd5bmtv3.en: Open your window. Look at Bay 3. I watched it burn twice.

dir.say: [calm, close, a little wistful] Open your window. [break] Look at Bay 3. [break] I watched it burn twice.

0c2kxurpe2d.speaker: Narrator
0c2kxurpe2d.text: You look. Bay 3 is a black shape against the cranes, roofless, the rain going straight in. Behind you, soft, the sound of a door, opened and shut again, the way it was at Batu Road when something was handed in.
0c2kxurpe2d.en: You look. Bay 3 is a black shape against the cranes, roofless, the rain going straight in. Behind you, soft, the sound of a door, opened and shut again, the way it was at Batu Road when something was handed in.

dir.say: [calm, slightly distant, as if over a telephone] Banting. [break] Then Jugra.

07x6zvdr1bg.speaker: Narrator
07x6zvdr1bg.text: Oil palm on both sides, black, and the road straight through it. The voice is a little thinner now, as if it were further away, though it has not moved.
07x6zvdr1bg.en: Oil palm on both sides, black, and the road straight through it. The voice is a little thinner now, as if it were further away, though it has not moved.

0dmz2o8pjbj.speaker: The Chairman
0dmz2o8pjbj.text: Forty years ago tonight I drove this road the other way, in a lorry with no lights.
0dmz2o8pjbj.en: Forty years ago tonight I drove this road the other way, in a lorry with no lights.

dir.say: [quiet, distant, remembering] Forty years ago tonight I drove this road the other way, [break] in a lorry with no lights.

1wies26t421.speaker: Narrator
1wies26t421.text: Then he hums. It takes you until Banting to place it: P. Ramlee, Getaran Jiwa. He hums it through twice, and stops in the same place both times.
1wies26t421.en: Then he hums. It takes you until Banting to place it: P. Ramlee, Getaran Jiwa. He hums it through twice, and stops in the same place both times.

050v4qg5s8t.speaker: Narrator
050v4qg5s8t.text: A gate in the oil palm under Bukit Jugra, and on the gate, faded almost to nothing, a sun painted in pink.
050v4qg5s8t.en: A gate in the oil palm under Bukit Jugra, and on the gate, faded almost to nothing, a sun painted in pink.

0uvj9uw9izx.speaker: The Chairman
0uvj9uw9izx.text: Thank you, detective. Wait until you hear the door. Then open the boot.
0uvj9uw9izx.en: Thank you, detective. Wait until you hear the door. Then open the boot.

dir.say: [calm, courteous, final] Thank you, detective. [break] Wait until you hear the door. [break] Then open the boot.

0cgi9xl3a6j.speaker: Narrator
0cgi9xl3a6j.text: The rear left door opens. A small sound of something taken off the seat.
0cgi9xl3a6j.en: The rear left door opens. A small sound of something taken off the seat.

0qeqcnvu7vj.speaker: Narrator
0qeqcnvu7vj.text: The door shuts. Flip-flops, slow, on laterite, going away. You count to ten, and then you look. The back seat is empty. In the rear ashtray, a cigarette burnt to the filter, cold.
0qeqcnvu7vj.en: The door shuts. Flip-flops, slow, on laterite, going away. You count to ten, and then you look. The back seat is empty. In the rear ashtray, a cigarette burnt to the filter, cold.

dir.say: [hushed] The door shuts. [break] Flip-flops, slow, on laterite, going away. [break] You count to ten, and then you look. [long-break] [flat] The back seat is empty. [break] In the rear ashtray, a cigarette burnt to the filter, cold.

20shreejtgh.speaker: Narrator
20shreejtgh.text: On the left of the seat Daniel sits with the hood in his lap and a cut cord beside him, blinking at the light.
20shreejtgh.en: On the left of the seat Daniel sits with the hood in his lap and a cut cord beside him, blinking at the light.

dir.cue: [hoarse, exhausted, a ghost of a smile]

1vigz3sbokj.speaker: Sjn. Asri
1vigz3sbokj.text: Puan Farah. Batu Tiga. The divider. She is alive.
1vigz3sbokj.en: Puan Farah. Batu Tiga. The divider. She is alive.

dir.say: [quiet, careful, tired] Puan Farah. [break] Batu Tiga. [break] The divider. [long-break] [relieved] She is alive.

02pab42vpp1.speaker: Narrator
02pab42vpp1.text: Hamidah Yusof waits at Bukit Aman until six with her flask and her pencil, and charges nobody. "A police officer in intensive care," she says, "and a blank sheet. I will remember this sheet."
02pab42vpp1.en: Hamidah Yusof waits at Bukit Aman until six with her flask and her pencil, and charges nobody. "A police officer in intensive care," she says, "and a blank sheet. I will remember this sheet."

028599pcolc.speaker: Narrator
028599pcolc.text: Nobody at Bukit Aman mentions Desmond Yap, found in Bay V1 a fortnight ago with a hose from his exhaust. Everybody thinks of him.
028599pcolc.en: Nobody at Bukit Aman mentions Desmond Yap, found in Bay V1 a fortnight ago with a hose from his exhaust. Everybody thinks of him.

256lpadf2j1.speaker: Narrator
256lpadf2j1.text: Farah is awake on Wednesday afternoon, propped up in a ward on the fourth floor with a brace on her left knee and three ribs taped, and the first thing she asks for is her warrant card.
256lpadf2j1.en: Farah is awake on Wednesday afternoon, propped up in a ward on the fourth floor with a brace on her left knee and three ribs taped, and the first thing she asks for is her warrant card.

0dw4lrqd1q3.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0dw4lrqd1q3.text: Somebody put me into that wall, and he is still out there driving. Three lengths behind somebody.
0dw4lrqd1q3.en: Somebody put me into that wall, and he is still out there driving. Three lengths behind somebody.

dir.say: [hoarse, angry, low] Somebody put me into that wall, and he is still out there driving. [break] [bitter] Three lengths behind somebody.

00cxlz8opp4.speaker: Narrator
00cxlz8opp4.text: On the locker, flowers with a card and no name: "Left shoulder, Inspector."
00cxlz8opp4.en: On the locker, flowers with a card and no name: "Left shoulder, Inspector."

142vql42sx5.speaker: Narrator
142vql42sx5.text: A basket of fruit from the Office of the Chairman, with a card in copperplate, posted in Singapore: with every good wish for the Inspector's recovery. Farah has it taken out of the room.
142vql42sx5.en: A basket of fruit from the Office of the Chairman, with a card in copperplate, posted in Singapore: with every good wish for the Inspector's recovery. Farah has it taken out of the room.

1iqvxeep4oq.speaker: Narrator
1iqvxeep4oq.text: A basket of fruit from the Office of the Chairman, the card initialled M.O. in Melissa Ong's small careful hand. Farah has it taken out of the room.
1iqvxeep4oq.en: A basket of fruit from the Office of the Chairman, the card initialled M.O. in Melissa Ong's small careful hand. Farah has it taken out of the room.

1v07oycxltg.speaker: Narrator
1v07oycxltg.text: At the door, as every day since Tuesday, Sergeant Asri, with two teh in a plastic bag and the newspapers under his arm.
1v07oycxltg.en: At the door, as every day since Tuesday, Sergeant Asri, with two teh in a plastic bag and the newspapers under his arm.

27j5wjg9gez.speaker: Narrator
27j5wjg9gez.text: Hamidah Yusof stands up in a courtroom she has stood up in a hundred times and withdraws the murder charges from Case 7: a discharge not amounting to acquittal, which means they can come back any morning she likes.
27j5wjg9gez.en: Hamidah Yusof stands up in a courtroom she has stood up in a hundred times and withdraws the murder charges from Case 7: a discharge not amounting to acquittal, which means they can come back any morning she likes.

29dc74tu3nw.speaker: Narrator
29dc74tu3nw.text: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin leaves by the side door, where a car is waiting with its engine running, and does not look at the photographers.
29dc74tu3nw.en: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin leaves by the side door, where a car is waiting with its engine running, and does not look at the photographers.

0hcp6jusb8k.speaker: Narrator
0hcp6jusb8k.text: Nurul Ain walks out of the front door and asks the press on the steps to photograph her, so that somebody does.
0hcp6jusb8k.en: Nurul Ain walks out of the front door and asks the press on the steps to photograph her, so that somebody does.

1uwifz6mcy1.speaker: Narrator
1uwifz6mcy1.text: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam is free to go. Her suspension by the Medical Council stays.
1uwifz6mcy1.en: Dr. Meera Rajaratnam is free to go. Her suspension by the Medical Council stays.

0774dir52oh.speaker: Narrator
0774dir52oh.text: Farah's men take Daniel to her safe house from Jugra, and he sleeps for nineteen hours in his clothes with every light in the house on.
0774dir52oh.en: Farah's men take Daniel to her safe house from Jugra, and he sleeps for nineteen hours in his clothes with every light in the house on.

12tg5313yot.speaker: Narrator
12tg5313yot.text: When he wakes he asks for a teh and a pen, and writes down every road the car took, in order, from memory, with his eyes shut. He was hooded the whole way. He gets every one right.
12tg5313yot.en: When he wakes he asks for a teh and a pen, and writes down every road the car took, in order, from memory, with his eyes shut. He was hooded the whole way. He gets every one right.

dir.say: [soft, wondering] When he wakes he asks for a teh and a pen, and writes down every road the car took, in order, from memory, with his eyes shut. [break] He was hooded the whole way. [break] [quiet pride] He gets every one right.

05gk35rivza.speaker: Narrator
05gk35rivza.text: The warrant for Dato' Rashid's murder is still open, and Farah cannot close it from a hospital bed. Her men drive Daniel from Jugra to Sungai Buloh with her jacket folded over his wrists, so nobody at the gate sees the cuffs.
05gk35rivza.en: The warrant for Dato' Rashid's murder is still open, and Farah cannot close it from a hospital bed. Her men drive Daniel from Jugra to Sungai Buloh with her jacket folded over his wrists, so nobody at the gate sees the cuffs.

0g4gspj6zdz.speaker: Narrator
0g4gspj6zdz.text: Hamidah has applied to withdraw the charge. The hearing is on the twenty-second.
0g4gspj6zdz.en: Hamidah has applied to withdraw the charge. The hearing is on the twenty-second.

1rr55lwf0fh.speaker: Narrator
1rr55lwf0fh.text: Daniel makes you count the stops again, on the back of a calendar, with his finger on each one: Batu Road, four minutes; Jalan Ampang, none; the gate of Warehouse 6, four minutes; Jugra.
1rr55lwf0fh.en: Daniel makes you count the stops again, on the back of a calendar, with his finger on each one: Batu Road, four minutes; Jalan Ampang, none; the gate of Warehouse 6, four minutes; Jugra.

1lz3mdmkxu3.speaker: Daniel Raj
1lz3mdmkxu3.text: Four minutes at Batu Road for a parcel, machan. Four minutes at a gate for nothing. Nobody waits four minutes for nothing.
1lz3mdmkxu3.en: Four minutes at Batu Road for a parcel, machan. Four minutes at a gate for nothing. Nobody waits four minutes for nothing.

dir.say: [thoughtful, insistent] Four minutes at Batu Road for a parcel, machan. [break] Four minutes at a gate for nothing. [break] [emphasis] Nobody waits four minutes for nothing.

198tmi0hw4d.speaker: Narrator
198tmi0hw4d.text: Through the glass you tell Daniel about the hand on your shoulder, and the tailor, and the lamp, and the wall.
198tmi0hw4d.en: Through the glass you tell Daniel about the hand on your shoulder, and the tailor, and the lamp, and the wall.

0rwlg55uwpm.speaker: Daniel Raj
0rwlg55uwpm.text: You did not look back. Good. One of us never has to.
0rwlg55uwpm.en: You did not look back. Good. One of us never has to.

dir.say: [soft, steady, sad] You did not look back. [break] Good. [long-break] One of us never has to.

1judm1vubxx.speaker: Narrator
1judm1vubxx.text: The records Hamidah asked for come back on Monday, stamped and empty: nothing at that place, at that minute, that anybody can find.
1judm1vubxx.en: The records Hamidah asked for come back on Monday, stamped and empty: nothing at that place, at that minute, that anybody can find.

1eu1d33tdcp.speaker: Narrator
1eu1d33tdcp.text: At Jugra the watchman's hut is padlocked, and the rice tin is gone.
1eu1d33tdcp.en: At Jugra the watchman's hut is padlocked, and the rice tin is gone.

1gx441fo1e9.speaker: Narrator
1gx441fo1e9.text: The plate goes to JPJ. BCK 210 was a Bedford lorry, registered in 1984 to one Teoh Ah Chuan of Jugra, and transferred on 3 December 1986 to Sinar Pengangkutan. The same week, a lien: "Sp.M.R.M. Chettiar, Melaka".
1gx441fo1e9.en: The plate goes to JPJ. BCK 210 was a Bedford lorry, registered in 1984 to one Teoh Ah Chuan of Jugra, and transferred on 3 December 1986 to Sinar Pengangkutan. The same week, a lien: "Sp.M.R.M. Chettiar, Melaka".

dir.say: [measured, quietly intent] The plate goes to JPJ. [break] B C K two one zero was a Bedford lorry, registered in 1984 to one Teoh Ah Chuan of Jugra, and transferred on the third of December 1986 to Sinar Pengangkutan. [break] The same week, a lien: [break] "Sp. M. R. M. Chettiar, Melaka".

0cd3iofc1p6.speaker: Narrator
0cd3iofc1p6.text: On the twenty-second Hamidah applies for an order to open whatever Sinar Pengangkutan keeps with that firm. The hearing is set for the twenty-eighth.
0cd3iofc1p6.en: On the twenty-second Hamidah applies for an order to open whatever Sinar Pengangkutan keeps with that firm. The hearing is set for the twenty-eighth.

1c2cst6y6uz.speaker: Narrator
1c2cst6y6uz.text: JPJ sends the plate back. It hangs on your office wall above the desk, with its small pink sun in the corner.
1c2cst6y6uz.en: JPJ sends the plate back. It hangs on your office wall above the desk, with its small pink sun in the corner.

0qgzpy0pz2j.speaker: Narrator
0qgzpy0pz2j.text: On Friday morning Jason Ooi's grey sedan is back in the drop-off lane at Menara Sinar, washed by hand.
0qgzpy0pz2j.en: On Friday morning Jason Ooi's grey sedan is back in the drop-off lane at Menara Sinar, washed by hand.

19tq0rl1amo.speaker: Narrator
19tq0rl1amo.text: The wall phone in Restoran Bala rings in the dark behind the shutter, and goes on ringing until you come down the back stairs. Bala Anne's shutter is down. Nobody else is downstairs.
19tq0rl1amo.en: The wall phone in Restoran Bala rings in the dark behind the shutter, and goes on ringing until you come down the back stairs. Bala Anne's shutter is down. Nobody else is downstairs.

1cdowk8cqnm.speaker: The Chairman
1cdowk8cqnm.text: You did not stop. Muthu would not have stopped either. Thank you, detective.
1cdowk8cqnm.en: You did not stop. Muthu would not have stopped either. Thank you, detective.

dir.say: [calm, close, almost warm] You did not stop. [break] Muthu would not have stopped either. [long-break] Thank you, detective.

0eujjdpwkdt.speaker: Narrator
0eujjdpwkdt.text: The dialling tone. Across the road, in the room above the sari shop, the chair is still turned to face the window.
0eujjdpwkdt.en: The dialling tone. Across the road, in the room above the sari shop, the chair is still turned to face the window.

01j1ot1otrc.speaker: Narrator
01j1ot1otrc.text: Hamidah's records for the gate of Warehouse 6 at 3:44 lead to one toll card, F-03's: Pulau Indah, the Kesas, the ELITE, the North-South Expressway south, and at 5:28 AM, Ayer Keroh, Melaka. Nobody knows why Melaka.
01j1ot1otrc.en: Hamidah's records for the gate of Warehouse 6 at 3:44 lead to one toll card, F-03's: Pulau Indah, the Kesas, the ELITE, the North-South Expressway south, and at 5:28 AM, Ayer Keroh, Melaka. Nobody knows why Melaka.

dir.say: [measured, quietly triumphant] Hamidah's records for the gate of Warehouse 6 at 3:44 lead to one toll card, F-zero-three's: [break] Pulau Indah, the Kesas, the ELITE, the North-South Expressway south, [break] and at 5:28 AM, Ayer Keroh, Melaka. [long-break] [puzzled] Nobody knows why Melaka.

2cw4bhdbqaq.speaker: Narrator
2cw4bhdbqaq.text: Murali Krishnan is charged. His prime mover is impounded, and his wife sells their thosai stall's second tawa to pay the lawyer.
2cw4bhdbqaq.en: Murali Krishnan is charged. His prime mover is impounded, and his wife sells their thosai stall's second tawa to pay the lawyer.

2e15e51m3xy.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2e15e51m3xy.text: You charged a man for what he saw in his mirror. Go and find what he did not see.
2e15e51m3xy.en: You charged a man for what he saw in his mirror. Go and find what he did not see.

dir.say: [tired, disappointed, cutting] You charged a man for what he saw in his mirror. [break] Go and find what he did not see.

0ei2u3m9ox4.speaker: Narrator
0ei2u3m9ox4.text: Kamarul Zaman is charged. The deputy minister's office says it has never heard of him.
0ei2u3m9ox4.en: Kamarul Zaman is charged. The deputy minister's office says it has never heard of him.

2492jqzwfh8.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2492jqzwfh8.text: You charged Kamarul for lying about where he slept. In this town that is not a crime. It is a career.
2492jqzwfh8.en: You charged Kamarul for lying about where he slept. In this town that is not a crime. It is a career.

dir.say: [dry, tired] You charged Kamarul for lying about where he slept. [break] In this town that is not a crime. [break] [wry] It is a career.

2fs5j3ic3lh.speaker: Narrator
2fs5j3ic3lh.text: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman by officers he trained. He asks whether Farah is awake, and does not seem to know which answer he wants.
2fs5j3ic3lh.en: Superintendent Khairul Anuar is arrested at Bukit Aman by officers he trained. He asks whether Farah is awake, and does not seem to know which answer he wants.

1d2t0jbjv7s.speaker: Narrator
1d2t0jbjv7s.text: Khairul Anuar, still suspended, is arrested at his house in Bangsar by officers he trained. He asks whether Farah is awake, and does not seem to know which answer he wants.
1d2t0jbjv7s.en: Khairul Anuar, still suspended, is arrested at his house in Bangsar by officers he trained. He asks whether Farah is awake, and does not seem to know which answer he wants.

2a9d0gtj4fq.speaker: Narrator
2a9d0gtj4fq.text: The three requests went out under his own login. It never crossed his mind that anybody reads the telco's bill.
2a9d0gtj4fq.en: The three requests went out under his own login. It never crossed his mind that anybody reads the telco's bill.

0dfcchs5h1x.speaker: Narrator
0dfcchs5h1x.text: The three requests went out under Kpl. Faridah Ismail's login, borrowed in October "for overtime claims". She reads about it in the Star, at her desk, and goes home sick.
0dfcchs5h1x.en: The three requests went out under Kpl. Faridah Ismail's login, borrowed in October "for overtime claims". She reads about it in the Star, at her desk, and goes home sick.

06i9rrr4lmm.speaker: Narrator
06i9rrr4lmm.text: Roslan Daud is arrested at Bengkel Seng Lee with grease to the elbows. He asks whether the Tuan has a new escort yet.
06i9rrr4lmm.en: Roslan Daud is arrested at Bengkel Seng Lee with grease to the elbows. He asks whether the Tuan has a new escort yet.

14tz5xgfat0.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
14tz5xgfat0.text: Khairul sent flowers. I gave them to the nurse with the worst cough.
14tz5xgfat0.en: Khairul sent flowers. I gave them to the nurse with the worst cough.

dir.say: [dry, deadpan, tired] Khairul sent flowers. [break] I gave them to the nurse with the worst cough.

1qya57x7qj2.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1qya57x7qj2.text: You did not stop. Good. If you had stopped, you would be his.
1qya57x7qj2.en: You did not stop. Good. If you had stopped, you would be his.

dir.say: [hoarse, quiet, fierce approval] You did not stop. [break] Good. [long-break] If you had stopped, you would be his.

1lkimkyklu2.speaker: Narrator
1lkimkyklu2.text: Christmas morning in Brickfields: the shutters down along Jalan Tun Sambanthan, a church bell somewhere behind the temple, and Bala Anne's wall phone ringing before the stove is lit.
1lkimkyklu2.en: Christmas morning in Brickfields: the shutters down along Jalan Tun Sambanthan, a church bell somewhere behind the temple, and Bala Anne's wall phone ringing before the stove is lit.

1xkwv27qs4g.speaker: Narrator
1xkwv27qs4g.text: Bala Anne holds the receiver out across the counter without a word. It is Hamidah Yusof, and she has not slept.
1xkwv27qs4g.en: Bala Anne holds the receiver out across the counter without a word. It is Hamidah Yusof, and she has not slept.

0tghpohzdm4.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
0tghpohzdm4.text: Box 14 is empty. They drilled one lock in a room full of gold.
0tghpohzdm4.en: Box 14 is empty. They drilled one lock in a room full of gold.

dir.say: [tired, crisp, controlled anger] Box 14 is empty. [break] They drilled one lock [emphasis] in a room full of gold.

19372g11hxm.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
19372g11hxm.text: The court was going to open it on Monday. Somebody could not wait for Monday.
19372g11hxm.en: The court was going to open it on Monday. Somebody could not wait for Monday.

0pokhokxu6t.speaker: Narrator
0pokhokxu6t.text: Daniel is already at your door with two teh in a plastic bag. Farah is waiting downstairs in a borrowed car that she cannot drive with that knee.
0pokhokxu6t.en: Daniel is already at your door with two teh in a plastic bag. Farah is waiting downstairs in a borrowed car that she cannot drive with that knee.

1c6un911bcz.speaker: Narrator
1c6un911bcz.text: He sleeps with the light on now, since the back seat of the black car. He says it is for the mosquitoes.
1c6un911bcz.en: He sleeps with the light on now, since the back seat of the black car. He says it is for the mosquitoes.

dir.say: [soft, careful] He sleeps with the light on now, since the back seat of the black car. [break] [faintly wry] He says it is for the mosquitoes.

0xxnxheiw1e.speaker: Daniel Raj
0xxnxheiw1e.text: They can bring the charge back any morning they like, machan. So this morning I am going to Melaka.
0xxnxheiw1e.en: They can bring the charge back any morning they like, machan. So this morning I am going to Melaka.

dir.say: [light, brave, a joke with an edge] They can bring the charge back any morning they like, machan. [break] So this morning I am going to Melaka.

1rchgvka61p.speaker: Daniel Raj
1rchgvka61p.text: A box that has waited thirty-nine years. I want to see it before the lawyers do.
1rchgvka61p.en: A box that has waited thirty-nine years. I want to see it before the lawyers do.

22w4su3c2o2.speaker: Narrator
22w4su3c2o2.text: You drive the borrowed car. Daniel folds a kancil out of the toll receipt in the passenger seat, and Farah sits in the back with her left knee in a brace, three ribs strapped and a walking stick across her lap.
22w4su3c2o2.en: You drive the borrowed car. Daniel folds a kancil out of the toll receipt in the passenger seat, and Farah sits in the back with her left knee in a brace, three ribs strapped and a walking stick across her lap.

04f32ci9ct0.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
04f32ci9ct0.text: I am on medical leave. I am not here.
04f32ci9ct0.en: I am on medical leave. I am not here.

dir.say: [deadpan, sore, stubborn] I am on medical leave. [break] I am not here.

1m073dv577p.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1m073dv577p.text: Asri is minding my desk at Bukit Aman. He rings every hour to ask whether I have taken my tablets. I have not.
1m073dv577p.en: Asri is minding my desk at Bukit Aman. He rings every hour to ask whether I have taken my tablets. I have not.

dir.say: [fond, dry] Asri is minding my desk at Bukit Aman. He rings every hour to ask whether I have taken my tablets. [break] [deadpan] I have not.

0wsibhiqy1j.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0wsibhiqy1j.text: Ayer Keroh, 5:28 AM, on the first. Now we know why Melaka.
0wsibhiqy1j.en: Ayer Keroh, 5:28 AM, on the first. Now we know why Melaka.

dir.say: [sharp, quiet satisfaction] Ayer Keroh, five twenty-eight AM, on the first. [break] Now we know why Melaka.

1huwryplc7u.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1huwryplc7u.text: Khairul rang Melaka Tengah last night. A Kuala Lumpur detective has no standing in Melaka, he told them, and an inspector on leave has less.
1huwryplc7u.en: Khairul rang Melaka Tengah last night. A Kuala Lumpur detective has no standing in Melaka, he told them, and an inspector on leave has less.

0nvq8qp4p35.speaker: Narrator
0nvq8qp4p35.text: Supt. Khairul Anuar is in Sungai Buloh on Hamidah's charge. For once, nobody has rung ahead to warn Melaka about you.
0nvq8qp4p35.en: Supt. Khairul Anuar is in Sungai Buloh on Hamidah's charge. For once, nobody has rung ahead to warn Melaka about you.

0czzu51rhnl.speaker: Narrator
0czzu51rhnl.text: A Chettiar firm house a hundred and fifty years old: whitewash, teak pillars, brass lamps, a long hall running back from the street to the river. Sinar Heritage has put a Christmas tree in the courtyard where the moneylenders' clerks once sat cross-legged over their ledgers.
0czzu51rhnl.en: A Chettiar firm house a hundred and fifty years old: whitewash, teak pillars, brass lamps, a long hall running back from the street to the river. Sinar Heritage has put a Christmas tree in the courtyard where the moneylenders' clerks once sat cross-legged over their ledgers.

16ivh5pg77s.speaker: Narrator
16ivh5pg77s.text: The general manager meets you at the door in a grey suit with a gold sunburst pin on the lapel, and greets you by name before Farah has shown anybody anything.
16ivh5pg77s.en: The general manager meets you at the door in a grey suit with a gold sunburst pin on the lapel, and greets you by name before Farah has shown anybody anything.

02w4l8tb2wc.speaker: Vanessa Low
02w4l8tb2wc.text: Welcome to The Kittangi. We have kept the iron room exactly as the police found it. Sinar Heritage will help in every way it can.
02w4l8tb2wc.en: Welcome to The Kittangi. We have kept the iron room exactly as the police found it. Sinar Heritage will help in every way it can.

dir.cue: [polished, warm hospitality voice, a little too smooth]

1a232finqc4.speaker: Narrator
1a232finqc4.text: On the reception desk, waiting for you, a card in copperplate from Singapore: "With the compliments of the season." No name.
1a232finqc4.en: On the reception desk, waiting for you, a card in copperplate from Singapore: "With the compliments of the season." No name.

0ggmiecvt34.speaker: Narrator
0ggmiecvt34.text: At the back of the house, behind a 1938 iron door as thick as your hand, a room the size of a lorry's cab, and in its walls forty-two small iron doors. Forty-one are shut. One hangs open, its lock drilled out, iron filings on the floor under it like black sugar.
0ggmiecvt34.en: At the back of the house, behind a 1938 iron door as thick as your hand, a room the size of a lorry's cab, and in its walls forty-two small iron doors. Forty-one are shut. One hangs open, its lock drilled out, iron filings on the floor under it like black sugar.

21gz6uwnpfh.speaker: Narrator
21gz6uwnpfh.text: Through the slots of the box beside it, Box 15, you can see gold: chains, bangles, a wedding thali on a red thread. Nobody has touched it.
21gz6uwnpfh.en: Through the slots of the box beside it, Box 15, you can see gold: chains, bangles, a wedding thali on a red thread. Nobody has touched it.

14a7hde71va.speaker: Narrator
14a7hde71va.text: Ram Chettiar stands at the iron door in a white veshti with a shirt over it, a ring of old iron keys turning in his fingers, and does not come in.
14a7hde71va.en: Ram Chettiar stands at the iron door in a white veshti with a shirt over it, a ring of old iron keys turning in his fingers, and does not come in.

1d5ybracsdi.speaker: Ram Chettiar
1d5ybracsdi.text: Thaathaa sonnaar: mugatha paakkaadhe, saaviya paaru.
1d5ybracsdi.en: Grandfather said: don't look at the face, look at the key.
1d5ybracsdi.tts: தாத்தா சொன்னார்: முகத்தைப் பாக்காதே, சாவியைப் பாரு.

dir.say: [soft, reverent, remembering] தாத்தா சொன்னார்: [break] முகத்தைப் பாக்காதே, [break] சாவியைப் பாரு.

0ivi8cmrp92.speaker: Ram Chettiar
0ivi8cmrp92.text: Forty-two boxes. In my grandfather's time a thief would have taken everything. This one took one box, and nobody alive knows what was in it.
0ivi8cmrp92.en: Forty-two boxes. In my grandfather's time a thief would have taken everything. This one took one box, and nobody alive knows what was in it.

0u0qnj0rprc.speaker: Narrator
0u0qnj0rprc.text: One short street: the bells of the Vinayagar temple, the call to prayer from the Kampung Kling mosque with its pagoda roof, and joss smoke drifting out of Cheng Hoon Teng, all at once, as they have for three hundred years.
0u0qnj0rprc.en: One short street: the bells of the Vinayagar temple, the call to prayer from the Kampung Kling mosque with its pagoda roof, and joss smoke drifting out of Cheng Hoon Teng, all at once, as they have for three hundred years.

dir.cue: [warm, unhurried, a street full of bells]

2420p3gziuj.speaker: Daniel Raj
2420p3gziuj.text: Machan. He kept a box for forty years, in a street where every god in Melaka lives next door.
2420p3gziuj.en: Machan. He kept a box for forty years, in a street where every god in Melaka lives next door.

0yax04jnr3g.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0yax04jnr3g.text: Then he chose the one street where nobody looks twice at a man who comes once a year.
0yax04jnr3g.en: Then he chose the one street where nobody looks twice at a man who comes once a year.

1tex809e356.speaker: Narrator
1tex809e356.text: Nobody is charged. Melaka Tengah writes "person or persons unknown" across the file, and the hotel puts its Christmas tree away.
1tex809e356.en: Nobody is charged. Melaka Tengah writes "person or persons unknown" across the file, and the hotel puts its Christmas tree away.

00ljswgujf2.speaker: Narrator
00ljswgujf2.text: Ram Chettiar closes the 1938 iron door on forty-one boxes and one empty one, and turns his grandfather's key twice.
00ljswgujf2.en: Ram Chettiar closes the 1938 iron door on forty-one boxes and one empty one, and turns his grandfather's key twice.

0ixqo7wimz3.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0ixqo7wimz3.text: The woman who switched the iron room off is laying out breakfast for a hundred and forty guests this morning, and she has asked whether we would like a table.
0ixqo7wimz3.en: The woman who switched the iron room off is laying out breakfast for a hundred and forty guests this morning, and she has asked whether we would like a table.

0u15493j8vn.speaker: Narrator
0u15493j8vn.text: A letter for Ram comes from Menara Sinar on Monday afternoon, signed M. Ong for the Office of the Chairman: Sinar Heritage still wishes to buy the iron room, as it stands.
0u15493j8vn.en: A letter for Ram comes from Menara Sinar on Monday afternoon, signed M. Ong for the Office of the Chairman: Sinar Heritage still wishes to buy the iron room, as it stands.

0su4jpchi6y.speaker: Narrator
0su4jpchi6y.text: A card in copperplate from Singapore comes to the iron room for Ram: the Office of the Chairman regrets the damage to Box 14, and will pay for a new lock.
0su4jpchi6y.en: A card in copperplate from Singapore comes to the iron room for Ram: the Office of the Chairman regrets the damage to Box 14, and will pay for a new lock.

19l2f7fysqq.speaker: Narrator
19l2f7fysqq.text: Melaka Tengah turns Melaka Sentral inside out: bay 9, the lost and found, every bin. The dry bag went north on Christmas morning. The note never went with it.
19l2f7fysqq.en: Melaka Tengah turns Melaka Sentral inside out: bay 9, the lost and found, every bin. The dry bag went north on Christmas morning. The note never went with it.

22ohavpyl0d.speaker: Narrator
22ohavpyl0d.text: On Tuesday the grille over the empty grave on St. Paul's Hill is found with a strip of tape on it, and nothing under the tape.
22ohavpyl0d.en: On Tuesday the grille over the empty grave on St. Paul's Hill is found with a strip of tape on it, and nothing under the tape.

dir.say: [quiet, bleak] On Tuesday the grille over the empty grave on St. Paul's Hill is found with a strip of tape on it, [break] and nothing under the tape.

1caytykbpsr.speaker: Narrator
1caytykbpsr.text: Ken has printed Shamsul's four photographs of Box 14 on paper from the pharmacy across the road: a watch, a lorry's registration card, an old photograph of a gate, and a note with two thumbs.
1caytykbpsr.en: Ken has printed Shamsul's four photographs of Box 14 on paper from the pharmacy across the road: a watch, a lorry's registration card, an old photograph of a gate, and a note with two thumbs.

226r4766ric.speaker: Narrator
226r4766ric.text: The watch is a 1970s Seiko, stopped at ten past two, river mud dried in its crown. On the back: TEOH A.C. 1979.
226r4766ric.en: The watch is a 1970s Seiko, stopped at ten past two, river mud dried in its crown. On the back: TEOH A.C. 1979.

dir.say: [slow, quiet, chilled] The watch is a nineteen-seventies Seiko, stopped at ten past two, river mud dried in its crown. [break] On the back: [emphasis] TEOH A. C. nineteen seventy-nine.

2av6ig3ec3z.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
2av6ig3ec3z.text: Teoh Ah Chuan, of Jugra. Died on the first of December, 1986. Drowned. The file says kemalangan. Accident.
2av6ig3ec3z.en: Teoh Ah Chuan, of Jugra. Died on the first of December, 1986. Drowned. The file says kemalangan. Accident.

dir.say: [reading off a screen, flat, then hard] Teoh Ah Chuan, of Jugra. Died on the first of December, nineteen eighty-six. [break] Drowned. [break] The file says kemalangan. [long-break] Accident.

0ixyr9kvdrq.speaker: Narrator
0ixyr9kvdrq.text: Daniel looks at the third photograph for a long time: the gate, the sun still wet on it, the girl with the brush, and across the red earth the long shadow of whoever held the camera. A slim man in a cap.
0ixyr9kvdrq.en: Daniel looks at the third photograph for a long time: the gate, the sun still wet on it, the girl with the brush, and across the red earth the long shadow of whoever held the camera. A slim man in a cap.

0fea7ugt4rb.speaker: Daniel Raj
0fea7ugt4rb.text: Forty years he kept this in a box, machan. Not the girl. The shadow.
0fea7ugt4rb.en: Forty years he kept this in a box, machan. Not the girl. The shadow.

dir.say: [quiet, unsettled] Forty years he kept this in a box, machan. [break] Not the girl. [long-break] The shadow.

28n3if67e24.speaker: Narrator
28n3if67e24.text: The dry bag went north from Ayer Keroh with Roslan Daud at 2:41 on Christmas morning, and nobody has seen it since.
28n3if67e24.en: The dry bag went north from Ayer Keroh with Roslan Daud at 2:41 on Christmas morning, and nobody has seen it since.

0bj7uwwh4mt.speaker: Narrator
0bj7uwwh4mt.text: A Sinar parcel left Port Klang for Singapore on Boxing Day. Officer: N. SALLEH.
0bj7uwwh4mt.en: A Sinar parcel left Port Klang for Singapore on Boxing Day. Officer: N. SALLEH.

1ghxrrc6juh.speaker: Nurul Ain
1ghxrrc6juh.text: They let me go on the ninth, on a discharge that is not an acquittal. I kept the newsroom's voicemail anyway. Somebody still thinks I buy papers.
1ghxrrc6juh.en: They let me go on the ninth, on a discharge that is not an acquittal. I kept the newsroom's voicemail anyway. Somebody still thinks I buy papers.

00hza6nrqur.speaker: Nurul Ain
00hza6nrqur.text: The paper let me go in October, and I kept its voicemail. Fifty thousand for a paper with two thumbs. I would have found it somehow.
00hza6nrqur.en: The paper let me go in October, and I kept its voicemail. Fifty thousand for a paper with two thumbs. I would have found it somehow.

dir.say: [wry, rueful] The paper let me go in October, and I kept its voicemail. [break] Fifty thousand for a paper with two thumbs. [break] [quietly fierce] I would have found it somehow.

1lv9z0ta2vb.speaker: Narrator
1lv9z0ta2vb.text: The last fireworks of the year go up late and ragged over the towers on Jalan Ampang. Bala Anne's shutter is down, and he does not come down.
1lv9z0ta2vb.en: The last fireworks of the year go up late and ragged over the towers on Jalan Ampang. Bala Anne's shutter is down, and he does not come down.

1k2lvaksjuk.speaker: Narrator
1k2lvaksjuk.text: A courier on a motorbike at the shutter, engine running, an envelope held out. He says only, "Tuan says terima kasih," and is gone before you have it open.
1k2lvaksjuk.en: A courier on a motorbike at the shutter, engine running, an envelope held out. He says only, "Tuan says terima kasih," and is gone before you have it open.

01m6xcn630z.speaker: Narrator
01m6xcn630z.text: Inside, the original of the photograph from Box 14: the gate, the sun, the girl with the brush, the long shadow on the laterite.
01m6xcn630z.en: Inside, the original of the photograph from Box 14: the gate, the sun, the girl with the brush, the long shadow on the laterite.

1olal2c7u7j.speaker: Narrator
1olal2c7u7j.text: On the back, in ink, in the left-handed hand that wrote "Terima kasih" on the rules card, two lines.
1olal2c7u7j.en: On the back, in ink, in the left-handed hand that wrote "Terima kasih" on the rules card, two lines.

1pyimbvly2k.speaker: Narrator
1pyimbvly2k.text: "Selamat Tahun Baru, detektif. She is fifty-five now."
1pyimbvly2k.en: "Selamat Tahun Baru, detektif. She is fifty-five now."

dir.say: [almost a whisper, reading] Selamat Tahun Baru, detektif. [long-break] She is fifty-five now.

1l2q6bqkba0.speaker: Narrator
1l2q6bqkba0.text: The ruined church on the top of St. Paul's Hill at first light: no roof, old Dutch gravestones standing against the walls, guttered candles in paper cups on every one, and in the floor of the nave an open grave behind an iron grille, where a saint lay for nine months and left.
1l2q6bqkba0.en: The ruined church on the top of St. Paul's Hill at first light: no roof, old Dutch gravestones standing against the walls, guttered candles in paper cups on every one, and in the floor of the nave an open grave behind an iron grille, where a saint lay for nine months and left.

2ej2oq8p2jm.speaker: Narrator
2ej2oq8p2jm.text: Under the rim of the grille, taped to the iron, a plastic sleeve with candle wax on it. Inside, a promissory note for eighteen thousand ringgit, stamped CANCELLED, and two thumbprints in old brown ink.
2ej2oq8p2jm.en: Under the rim of the grille, taped to the iron, a plastic sleeve with candle wax on it. Inside, a promissory note for eighteen thousand ringgit, stamped CANCELLED, and two thumbprints in old brown ink.

0s6berywozs.speaker: Narrator
0s6berywozs.text: JPN matches the right thumb within the hour: Muthusamy a/l Perumal, the guarantor. The left thumb has nine clear points. The national search needs twelve.
0s6berywozs.en: JPN matches the right thumb within the hour: Muthusamy a/l Perumal, the guarantor. The left thumb has nine clear points. The national search needs twelve.

dir.say: [measured, careful] JPN matches the right thumb within the hour: Muthusamy a/l Perumal, the guarantor. [break] The left thumb has nine clear points. [break] [quiet] The national search needs twelve.

0ei1oqusf03.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
0ei1oqusf03.text: Nine points is a man. It is not yet a name.
0ei1oqusf03.en: Nine points is a man. It is not yet a name.

dir.say: [dry, precise, a held breath] Nine points is a man. [break] It is not yet a name.

01mz8rq1m51.speaker: Narrator
01mz8rq1m51.text: Melaka Tengah walks Bukit China all Monday with two dogs and a clerk from the Chinese associations, and opens no urn without permission. Joss ash on every grave. No paper.
01mz8rq1m51.en: Melaka Tengah walks Bukit China all Monday with two dogs and a clerk from the Chinese associations, and opens no urn without permission. Joss ash on every grave. No paper.

10ck2hbq8ne.speaker: Narrator
10ck2hbq8ne.text: Marine police divers go down off the Kampung Morten jetty into water you cannot see your hand in, and come up with a bicycle, a shopping trolley and last year's Christmas tree.
10ck2hbq8ne.en: Marine police divers go down off the Kampung Morten jetty into water you cannot see your hand in, and come up with a bicycle, a shopping trolley and last year's Christmas tree.

07wv85kek8o.speaker: Narrator
07wv85kek8o.text: Nobody tells Melaka Tengah where to look.
07wv85kek8o.en: Nobody tells Melaka Tengah where to look.

18xfvmbdhhi.speaker: Narrator
18xfvmbdhhi.text: Jock Sequeira is charged. The Settlement holds a collection for his lawyer that evening, and raises it in an hour.
18xfvmbdhhi.en: Jock Sequeira is charged. The Settlement holds a collection for his lawyer that evening, and raises it in an hour.

0zgru7mq21i.speaker: Narrator
0zgru7mq21i.text: On New Year's Eve the Settlement dances without its locksmith. The band plays the branyo twice, once for him.
0zgru7mq21i.en: On New Year's Eve the Settlement dances without its locksmith. The band plays the branyo twice, once for him.

1m7ajbvzh8d.speaker: Narrator
1m7ajbvzh8d.text: Ram Chettiar is charged. The iron room is sealed, and Sinar Heritage's lawyers write to the court the same afternoon to buy it.
1m7ajbvzh8d.en: Ram Chettiar is charged. The iron room is sealed, and Sinar Heritage's lawyers write to the court the same afternoon to buy it.

12tiegk4s8j.speaker: Narrator
12tiegk4s8j.text: A constable closes the iron door, because the keeper is in a cell at Melaka Tengah. Without a keeper the will cannot hold the room, and Sinar Heritage buys the iron room before the year is out.
12tiegk4s8j.en: A constable closes the iron door, because the keeper is in a cell at Melaka Tengah. Without a keeper the will cannot hold the room, and Sinar Heritage buys the iron room before the year is out.

1q5v3pcnjeb.speaker: Narrator
1q5v3pcnjeb.text: Vanessa Low is arrested in the courtyard of The Kittangi under the Christmas tree. She asks whether the hotel will be told before the guests wake.
1q5v3pcnjeb.en: Vanessa Low is arrested in the courtyard of The Kittangi under the Christmas tree. She asks whether the hotel will be told before the guests wake.

1ho7kixjgmi.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1ho7kixjgmi.text: Boat seven takes the river cruise out tonight with the same pilot at the wheel. He waved at me from the jetty.
1ho7kixjgmi.en: Boat seven takes the river cruise out tonight with the same pilot at the wheel. He waved at me from the jetty.

1g92njh25fc.speaker: Narrator
1g92njh25fc.text: Shamsul Bakri is arrested on the cruise jetty in his pilot's shirt, and asks the constable to tell his mother he was not in a fight.
1g92njh25fc.en: Shamsul Bakri is arrested on the cruise jetty in his pilot's shirt, and asks the constable to tell his mother he was not in a fight.

1pk7mwgffej.speaker: Ram Chettiar
1pk7mwgffej.text: My grandfather lent that man eighteen thousand ringgit and wrote that he was not a good man. You caught the ones who opened his box. I am the one who told them when. Write that down also.
1pk7mwgffej.en: My grandfather lent that man eighteen thousand ringgit and wrote that he was not a good man. You caught the ones who opened his box. I am the one who told them when. Write that down also.

dir.say: [grave, courteous, ashamed] My grandfather lent that man eighteen thousand ringgit and wrote that he was not a good man. [break] You caught the ones who opened his box. [break] [quiet] I am the one who told them when. [break] Write that down also.

1ubdn52f4xa.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1ubdn52f4xa.text: You got the woman at the panel and the boy on the river. You also charged a man who was never in the room. Sinar will not mind at all.
1ubdn52f4xa.en: You got the woman at the panel and the boy on the river. You also charged a man who was never in the room. Sinar will not mind at all.

0muxvvh8f8k.speaker: Narrator
0muxvvh8f8k.text: The shutters of Jalan Tun Sambanthan are still down. A D9 pool car idles at the kerb with its wipers going, because Farah's Waja is still an exhibit in a police yard in Shah Alam.
0muxvvh8f8k.en: The shutters of Jalan Tun Sambanthan are still down. A D9 pool car idles at the kerb with its wipers going, because Farah's Waja is still an exhibit in a police yard in Shah Alam.

19gshlgk4b4.speaker: Narrator
19gshlgk4b4.text: Farah sits in front with her stick between her knees and her left leg out straight. She is on leave, she says. Leave is where she chooses to be.
19gshlgk4b4.en: Farah sits in front with her stick between her knees and her left leg out straight. She is on leave, she says. Leave is where she chooses to be.

1ymbv00jts4.speaker: Narrator
1ymbv00jts4.text: Sergeant Asri puts your bag in the boot and asks, as he closes it, what time you are seeing the old man on Friday. You tell him: seven.
1ymbv00jts4.en: Sergeant Asri puts your bag in the boot and asks, as he closes it, what time you are seeing the old man on Friday. You tell him: seven.

1tx43696n70.speaker: Daniel Raj
1tx43696n70.text: Machan. The only passport I can use says K. Rajan, and K. Rajan is not a man I want to show to a Singapore immigration officer. Bring me back the old man's story. And a kaya bun.
1tx43696n70.en: Machan. The only passport I can use says K. Rajan, and K. Rajan is not a man I want to show to a Singapore immigration officer. Bring me back the old man's story. And a kaya bun.

dir.say: [warm, wry, a little rueful] Machan. [break] The only passport I can use says K. Rajan, and K. Rajan is not a man I want to show to a Singapore immigration officer. [break] [lighter] Bring me back the old man's story. [break] And a kaya bun.

123jce0qcw0.speaker: Daniel Raj
123jce0qcw0.text: Hamidah says the charge can come back any morning it likes. So I am not crossing anything. Not even the road.
123jce0qcw0.en: Hamidah says the charge can come back any morning it likes. So I am not crossing anything. Not even the road.

dir.say: [dry, tired, half joking] Hamidah says the charge can come back any morning it likes. [break] So I am not crossing anything. [break] [quietly] Not even the road.

27v8h98ts2d.speaker: Narrator
27v8h98ts2d.text: Since December he does not sleep anywhere he cannot see the door. He stands on the pavement until the car turns the corner.
27v8h98ts2d.en: Since December he does not sleep anywhere he cannot see the door. He stands on the pavement until the car turns the corner.

15tedftkqy8.speaker: Narrator
15tedftkqy8.text: The Causeway is a kilometre of road laid across the Straits of Johor. Under it the water is brown and slow and full of light. Behind you, Johor Bahru. Ahead, a country where you are nobody's police.
15tedftkqy8.en: The Causeway is a kilometre of road laid across the Straits of Johor. Under it the water is brown and slow and full of light. Behind you, Johor Bahru. Ahead, a country where you are nobody's police.

dir.say: [measured, a little awed] The Causeway is a kilometre of road laid across the Straits of Johor. [break] Under it the water is brown and slow and full of light. [break] Behind you, Johor Bahru. [break] [low] Ahead, a country where you are nobody's police.

26sifa9onve.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
26sifa9onve.text: He would not cross this. Forty years, a whole port, and he never once came over.
26sifa9onve.en: He would not cross this. Forty years, a whole port, and he never once came over.

dir.say: [quiet, looking at the water, hard] He would not cross this. [break] Forty years, a whole port, [break] and he never once came over.

1bn0yebqlhx.speaker: Narrator
1bn0yebqlhx.text: At the booth an officer reads your passport, reads it again, and lets you through. Behind you the pool car turns round for Kuala Lumpur.
1bn0yebqlhx.en: At the booth an officer reads your passport, reads it again, and lets you through. Behind you the pool car turns round for Kuala Lumpur.

0o82vqncjes.speaker: Narrator
