0o82vqncjes.text: Two-storey and three-storey shophouses in pastel plaster, louvred shutters, five-foot ways. Across the street the green-tiled roofs of Thian Hock Keng, where sailors once thanked the sea goddess for getting them here. Over all of it, the glass towers of the banks.
0o82vqncjes.en: Two-storey and three-storey shophouses in pastel plaster, louvred shutters, five-foot ways. Across the street the green-tiled roofs of Thian Hock Keng, where sailors once thanked the sea goddess for getting them here. Over all of it, the glass towers of the banks.

276xvajix9r.speaker: Narrator
276xvajix9r.text: Number 214 is the narrowest house in the row: a brass plate, SEAH & SEAH, ADVOCATES & SOLICITORS, polished thin. On the third floor, behind four iron bars, a desk lamp is on in the middle of the afternoon.
276xvajix9r.en: Number 214 is the narrowest house in the row: a brass plate, SEAH & SEAH, ADVOCATES & SOLICITORS, polished thin. On the third floor, behind four iron bars, a desk lamp is on in the middle of the afternoon.

dir.say: [observant, then uneasy] Number 214 is the narrowest house in the row: [break] a brass plate, Seah and Seah, Advocates and Solicitors, polished thin. [break] [quieter] On the third floor, behind four iron bars, a desk lamp is on in the middle of the afternoon.

21obmfdvomo.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
21obmfdvomo.text: Vivian Chua lives four streets from here now. Ann Siang Hill. She sends cards.
21obmfdvomo.en: Vivian Chua lives four streets from here now. Ann Siang Hill. She sends cards.

0fq22bukb05.speaker: Narrator
0fq22bukb05.text: Your hotel is on Club Street, round the corner and up the hill: a room the size of a lift, a window onto a wall, and an old telephone beside the bed.
0fq22bukb05.en: Your hotel is on Club Street, round the corner and up the hill: a room the size of a lift, a window onto a wall, and an old telephone beside the bed.

19mfrxccn3q.speaker: Narrator
19mfrxccn3q.text: The telephone beside the bed rings once, politely, as if it were apologising.
19mfrxccn3q.en: The telephone beside the bed rings once, politely, as if it were apologising.

16shr2veiri.speaker: Arthur Seah
16shr2veiri.text: Arthur Seah. Forgive an old man's telephone manners. My granddaughter says I shout.
16shr2veiri.en: Arthur Seah. Forgive an old man's telephone manners. My granddaughter says I shout.

dir.say: [old, courteous, a little too loud on the telephone] Arthur Seah. [break] Forgive an old man's telephone manners. [break] [wry] My granddaughter says I shout.

2a4wt9u929q.speaker: Arthur Seah
2a4wt9u929q.text: Seven o'clock on Friday. I met him once, in 1987, on the Johor side. He would not cross the water.
2a4wt9u929q.en: Seven o'clock on Friday. I met him once, in 1987, on the Johor side. He would not cross the water.

dir.say: [old, careful, lowering his voice as if someone might hear] Seven o'clock on Friday. [break] I met him once, in 1987, on the Johor side. [long-break] He would not cross the water.

2cuf3xcjk3c.speaker: Arthur Seah
2cuf3xcjk3c.text: Tomorrow I bring the deed up from the strongroom, and the letter that goes with it. On Friday at seven I will have it all out on the table for you. All of it. I have been tidy for forty years. I should like to be untidy once.
2cuf3xcjk3c.en: Tomorrow I bring the deed up from the strongroom, and the letter that goes with it. On Friday at seven I will have it all out on the table for you. All of it. I have been tidy for forty years. I should like to be untidy once.

dir.say: [old, precise, with a quiet eagerness] Tomorrow I bring the deed up from the strongroom, and the letter that goes with it. [break] On Friday at seven I will have it all out on the table for you. [break] All of it. [break] [wry, almost a smile] I have been tidy for forty years. [break] I should like to be untidy once.

0y8xdc6m2ps.speaker: Narrator
0y8xdc6m2ps.text: He hangs up before you can ask him anything, the way men of his age end telephone calls: when they have said what they rang to say.
0y8xdc6m2ps.en: He hangs up before you can ask him anything, the way men of his age end telephone calls: when they have said what they rang to say.

1u0pls88e1c.speaker: Narrator
1u0pls88e1c.text: Third floor. A corridor of old teak, a camera in its corner, and at the end a door bolted from inside. Nobody answers it.
1u0pls88e1c.en: Third floor. A corridor of old teak, a camera in its corner, and at the end a door bolted from inside. Nobody answers it.

01eouzo6qjw.speaker: Narrator
01eouzo6qjw.text: Outside it: the granddaughter in a grey suit and pearls, who came in at five to seven; the night guard with his cap in his hands; two constables; and a woman in a trouser suit with a lanyard, who says her name is Teo and does not offer her hand.
01eouzo6qjw.en: Outside it: the granddaughter in a grey suit and pearls, who came in at five to seven; the night guard with his cap in his hands; two constables; and a woman in a trouser suit with a lanyard, who says her name is Teo and does not offer her hand.

26iv38jwxm4.speaker: Clarissa Seah
26iv38jwxm4.text: Ah Kong? Ah Kong! He never sleeps past six. Never.
26iv38jwxm4.en: Ah Kong? Ah Kong! He never sleeps past six. Never.

dir.say: [knocking, controlled, rising] Ah Kong? [break] [louder, sharp] Ah Kong! [break] [composed again, too quickly] He never sleeps past six. [break] Never.

0l7huut08i2.speaker: Narrator
0l7huut08i2.text: The bigger constable puts his shoulder to the door twice. The bolt's keeper tears out of the frame. The room is warm and still and smells of chrysanthemum tea.
0l7huut08i2.en: The bigger constable puts his shoulder to the door twice. The bolt's keeper tears out of the frame. The room is warm and still and smells of chrysanthemum tea.

1u9bjp1sztm.speaker: Narrator
1u9bjp1sztm.text: A leather chair turned a little from the desk. A walking stick hooked on its arm. Spectacles folded on the blotter. A hearing aid on the floor. An empty green deed box with its lid up, and a long envelope slit open along the top. Four iron bars over the window, painted over many times. Nobody.
1u9bjp1sztm.en: A leather chair turned a little from the desk. A walking stick hooked on its arm. Spectacles folded on the blotter. A hearing aid on the floor. An empty green deed box with its lid up, and a long envelope slit open along the top. Four iron bars over the window, painted over many times. Nobody.

dir.say: [hushed, slow, each item placed down] A leather chair turned a little from the desk. [break] A walking stick hooked on its arm. [break] Spectacles folded on the blotter. [break] A hearing aid on the floor. [break] An empty green deed box with its lid up, and a long envelope slit open along the top. [break] Four iron bars over the window, painted over many times. [long-break] [flat] Nobody.

2a88gpcp6ti.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
2a88gpcp6ti.text: Can or not, you tell me. Bolted inside, bars outside, camera on the corridor. Where did an old man go?
2a88gpcp6ti.en: Can or not, you tell me. Bolted inside, bars outside, camera on the corridor. Where did an old man go?

dir.say: [brisk, dry, Singaporean, challenging] Can or not, you tell me. [break] Bolted inside, bars outside, camera on the corridor. [break] [pointed] Where did an old man go?

07xpkbcu4ct.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
07xpkbcu4ct.text: Lyon, 2014. Your inspector sat next to me for six weeks and corrected my French. So. This is a courtesy. You look, you tell me, I decide. You touch nothing I have not touched first.
07xpkbcu4ct.en: Lyon, 2014. Your inspector sat next to me for six weeks and corrected my French. So. This is a courtesy. You look, you tell me, I decide. You touch nothing I have not touched first.

dir.say: [brisk, dry, amused despite herself] Lyon, 2014. [break] Your inspector sat next to me for six weeks and corrected my French. [break] [firm] So. This is a courtesy. [break] You look, you tell me, I decide. [break] You touch nothing I have not touched first.

1yzlh0s1oyk.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
1yzlh0s1oyk.text: Your superintendent rang Cantonment yesterday to tell us you are not police. I told him I know. That is why you are allowed in.
1yzlh0s1oyk.en: Your superintendent rang Cantonment yesterday to tell us you are not police. I told him I know. That is why you are allowed in.

0ynwqm72lcp.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
0ynwqm72lcp.text: A suspended superintendent rang Cantonment from his house yesterday to tell us you are not police. I told him I know. That is why you are allowed in.
0ynwqm72lcp.en: A suspended superintendent rang Cantonment from his house yesterday to tell us you are not police. I told him I know. That is why you are allowed in.

0zpexegk98p.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0zpexegk98p.text: He would have it all out on the table, he said. Somebody has cleared the table.
0zpexegk98p.en: He would have it all out on the table, he said. Somebody has cleared the table.

24btthbmrld.speaker: Narrator
24btthbmrld.text: ASP Teo files the case as a missing person, signs it, and goes home to sleep for the first time since Thursday. Nobody is charged with anything.
24btthbmrld.en: ASP Teo files the case as a missing person, signs it, and goes home to sleep for the first time since Thursday. Nobody is charged with anything.

0bdyzbr5uf6.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
0bdyzbr5uf6.text: Whoever took him, I am not holding them. My superintendent says thank you for your courtesy visit.
0bdyzbr5uf6.en: Whoever took him, I am not holding them. My superintendent says thank you for your courtesy visit.

0dpqahphjrn.speaker: Narrator
0dpqahphjrn.text: Teo's team spends the afternoon on the bolt with a locksmith from Jurong and three magnets. From outside, whatever they do, the bolt does not move.
0dpqahphjrn.en: Teo's team spends the afternoon on the bolt with a locksmith from Jurong and three magnets. From outside, whatever they do, the bolt does not move.

00rm2oy9lrx.speaker: Narrator
00rm2oy9lrx.text: By the time Teo's team reaches Tuas the bale room is empty and cold. The plant's log has forty minutes missing, from eleven o'clock to twenty to twelve. Arthur Seah is not found.
00rm2oy9lrx.en: By the time Teo's team reaches Tuas the bale room is empty and cold. The plant's log has forty minutes missing, from eleven o'clock to twenty to twelve. Arthur Seah is not found.

dir.say: [low, heavy, slow] By the time Teo's team reaches Tuas the bale room is empty and cold. [break] The plant's log has forty minutes missing, from eleven o'clock to twenty to twelve. [long-break] [flat, final] Arthur Seah is not found.

0wlbx2mzr13.speaker: Narrator
0wlbx2mzr13.text: Only the corner survives, in an evidence bag at Cantonment, with the end of one line on it in a left hand: "...drives me last."
0wlbx2mzr13.en: Only the corner survives, in an evidence bag at Cantonment, with the end of one line on it in a left hand: "...drives me last."

1cscy8kamtn.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1cscy8kamtn.text: He wanted to be untidy once. He wanted to put it all out on the table. They took the table.
1cscy8kamtn.en: He wanted to be untidy once. He wanted to put it all out on the table. They took the table.

dir.say: [low, bitter, grieving] He wanted to be untidy once. [break] He wanted to put it all out on the table. [long-break] They took the table.

0gokva2e0w2.speaker: Narrator
0gokva2e0w2.text: On Saturday the 1987 deed goes into the custody of the High Court of Singapore in a grey archive box, and a certified copy goes north to Hamidah Yusof by courier, across the water, the way its maker never would.
0gokva2e0w2.en: On Saturday the 1987 deed goes into the custody of the High Court of Singapore in a grey archive box, and a certified copy goes north to Hamidah Yusof by courier, across the water, the way its maker never would.

02qp7g0mgmh.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
02qp7g0mgmh.text: Muthu's name on the deed, and not one stroke of it his. Hamidah says that is a forgery in two countries. She says she will need both of them.
02qp7g0mgmh.en: Muthu's name on the deed, and not one stroke of it his. Hamidah says that is a forgery in two countries. She says she will need both of them.

dir.say: [low, hard, a little sad] Muthu's name on the deed, and not one stroke of it his. [break] Hamidah says that is a forgery in two countries. [break] [dry] She says she will need both of them.

084s04x5aln.speaker: Narrator
084s04x5aln.text: On Monday Clarissa Seah is still the trustee of the Jugra Trust. The brass plate on Telok Ayer Street is polished at eight, as usual.
084s04x5aln.en: On Monday Clarissa Seah is still the trustee of the Jugra Trust. The brass plate on Telok Ayer Street is polished at eight, as usual.

225b0ds3nt7.speaker: Narrator
225b0ds3nt7.text: The Law Society appoints an interim trustee for the Jugra Trust on Monday morning. By Monday afternoon Sinar's lawyers have written to object.
225b0ds3nt7.en: The Law Society appoints an interim trustee for the Jugra Trust on Monday morning. By Monday afternoon Sinar's lawyers have written to object.

1c6jzvaqem6.speaker: Narrator
1c6jzvaqem6.text: At your hotel a card in copperplate is waiting, with no stamp: "He will be sorry about the old man."
1c6jzvaqem6.en: At your hotel a card in copperplate is waiting, with no stamp: "He will be sorry about the old man."

0oodbh7uryv.speaker: Narrator
0oodbh7uryv.text: A letter from the Office of the Chairman reaches Seah & Seah by hand on Monday, asking after Mr. Arthur's health. It is initialled M.O.
0oodbh7uryv.en: A letter from the Office of the Chairman reaches Seah & Seah by hand on Monday, asking after Mr. Arthur's health. It is initialled M.O.

1l4s61e3zce.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
1l4s61e3zce.text: One more thing. The trust's investment committee has three members. One is a Sri Lankan lady, very elegant, who flies in from Colombo every quarter. Somebody you know, I think.
1l4s61e3zce.en: One more thing. The trust's investment committee has three members. One is a Sri Lankan lady, very elegant, who flies in from Colombo every quarter. Somebody you know, I think.

293q1mmghvz.speaker: Narrator
293q1mmghvz.text: Bin 7's empty frame crossed back into Johor on Saturday, on a Sinar Cold Chain flatbed. Officer: N. SALLEH.
293q1mmghvz.en: Bin 7's empty frame crossed back into Johor on Saturday, on a Sinar Cold Chain flatbed. Officer: N. SALLEH.

0pnjll286yf.speaker: Narrator
0pnjll286yf.text: Daniel rings the hotel on Sunday night, from the agency, with the radio on behind him and a teh going cold.
0pnjll286yf.en: Daniel rings the hotel on Sunday night, from the agency, with the radio on behind him and a teh going cold.

11s8qgovg19.speaker: Daniel Raj
11s8qgovg19.text: Machan. Still nothing? Then keep looking. Old men are harder to lose than people think.
11s8qgovg19.en: Machan. Still nothing? Then keep looking. Old men are harder to lose than people think.

dir.say: [gentle, steady, stubborn] Machan. Still nothing? [break] Then keep looking. [break] Old men are harder to lose than people think.

1nbpgre7bub.speaker: Daniel Raj
1nbpgre7bub.text: Hamidah says my charge is a door that is not locked. So I stay on this side of it.
1nbpgre7bub.en: Hamidah says my charge is a door that is not locked. So I stay on this side of it.

0risz8xswxz.speaker: Narrator
0risz8xswxz.text: Since December he does not sleep anywhere he cannot see the door, and he has started leaving the radio on all night.
0risz8xswxz.en: Since December he does not sleep anywhere he cannot see the door, and he has started leaving the radio on all night.

17qeevwwsut.speaker: Narrator
17qeevwwsut.text: Then the line clicks, and a call from Colombo cuts in on top of him.
17qeevwwsut.en: Then the line clicks, and a call from Colombo cuts in on top of him.

dir.cue: [warm, formal, a smile in the voice]

1gnz0bgpw12.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
1gnz0bgpw12.text: Your fire officer and your depot manager send their regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know they are both still here.
1gnz0bgpw12.en: Your fire officer and your depot manager send their regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know they are both still here.

085ikoecugl.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
085ikoecugl.text: Your fire officer sends his regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know he is still here.
085ikoecugl.en: Your fire officer sends his regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know he is still here.

24g76hn1ums.speaker: Inspector Ruwan Herath
24g76hn1ums.text: Your depot manager sends his regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know he is still here.
24g76hn1ums.en: Your depot manager sends his regards from my side of the water. I thought you would like to know he is still here.

2d8jvv2mgvd.speaker: Narrator
2d8jvv2mgvd.text: At ten past two the telephone beside the bed rings. Nobody at the desk downstairs put the call through.
2d8jvv2mgvd.en: At ten past two the telephone beside the bed rings. Nobody at the desk downstairs put the call through.

dir.say: [whispering, very still, dread] At ten past two the telephone beside the bed rings. [break] Nobody at the desk downstairs put the call through.

1lf0bc3mx06.speaker: The Chairman
1lf0bc3mx06.text: You crossed the water for me, detective. I never have. Thank you.
1lf0bc3mx06.en: You crossed the water for me, detective. I never have. Thank you.

dir.say: [close, calm, courteous, faintly amused, utterly cold underneath] You crossed the water for me, detective. [break] I never have. [long-break] [softly] Thank you.

17oln9yjwyl.speaker: Narrator
17oln9yjwyl.text: A lid snaps open on the line, and shut. Then the dialling tone, and the hum of the city, and your own heart.
17oln9yjwyl.en: A lid snaps open on the line, and shut. Then the dialling tone, and the hum of the city, and your own heart.

dir.say: [whispering, shaken] A lid snaps open on the line, [break] and shut. [break] Then the dialling tone, [break] and the hum of the city, [break] [flat] and your own heart.

1891hjgi2qp.speaker: Narrator
1891hjgi2qp.text: The fire service takes the bars off the oldest window on Telok Ayer Street in front of a television crew. Under the paint the bolts have rusted into the frame since 1946.
1891hjgi2qp.en: The fire service takes the bars off the oldest window on Telok Ayer Street in front of a television crew. Under the paint the bolts have rusted into the frame since 1946.

1ahc5n7asf5.speaker: Narrator
1ahc5n7asf5.text: Teo's men take down the archive shelving and open the party wall into No. 216. Behind the brick is more brick, and a hundred years of dust.
1ahc5n7asf5.en: Teo's men take down the archive shelving and open the party wall into No. 216. Behind the brick is more brick, and a hundred years of dust.

189q0zawkbt.speaker: Narrator
189q0zawkbt.text: Teo's team opens door 4 at Tuas at two o'clock on Friday afternoon. Behind it, among the paper bales, in a shredding bin wrapped in empty shred sacks, Arthur Seah is alive and very cold, and asks for his hearing aid.
189q0zawkbt.en: Teo's team opens door 4 at Tuas at two o'clock on Friday afternoon. Behind it, among the paper bales, in a shredding bin wrapped in empty shred sacks, Arthur Seah is alive and very cold, and asks for his hearing aid.

dir.say: [low, building, then relief] Teo's team opens door four at Tuas at two o'clock on Friday afternoon. [break] Behind it, among the paper bales, in a shredding bin wrapped in empty shred sacks, [break] [softer] Arthur Seah is alive and very cold, [break] and asks for his hearing aid.

29zaz2zj2fy.speaker: Narrator
29zaz2zj2fy.text: On Saturday, under three blankets, his hearing aid back in, he asks for his spectacles before he will speak, and then for the Malaysian. He recites the letter of wishes from memory, every word, and stops at the last line as if it were the end of a hymn.
29zaz2zj2fy.en: On Saturday, under three blankets, his hearing aid back in, he asks for his spectacles before he will speak, and then for the Malaysian. He recites the letter of wishes from memory, every word, and stops at the last line as if it were the end of a hymn.

1dtsdn32huy.speaker: Arthur Seah
1dtsdn32huy.text: On my death the Trust is to be directed by whoever drives me last.
1dtsdn32huy.en: On my death the Trust is to be directed by whoever drives me last.

dir.say: [old, slow, reciting from memory like scripture] On my death [break] the Trust is to be directed [break] by whoever [emphasis] drives me last.

10hfza4fmk0.speaker: Arthur Seah
10hfza4fmk0.text: I told him that is not a legal sentence. He said, it will be, Arthur, when I am dead.
10hfza4fmk0.en: I told him that is not a legal sentence. He said, it will be, Arthur, when I am dead.

dir.say: [old, dry, a lawyer's distaste] I told him that is not a legal sentence. [long-break] [quieter, uneasy] He said, it will be, Arthur, [break] when I am dead.

2cgjyig98e0.speaker: Arthur Seah
2cgjyig98e0.text: The first of December, 1987. The Johor waterfront, at dusk. A black car, and his driver standing outside it with his back to us the whole time.
2cgjyig98e0.en: The first of December, 1987. The Johor waterfront, at dusk. A black car, and his driver standing outside it with his back to us the whole time.

dir.say: [old, remembering, slow] The first of December, 1987. [break] The Johor waterfront, at dusk. [break] A black car, [break] and his driver standing outside it with his back to us the whole time.

0zseb5e0hti.speaker: Arthur Seah
0zseb5e0hti.text: Younger than me and older than he looked. A face you forget while you are looking at it. He signed with his left hand.
0zseb5e0hti.en: Younger than me and older than he looked. A face you forget while you are looking at it. He signed with his left hand.

dir.say: [old, careful, slightly troubled] Younger than me and older than he looked. [break] A face you forget while you are looking at it. [long-break] He signed with his left hand.

223rgdhs8ko.speaker: Arthur Seah
223rgdhs8ko.text: I do not cross water, he said. So I crossed it, with my pen and my stamp. I have been crossing it for him for forty years.
223rgdhs8ko.en: I do not cross water, he said. So I crossed it, with my pen and my stamp. I have been crossing it for him for forty years.

dir.say: [old, quiet, rueful] I do not cross water, he said. [break] So I crossed it, with my pen and my stamp. [break] [heavier] I have been crossing it for him for forty years.

17986r2cck9.speaker: Daniel Raj
17986r2cck9.text: Machan. They found the old man? Then fold him a kancil from me. A man who keeps a paper forty years has earned one.
17986r2cck9.en: Machan. They found the old man? Then fold him a kancil from me. A man who keeps a paper forty years has earned one.

dir.say: [warm, relieved, gentle] Machan. They found the old man? [break] Then fold him a kancil from me. [break] A man who keeps a paper forty years has earned one.

1tp6y3zruan.speaker: Narrator
1tp6y3zruan.text: Nobody tells Teo which way he went, and she searches nothing.
1tp6y3zruan.en: Nobody tells Teo which way he went, and she searches nothing.

1vjwx5wxngo.speaker: Narrator
1vjwx5wxngo.text: R. Rajendran is charged. His firm takes his uniform back the same afternoon.
1vjwx5wxngo.en: R. Rajendran is charged. His firm takes his uniform back the same afternoon.

0hat3co3yhu.speaker: Narrator
0hat3co3yhu.text: Lucas Seah is charged. He asks the magistrate to tell his father he is sorry, and the magistrate does not know where to send it.
0hat3co3yhu.en: Lucas Seah is charged. He asks the magistrate to tell his father he is sorry, and the magistrate does not know where to send it.

092a6sr2v8a.speaker: Narrator
092a6sr2v8a.text: Clarissa Seah is arrested in the firm's boardroom under her great-grandfather's portrait, and asks for a Singapore lawyer who has never acted for Sinar. There is not one in the Law Society's directory.
092a6sr2v8a.en: Clarissa Seah is arrested in the firm's boardroom under her great-grandfather's portrait, and asks for a Singapore lawyer who has never acted for Sinar. There is not one in the Law Society's directory.

0wjldk9voc2.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
0wjldk9voc2.text: The granddaughter is in my cells. The man who carried him down is back at work in Tuas on Monday, weighing paper.
0wjldk9voc2.en: The granddaughter is in my cells. The man who carried him down is back at work in Tuas on Monday, weighing paper.

1lso4xigt09.speaker: Narrator
1lso4xigt09.text: Gary Raju is charged at Cantonment on Sunday morning, still in the overalls he ran in on Friday. He asks whether the old man was cold.
1lso4xigt09.en: Gary Raju is charged at Cantonment on Sunday morning, still in the overalls he ran in on Friday. He asks whether the old man was cold.

dir.say: [clipped, formal] Gary Raju is charged at Cantonment on Sunday morning, still in the overalls he ran in on Friday. [break] [quiet] He asks whether the old man was cold.

1e73a2edtcx.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
1e73a2edtcx.text: The man who rode the lift is in my cells. The woman who sent it up is still signing letters on Telok Ayer Street.
1e73a2edtcx.en: The man who rode the lift is in my cells. The woman who sent it up is still signing letters on Telok Ayer Street.

0rhwgptvptu.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
0rhwgptvptu.text: Two names, one route, one old man. In Singapore we call that a good week.
0rhwgptvptu.en: Two names, one route, one old man. In Singapore we call that a good week.

10ejja14v2x.speaker: ASP Teo Wei Ling
10ejja14v2x.text: You gave me the two who did it, and one more who did not. Here the court reads the whole file, ah. It will notice.
10ejja14v2x.en: You gave me the two who did it, and one more who did not. Here the court reads the whole file, ah. It will notice.

0kyjh3rrehw.speaker: Narrator
0kyjh3rrehw.text: Twenty to nine on a Monday at the Shah Alam courts: lawyers in black, families on the steps with plastic bags of food, and at the top of them, Hamidah Yusof with her flask of teh and her hair still wet.
0kyjh3rrehw.en: Twenty to nine on a Monday at the Shah Alam courts: lawyers in black, families on the steps with plastic bags of food, and at the top of them, Hamidah Yusof with her flask of teh and her hair still wet.

2gjk787ohbs.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
2gjk787ohbs.text: Third court this season, detective. This one is forty years old.
2gjk787ohbs.en: Third court this season, detective. This one is forty years old.

dir.say: [dry, brisk, faintly amused] Third court this season, detective. [break] [quieter] This one is forty years old.

1e2g6o3m19w.speaker: Narrator
1e2g6o3m19w.text: The coroner sits in Court 3 for four days, on an application Hamidah signed herself. The death of Teoh Ah Chuan, lorry owner, of Jugra, on 1 December 1986. Cause on the file: kemalangan. Accident. Time taken to decide it: eleven minutes.
1e2g6o3m19w.en: The coroner sits in Court 3 for four days, on an application Hamidah signed herself. The death of Teoh Ah Chuan, lorry owner, of Jugra, on 1 December 1986. Cause on the file: kemalangan. Accident. Time taken to decide it: eleven minutes.

dir.say: [measured, flat, reading a record] The coroner sits in Court 3 for four days, on an application Hamidah signed herself. [break] The death of Teoh Ah Chuan, lorry owner, of Jugra, on 1 December 1986. [break] Cause on the file: kemalangan. [break] Accident. [long-break] [quiet, bitter] Time taken to decide it: eleven minutes.

08yt3hxy3ib.speaker: Narrator
08yt3hxy3ib.text: A police car stops at the foot of the steps. Out of it, between two constables, comes a thin old man in a pressed shirt, holding a folder to his chest like a schoolboy: retired Corporal Tarmizi Hassan, who wrote the word. Farah's sergeant, Asri, walks at his elbow.
08yt3hxy3ib.en: A police car stops at the foot of the steps. Out of it, between two constables, comes a thin old man in a pressed shirt, holding a folder to his chest like a schoolboy: retired Corporal Tarmizi Hassan, who wrote the word. Farah's sergeant, Asri, walks at his elbow.

0w0d9pp1hfj.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0w0d9pp1hfj.text: No stick. Back on duty, back on my feet. I asked for Asri on the witness room. In four years he has never once been late.
0w0d9pp1hfj.en: No stick. Back on duty, back on my feet. I asked for Asri on the witness room. In four years he has never once been late.

dir.say: [brisk, pleased with herself, dry] No stick. Back on duty, back on my feet. [break] [matter of fact, warm] I asked for Asri on the witness room. In four years he has never once been late.

198ikgti91a.speaker: Narrator
198ikgti91a.text: In the corridor outside Court 3 the old corporal stops in front of you, as if he has waited a long time to say it to somebody who is not from Jugra.
198ikgti91a.en: In the corridor outside Court 3 the old corporal stops in front of you, as if he has waited a long time to say it to somebody who is not from Jugra.

1cf7otsda7r.speaker: Tarmizi Hassan
1cf7otsda7r.text: Saya tulis kemalangan. Empat puluh tahun saya tulis kemalangan.
1cf7otsda7r.en: I wrote "accident". For forty years I have been writing "accident".

dir.say: [old man, thin voice, trembling, a confession held in too long] Saya tulis kemalangan. [break] [breaking] Empat puluh tahun saya tulis kemalangan.

037ujy5upi2.speaker: Narrator
037ujy5upi2.text: In the front row of the gallery a woman of fifty-five sits with paint dried on her forearms and a tin of brushes on her knee, as if she might be asked to paint something: Teoh Siew Yang, the applicant, the dead man's daughter, down from Butterworth.
037ujy5upi2.en: In the front row of the gallery a woman of fifty-five sits with paint dried on her forearms and a tin of brushes on her knee, as if she might be asked to paint something: Teoh Siew Yang, the applicant, the dead man's daughter, down from Butterworth.

03f0ro3i0s7.speaker: Narrator
03f0ro3i0s7.text: When the clerk reads her father's name she says something to nobody, in Hokkien.
03f0ro3i0s7.en: When the clerk reads her father's name she says something to nobody, in Hokkien.

dir.cue: [barely a whisper, to herself, grief worn smooth]

0y8t0k71ulc.speaker: Narrator
0y8t0k71ulc.text: Beside her, an old man in a white shirt turns a string of prayer beads: her uncle, Teoh Ah Kow, the dead man's younger brother, who identified the body in 1986 and has come to sit beside her every day.
0y8t0k71ulc.en: Beside her, an old man in a white shirt turns a string of prayer beads: her uncle, Teoh Ah Kow, the dead man's younger brother, who identified the body in 1986 and has come to sit beside her every day.

00ibw5so0v6.speaker: Teoh Ah Kow
00ibw5so0v6.text: Sit, Siew Yang. Forty years you waited. You can wait one more minute.
00ibw5so0v6.en: Sit, Siew Yang. Forty years you waited. You can wait one more minute.

dir.cue: [soft, gentle old man, soothing, a little too smooth]

0lrqv0duxe0.speaker: Narrator
0lrqv0duxe0.text: Daniel sits in the row behind them with the coroner's cause list in his hands, and folds nothing.
0lrqv0duxe0.en: Daniel sits in the row behind them with the coroner's cause list in his hands, and folds nothing.

145d9dw5mkw.speaker: Narrator
145d9dw5mkw.text: He sleeps with the light on now, since the back seat of the car. In court he sits where he can see the door.
145d9dw5mkw.en: He sleeps with the light on now, since the back seat of the car. In court he sits where he can see the door.

1ku1t31mv8v.speaker: Daniel Raj
1ku1t31mv8v.text: They kept this file shut for forty years, machan. Mine they only closed in December, and they can open it again any morning they like.
1ku1t31mv8v.en: They kept this file shut for forty years, machan. Mine they only closed in December, and they can open it again any morning they like.

dir.say: [low, wry, tired] They kept this file shut for forty years, machan. [break] [bitter, quiet] Mine they only closed in December, and they can open it again any morning they like.

1bvp4u61lph.speaker: Narrator
1bvp4u61lph.text: A girl of fifteen asleep on a camp bed in her father's yard office wakes to a lorry engine at ten past two in the morning, and goes to the window.
1bvp4u61lph.en: A girl of fifteen asleep on a camp bed in her father's yard office wakes to a lorry engine at ten past two in the morning, and goes to the window.

043acs945hp.speaker: Narrator
043acs945hp.text: A torch on the bank of the river, held up high. The tail lights of a lorry going down the washing ramp into black water, and under.
043acs945hp.en: A torch on the bank of the river, held up high. The tail lights of a lorry going down the washing ramp into black water, and under.

dir.say: [hushed, dreamlike] A torch on the bank of the river, held up high. [break] [slow, dread] The tail lights of a lorry going down the washing ramp into black water, [long-break] and under.

040ufrlse56.speaker: Narrator
040ufrlse56.text: Two figures. One on the bank, holding the light. One in the water at the cab door, with his back to her.
040ufrlse56.en: Two figures. One on the bank, holding the light. One in the water at the cab door, with his back to her.

dir.say: [whispering, slow] Two figures. [break] One on the bank, holding the light. [break] One in the water at the cab door, [break] with his back to her.

2dk065kpwx3.speaker: Narrator
2dk065kpwx3.text: Across the yard a man's voice said: "Jangan tengok belakang."
2dk065kpwx3.en: Across the yard a man's voice said: "Jangan tengok belakang."

dir.say: [whispering, very still, chilled] Across the yard a man's voice said: [long-break] "Jangan tengok belakang."

0qrnc2uv6vp.speaker: Narrator
0qrnc2uv6vp.text: In the morning her uncle told her she had dreamed it. She was fifteen. She believed him for forty years, nearly.
0qrnc2uv6vp.en: In the morning her uncle told her she had dreamed it. She was fifteen. She believed him for forty years, nearly.

dir.say: [quiet, aching] In the morning her uncle told her she had dreamed it. [break] She was fifteen. [long-break] [softly] She believed him for forty years, nearly.

0j9iibjzghw.speaker: Narrator
0j9iibjzghw.text: The coroner's site visit: three cars on a laterite track under Bukit Jugra, the lighthouse on the hill above, oil palm on both sides, and at the end of the track a gate with a sun painted on it. Pink, faded, forty-one years old.
0j9iibjzghw.en: The coroner's site visit: three cars on a laterite track under Bukit Jugra, the lighthouse on the hill above, oil palm on both sides, and at the end of the track a gate with a sun painted on it. Pink, faded, forty-one years old.

0cpl0fbyvft.speaker: Narrator
0cpl0fbyvft.text: Pak Itam, the watchman, opens the gate for the coroner without a word, his keys on their string, and stands aside looking at the ground.
0cpl0fbyvft.en: Pak Itam, the watchman, opens the gate for the coroner without a word, his keys on their string, and stands aside looking at the ground.

02mslqhne0w.speaker: Narrator
02mslqhne0w.text: Inside: laterite and weeds, a lorry shed with no lorry in it, a hut by the gate, and at the bottom of the yard the concrete washing ramp running down into the brown Langat. Still there. Still wet.
02mslqhne0w.en: Inside: laterite and weeds, a lorry shed with no lorry in it, a hut by the gate, and at the bottom of the yard the concrete washing ramp running down into the brown Langat. Still there. Still wet.

dir.say: [low, uneasy] Inside: laterite and weeds, a lorry shed with no lorry in it, a hut by the gate, [break] and at the bottom of the yard the concrete washing ramp running down into the brown Langat. [long-break] Still there. [break] Still wet.

1fjrpbjnqh0.speaker: Pak Itam
1fjrpbjnqh0.text: Air tengah pasang, tuan. Jangan dekat.
1fjrpbjnqh0.en: The tide is coming in, sir. Don't go near.

dir.cue: [old village man, quiet, flat, a warning without emphasis]

1casefkrlgj.speaker: Narrator
1casefkrlgj.text: Siew Yang puts her hand flat on the painted sun, the way you would put a hand on a horse.
1casefkrlgj.en: Siew Yang puts her hand flat on the painted sun, the way you would put a hand on a horse.

2fil1r0br4p.speaker: Narrator
2fil1r0br4p.text: On the exhibit table the clerk lays out what forty years have left: a police file of four typed pages, a lorry's registration card, and a photograph of a wristwatch stopped at ten past two, from a thief's telephone in Melaka.
2fil1r0br4p.en: On the exhibit table the clerk lays out what forty years have left: a police file of four typed pages, a lorry's registration card, and a photograph of a wristwatch stopped at ten past two, from a thief's telephone in Melaka.

0oswsosqzde.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
0oswsosqzde.text: Every exhibit on that table came from somebody who was told to burn it.
0oswsosqzde.en: Every exhibit on that table came from somebody who was told to burn it.

0m58fmx8dfi.speaker: Narrator
0m58fmx8dfi.text: In Cheras a headstone says Ong Wei Jie now. Siew Yang knew the family: a ferry engineer's boy from Bagan Luar, three streets from her shop.
0m58fmx8dfi.en: In Cheras a headstone says Ong Wei Jie now. Siew Yang knew the family: a ferry engineer's boy from Bagan Luar, three streets from her shop.

19cxa3ri6o5.speaker: Narrator
19cxa3ri6o5.text: Exhibit P7: a cancelled promissory note from Melaka, 2 December 1986, with two thumbprints on it, in the plastic sleeve that was taped under an iron grille on St. Paul's Hill.
19cxa3ri6o5.en: Exhibit P7: a cancelled promissory note from Melaka, 2 December 1986, with two thumbprints on it, in the plastic sleeve that was taped under an iron grille on St. Paul's Hill.

0ydcgrfgptc.speaker: Narrator
0ydcgrfgptc.text: Exhibit P9: an affidavit sworn in Singapore General Hospital by Arthur Seah, eighty-two, about a man in the back of a car who would not cross the water.
0ydcgrfgptc.en: Exhibit P9: an affidavit sworn in Singapore General Hospital by Arthur Seah, eighty-two, about a man in the back of a car who would not cross the water.

1wv6iefplko.speaker: Narrator
1wv6iefplko.text: Leaning against the leg of the exhibit table, a rusted lorry plate: BCK 210, with a small sun painted in its corner.
1wv6iefplko.en: Leaning against the leg of the exhibit table, a rusted lorry plate: BCK 210, with a small sun painted in its corner.

0cn3sx11d5j.speaker: Narrator
0cn3sx11d5j.text: The plate BCK 210 is still on your office wall in Brickfields. The coroner has asked for a photograph of it, and has it.
0cn3sx11d5j.en: The plate BCK 210 is still on your office wall in Brickfields. The coroner has asked for a photograph of it, and has it.

2d3zlilguuv.speaker: Narrator
2d3zlilguuv.text: In the back row, in plain clothes and without a notebook: Superintendent Khairul, "observing".
2d3zlilguuv.en: In the back row, in plain clothes and without a notebook: Superintendent Khairul, "observing".

0hqivyvbqj6.speaker: Narrator
0hqivyvbqj6.text: Teoh Ah Kow is not charged. He takes the evening bus home to Banting with his beads, and waters his garden in the dark.
0hqivyvbqj6.en: Teoh Ah Kow is not charged. He takes the evening bus home to Banting with his beads, and waters his garden in the dark.

dir.say: [flat, uneasy] Teoh Ah Kow is not charged. [break] He takes the evening bus home to Banting with his beads, [break] [quiet, ominous] and waters his garden in the dark.

296qatnh3y7.speaker: Narrator
296qatnh3y7.text: Shamir Kassim is not charged with the tea. Hamidah reports him to the Bar Council for the cut recording and the envelope, and he is in a Sinar car before the letter is typed.
296qatnh3y7.en: Shamir Kassim is not charged with the tea. Hamidah reports him to the Bar Council for the cut recording and the envelope, and he is in a Sinar car before the letter is typed.

0qnei5qz1p5.speaker: Narrator
0qnei5qz1p5.text: The coroner finds what the corporal found: the brakes failed. The finding of 1986 is written again in 2027, in a better hand.
0qnei5qz1p5.en: The coroner finds what the corporal found: the brakes failed. The finding of 1986 is written again in 2027, in a better hand.

273tqtq6wtj.speaker: Narrator
273tqtq6wtj.text: The file of 1986 is closed again, for the second time, and this time in a coroner's hand.
273tqtq6wtj.en: The file of 1986 is closed again, for the second time, and this time in a coroner's hand.

105ihpjt1rx.speaker: Narrator
105ihpjt1rx.text: In the GOH 2021 carton, among Henry Goh's old index cards, Farah finds one from 1986 in his young handwriting: "Teoh A.C., drowning, dental: identified by brother."
105ihpjt1rx.en: In the GOH 2021 carton, among Henry Goh's old index cards, Farah finds one from 1986 in his young handwriting: "Teoh A.C., drowning, dental: identified by brother."

dir.say: [quiet, slow, uneasy] In the GOH 2021 carton, among Henry Goh's old index cards, Farah finds one from 1986 in his young handwriting: [break] [reading, flat] "Teoh A.C., drowning, dental: [break] identified by brother."

23osqpw1wzq.speaker: Narrator
23osqpw1wzq.text: Siew Yang drives down to Jugra in the last of the light with her tin of brushes, and paints nothing.
23osqpw1wzq.en: Siew Yang drives down to Jugra in the last of the light with her tin of brushes, and paints nothing.

1cx4bdmkkyi.speaker: Narrator
1cx4bdmkkyi.text: She sits on the washing ramp with her shoes off until the tide comes up to her feet and it is dark, and Pak Itam waits at the gate with his keys and does not ask her to go.
1cx4bdmkkyi.en: She sits on the washing ramp with her shoes off until the tide comes up to her feet and it is dark, and Pak Itam waits at the gate with his keys and does not ask her to go.

0xyxw3rrty0.speaker: Narrator
0xyxw3rrty0.text: Daniel folds a kancil out of the coroner's cause list, slowly, and sets it on the exhibit table beside the photograph of the watch at ten past two.
0xyxw3rrty0.en: Daniel folds a kancil out of the coroner's cause list, slowly, and sets it on the exhibit table beside the photograph of the watch at ten past two.

20o1h9xux9y.speaker: Daniel Raj
20o1h9xux9y.text: All this time I thought it was a time, machan. It was a minute.
20o1h9xux9y.en: All this time I thought it was a time, machan. It was a minute.

dir.say: [low, quiet, a realisation] All this time I thought it was a time, machan. [long-break] It was a minute.

18qoyv48vbu.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
18qoyv48vbu.text: Asri carried that cup in himself. He has not slept since. I told him it is not his fault.
18qoyv48vbu.en: Asri carried that cup in himself. He has not slept since. I told him it is not his fault.

1xpzptyoex3.speaker: Narrator
1xpzptyoex3.text: Since the back seat on the first of December Daniel has slept with the light on. Tonight, he says, he might try it off.
1xpzptyoex3.en: Since the back seat on the first of December Daniel has slept with the light on. Tonight, he says, he might try it off.

2ckge364gp2.speaker: Daniel Raj
2ckge364gp2.text: They closed a drowning in eleven minutes, machan. Mine took a year, and it is still not shut.
2ckge364gp2.en: They closed a drowning in eleven minutes, machan. Mine took a year, and it is still not shut.

0ekhpgxqs8d.speaker: Narrator
0ekhpgxqs8d.text: In Butterworth, at the ferry terminal, Madam Ong closes her stall and sets out one glass of teh.
0ekhpgxqs8d.en: In Butterworth, at the ferry terminal, Madam Ong closes her stall and sets out one glass of teh.

1hydhovrn0f.speaker: Narrator
1hydhovrn0f.text: In Butterworth, at the ferry terminal, Madam Ong closes her stall and sets out two glasses of teh, as she has every night since 2021.
1hydhovrn0f.en: In Butterworth, at the ferry terminal, Madam Ong closes her stall and sets out two glasses of teh, as she has every night since 2021.

1iiiad0ski0.speaker: Narrator
1iiiad0ski0.text: Restoran Bala's shutter is down, and the street is red with lanterns for the morning. Behind the shutter the wall phone rings, and keeps ringing, until you come down the stairs in the dark and lift it.
1iiiad0ski0.en: Restoran Bala's shutter is down, and the street is red with lanterns for the morning. Behind the shutter the wall phone rings, and keeps ringing, until you come down the stairs in the dark and lift it.

dir.say: [low, hushed, night] Restoran Bala's shutter is down, and the street is red with lanterns for the morning. [break] Behind the shutter the wall phone rings, [break] and keeps ringing, [break] [whispering] until you come down the stairs in the dark and lift it.

0xbz1bjv8tf.speaker: The Chairman
0xbz1bjv8tf.text: You found my first night, detective. Thank you.
0xbz1bjv8tf.en: You found my first night, detective. Thank you.

dir.say: [close, calm, warm and courteous, utterly cold underneath] You found my first night, detective. [long-break] [softly] Thank you.

1n6ndl8lw8j.speaker: Narrator
1n6ndl8lw8j.text: A lid snaps open on the line, and shut.
1n6ndl8lw8j.en: A lid snaps open on the line, and shut.

0u7dgfyljy0.speaker: The Chairman
0u7dgfyljy0.text: On the fifteenth night of the new year, come to the gate. Bring the plate.
0u7dgfyljy0.en: On the fifteenth night of the new year, come to the gate. Bring the plate.

dir.say: [quiet, precise, an invitation that is an order] On the fifteenth night of the new year, [break] come to the gate. [long-break] [softly] Bring the plate.

23ftil3khad.speaker: Narrator
23ftil3khad.text: The line goes dead. Across the street a firecracker goes off early, and somebody's grandmother shouts at it.
23ftil3khad.en: The line goes dead. Across the street a firecracker goes off early, and somebody's grandmother shouts at it.

dir.say: [flat, quiet] The line goes dead. [long-break] [dry, faintly wry] Across the street a firecracker goes off early, and somebody's grandmother shouts at it.

27d57bvuxpd.speaker: Narrator
27d57bvuxpd.text: At four o'clock the coroner reads her finding into a file that was closed in eleven minutes, and she takes eleven minutes over it, on purpose.
27d57bvuxpd.en: At four o'clock the coroner reads her finding into a file that was closed in eleven minutes, and she takes eleven minutes over it, on purpose.

251wbvbws26.speaker: Narrator
251wbvbws26.text: Unlawful killing by the driver of BCK 210, a man whose name was torn out of the file in 1987, in the presence of Muthusamy a/l Perumal, deceased.
251wbvbws26.en: Unlawful killing by the driver of BCK 210, a man whose name was torn out of the file in 1987, in the presence of Muthusamy a/l Perumal, deceased.

dir.say: [slow, formal, solemn, every word weighed] Unlawful killing by the driver of BCK two one zero, [break] a man whose name was torn out of the file in 1987, [break] in the presence of Muthusamy a/l Perumal, [break] deceased.

0y4b8s0kpvm.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
0y4b8s0kpvm.text: Eleven minutes. She timed it. Forty years late, and exactly on time.
0y4b8s0kpvm.en: Eleven minutes. She timed it. Forty years late, and exactly on time.

dir.say: [quiet, dry, moved and hiding it] Eleven minutes. [break] She timed it. [long-break] Forty years late, and exactly on time.

0l7jajfjhlo.speaker: Narrator
0l7jajfjhlo.text: Tarmizi Hassan does not come back to court. From his hospital bed he sends word that he remembers nothing after Tuesday.
0l7jajfjhlo.en: Tarmizi Hassan does not come back to court. From his hospital bed he sends word that he remembers nothing after Tuesday.

1tvqfau5ymk.speaker: Narrator
1tvqfau5ymk.text: Siew Yang drives down to Jugra in the last of the light with her tin of brushes and a ladder on the roof of her car.
1tvqfau5ymk.en: Siew Yang drives down to Jugra in the last of the light with her tin of brushes and a ladder on the roof of her car.

28gnktlur8y.speaker: Narrator
28gnktlur8y.text: Under the pink sun, in small black letters, careful as a sign for a shop that will be open a long time, she paints: TEOH AH CHUAN 1934–1986.
28gnktlur8y.en: Under the pink sun, in small black letters, careful as a sign for a shop that will be open a long time, she paints: TEOH AH CHUAN 1934–1986.

dir.say: [soft, slow, reverent] Under the pink sun, in small black letters, careful as a sign for a shop that will be open a long time, [break] she paints: [long-break] TEOH AH CHUAN, nineteen thirty-four to nineteen eighty-six.

0lvyyvecnb1.speaker: Narrator
0lvyyvecnb1.text: Pak Itam holds the ladder, and looks at the ground.
0lvyyvecnb1.en: Pak Itam holds the ladder, and looks at the ground.

29b7r37vxam.speaker: Narrator
29b7r37vxam.text: The coroner finds that Teoh Ah Kow let the handbrake off for his debts. On the steps Siew Yang tells the press that her uncle was at home in Banting when the engine started, and that she should know, because she was there and he was not.
29b7r37vxam.en: The coroner finds that Teoh Ah Kow let the handbrake off for his debts. On the steps Siew Yang tells the press that her uncle was at home in Banting when the engine started, and that she should know, because she was there and he was not.

1m0ub97n7zq.speaker: Narrator
1m0ub97n7zq.text: The coroner finds that Teoh Ah Chuan drove into the river himself. In the front row of the gallery Siew Yang stands up, and then sits down again.
1m0ub97n7zq.en: The coroner finds that Teoh Ah Chuan drove into the river himself. In the front row of the gallery Siew Yang stands up, and then sits down again.

06rcu5jd8xy.speaker: Narrator
06rcu5jd8xy.text: The coroner writes no new finding, and the old one stands.
06rcu5jd8xy.en: The coroner writes no new finding, and the old one stands.

0bzr8t8e84h.speaker: Narrator
0bzr8t8e84h.text: Teoh Siew Yang is charged. She puts her brushes on the dock rail and does not look at her uncle.
0bzr8t8e84h.en: Teoh Siew Yang is charged. She puts her brushes on the dock rail and does not look at her uncle.

0zwq6lgaln5.speaker: Narrator
0zwq6lgaln5.text: Siew Yang is on remand in Kajang, and her brushes are in a police evidence bag in Shah Alam.
0zwq6lgaln5.en: Siew Yang is on remand in Kajang, and her brushes are in a police evidence bag in Shah Alam.

0tkbva3bf1w.speaker: Narrator
0tkbva3bf1w.text: At dusk Pak Itam chains the gate, and stands for a while looking at the pink sun, and then at the ground.
0tkbva3bf1w.en: At dusk Pak Itam chains the gate, and stands for a while looking at the pink sun, and then at the ground.

02kl8lim3bz.speaker: Narrator
02kl8lim3bz.text: Shamir Kassim is charged. Sinar's statement says he acted alone, which nobody in the court believes, including the coroner.
02kl8lim3bz.en: Shamir Kassim is charged. Sinar's statement says he acted alone, which nobody in the court believes, including the coroner.

0xovjkxcsk8.speaker: Narrator
0xovjkxcsk8.text: Teoh Ah Kow is arrested in the gallery with his beads in his hand. He asks his niece to light a joss stick for her father on the eve of the new year. She does not answer.
0xovjkxcsk8.en: Teoh Ah Kow is arrested in the gallery with his beads in his hand. He asks his niece to light a joss stick for her father on the eve of the new year. She does not answer.

dir.say: [clipped, formal, then quiet and sad] Teoh Ah Kow is arrested in the gallery with his beads in his hand. [break] He asks his niece to light a joss stick for her father on the eve of the new year. [long-break] She does not answer.

1lebyd44ata.speaker: Narrator
1lebyd44ata.text: Tarmizi Hassan comes back in a wheelchair and says, in front of the court, what he was paid and who paid it. The coroner thanks him, and writes her finding anyway.
1lebyd44ata.en: Tarmizi Hassan comes back in a wheelchair and says, in front of the court, what he was paid and who paid it. The coroner thanks him, and writes her finding anyway.

2dnzoatt48p.speaker: Narrator
2dnzoatt48p.text: Before she rises, Tarmizi Hassan is wheeled in from the hospital with a drip on a pole and his wife at his elbow, and asks to add one thing to his evidence.
2dnzoatt48p.en: Before she rises, Tarmizi Hassan is wheeled in from the hospital with a drip on a pole and his wife at his elbow, and asks to add one thing to his evidence.

0gsmznybkzo.speaker: Tarmizi Hassan
0gsmznybkzo.text: Empat puluh tahun saya tulis. Hari ini saya cakap.
0gsmznybkzo.en: Forty years I wrote. Today I speak.

dir.say: [old man, weak but steady, from a wheelchair, quiet dignity] Empat puluh tahun saya tulis. [long-break] Hari ini saya cakap.

01m8qlxwabt.speaker: Narrator
01m8qlxwabt.text: Ridzuan Tarmizi is charged. His tow truck is taken off the road outside the court, by another tow truck.
01m8qlxwabt.en: Ridzuan Tarmizi is charged. His tow truck is taken off the road outside the court, by another tow truck.

25c0xrxuuod.speaker: Narrator
25c0xrxuuod.text: The fifteenth night of the new year. Somebody on Jalan Tun Sambanthan has hung oranges in a net over a shop door, and somebody in a back lane is letting off firecrackers one string at a time, as if they were rationed.
25c0xrxuuod.en: The fifteenth night of the new year. Somebody on Jalan Tun Sambanthan has hung oranges in a net over a shop door, and somebody in a back lane is letting off firecrackers one string at a time, as if they were rationed.

dir.say: [low, weary, intimate] The fifteenth night of the new year. [break] [dry, quietly amused] Somebody on Jalan Tun Sambanthan has hung oranges in a net over a shop door, and somebody in a back lane is letting off firecrackers one string at a time, [break] as if they were rationed.

0pa8pa337ws.speaker: Narrator
0pa8pa337ws.text: Bala Anne has his shutter half down. He has not pulled it the rest of the way, and he has not opened it either.
0pa8pa337ws.en: Bala Anne has his shutter half down. He has not pulled it the rest of the way, and he has not opened it either.

dir.say: [quiet, uneasy] Bala Anne has his shutter half down. [break] He has not pulled it the rest of the way, [break] and he has not opened it either.

0zvwrmbqtnm.speaker: Narrator
0zvwrmbqtnm.text: At the counter Farah rings her sergeant on her own telephone, which is charged tonight.
0zvwrmbqtnm.en: At the counter Farah rings her sergeant on her own telephone, which is charged tonight.

dir.say: [flat, low] At the counter Farah rings her sergeant on her own telephone, [break] [wry] which is charged tonight.

1s1gox97fep.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
1s1gox97fep.text: Watch V1. Tell me when it moves.
1s1gox97fep.en: Watch V1. Tell me when it moves.

14p8kj1c8jn.speaker: Narrator
14p8kj1c8jn.text: On the back seat of her car, wrapped in a Bomba blanket, the rusted plate BCK 210 with its small painted sun. He asked you to bring it.
14p8kj1c8jn.en: On the back seat of her car, wrapped in a Bomba blanket, the rusted plate BCK 210 with its small painted sun. He asked you to bring it.

dir.say: [low, measured] On the back seat of her car, wrapped in a Bomba blanket, the rusted plate B C K two one oh, with its small painted sun. [long-break] [quietly ominous] He asked you to bring it.

1ddl4xw0cy0.speaker: Narrator
1ddl4xw0cy0.text: Daniel sits on the step under the half shutter with every light in the shop on behind him. Since December he has slept with the light on.
1ddl4xw0cy0.en: Daniel sits on the step under the half shutter with every light in the shop on behind him. Since December he has slept with the light on.

dir.say: [soft, tender] Daniel sits on the step under the half shutter with every light in the shop on behind him. [break] [quiet, aching] Since December he has slept with the light on.

20gck9ndazj.speaker: Narrator
20gck9ndazj.text: Daniel sits on the step under the half shutter folding a kancil out of a red packet, and does not look up when the firecrackers go.
20gck9ndazj.en: Daniel sits on the step under the half shutter folding a kancil out of a red packet, and does not look up when the firecrackers go.

1awdyv16yto.speaker: Daniel Raj
1awdyv16yto.text: A man whose charge can come back any morning does not go to a fire, machan. I will mind the telephone.
1awdyv16yto.en: A man whose charge can come back any morning does not go to a fire, machan. I will mind the telephone.

dir.say: [wry, tired, gentle] A man whose charge can come back any morning does not go to a fire, machan. [break] [quiet] I will mind the telephone.

0udkvc7lbu8.speaker: Daniel Raj
0udkvc7lbu8.text: Somebody has to mind the telephone, machan. He likes to ring it.
0udkvc7lbu8.en: Somebody has to mind the telephone, machan. He likes to ring it.

dir.say: [dry, half a smile] Somebody has to mind the telephone, machan. [break] [darker] He likes to ring it.

05vw2jw1o6s.speaker: Narrator
05vw2jw1o6s.text: Farah's radio, on the counter between two glasses of teh, clicks once.
05vw2jw1o6s.en: Farah's radio, on the counter between two glasses of teh, clicks once.

0iro8kuov0h.speaker: Sjn. Asri
0iro8kuov0h.text: Kereta dah keluar dari V1. Satu penumpang. Saya ikut dengan motor.
0iro8kuov0h.en: The car has left V1. One passenger. I'm following on the bike.

dir.say: [over a police radio, calm, quiet, slightly breathless] Kereta dah keluar dari V1. [break] Satu penumpang. [break] Saya ikut dengan motor.

0ygtb4dnpq9.speaker: Narrator
0ygtb4dnpq9.text: Farah wants to reach the gate at ten past two and not a minute before. She has timed the road twice. At twenty to two you leave Brickfields in her car, with the plate on the back seat.
0ygtb4dnpq9.en: Farah wants to reach the gate at ten past two and not a minute before. She has timed the road twice. At twenty to two you leave Brickfields in her car, with the plate on the back seat.

dir.say: [measured, low] Farah wants to reach the gate at ten past two and not a minute before. [break] She has timed the road twice. [break] At twenty to two you leave Brickfields in her car, with the plate on the back seat.

1oy07ok1y7c.speaker: Narrator
1oy07ok1y7c.text: No tolls on the old road, and few cameras: oil palm on both sides, a lorry stop shuttered for the holiday, a temple with every lamp lit for the full moon.
1oy07ok1y7c.en: No tolls on the old road, and few cameras: oil palm on both sides, a lorry stop shuttered for the holiday, a temple with every lamp lit for the full moon.

dir.say: [low, hypnotic, night-drive calm] No tolls on the old road, and few cameras. [break] Oil palm on both sides, a lorry stop shuttered for the holiday, [break] a temple with every lamp lit for the full moon.

1nwyxzohshy.speaker: Sjn. Asri
1nwyxzohshy.text: Puan, saya hilang dia di Jenjarom.
1nwyxzohshy.en: Ma'am, I lost him at Jenjarom.

dir.say: [over a police radio, apologetic, low, steady] Puan, [break] saya hilang dia di Jenjarom.

02rhckulakn.speaker: Narrator
02rhckulakn.text: Farah asks him where he is. The radio gives her the hiss of an open channel, and then not even that. She puts her foot down.
02rhckulakn.en: Farah asks him where he is. The radio gives her the hiss of an open channel, and then not even that. She puts her foot down.

dir.say: [tense, low] Farah asks him where he is. [break] The radio gives her the hiss of an open channel, [break] and then not even that. [break] [sharp] She puts her foot down.

25hykigcg7c.speaker: Narrator
25hykigcg7c.text: You are late. The pink sun on the gate is lit from below, by a fire.
25hykigcg7c.en: You are late. The pink sun on the gate is lit from below, by a fire.

dir.say: [grim, low] You are late. [long-break] [awed, hushed] The pink sun on the gate is lit from below, [break] by a fire.

2bs0uzt92tm.speaker: Narrator
2bs0uzt92tm.text: Inside the gate, on the laterite where Sinar's first lorry stood, a long black car with no plates is burning from the front seats back.
2bs0uzt92tm.en: Inside the gate, on the laterite where Sinar's first lorry stood, a long black car with no plates is burning from the front seats back.

0j6ceh3w8d9.speaker: Narrator
0j6ceh3w8d9.text: Under the sun, in small black letters three weeks old, the firelight finds a name: TEOH AH CHUAN 1934–1986.
0j6ceh3w8d9.en: Under the sun, in small black letters three weeks old, the firelight finds a name: TEOH AH CHUAN 1934–1986.

dir.say: [quiet, solemn] Under the sun, in small black letters three weeks old, the firelight finds a name. [break] Teoh Ah Chuan. [break] Nineteen thirty-four to nineteen eighty-six.

1rxitz496xd.speaker: Narrator
1rxitz496xd.text: Pak Itam stands at the gate post with a bucket of water he has not used, and looks at the ground. Bomba's lights are coming down the road from Banting.
1rxitz496xd.en: Pak Itam stands at the gate post with a bucket of water he has not used, and looks at the ground. Bomba's lights are coming down the road from Banting.

dir.say: [low, weary] Pak Itam stands at the gate post with a bucket of water he has not used, [break] and looks at the ground. [break] Bomba's lights are coming down the road from Banting.
[urgent, into a radio, rising worry] Asri. [break] Asri, where are you?

1u9n996dy1e.speaker: Narrator
1u9n996dy1e.text: Rosli, in yesterday's uniform, opens the back door with a crowbar when the metal will let him.
1u9n996dy1e.en: Rosli, in yesterday's uniform, opens the back door with a crowbar when the metal will let him.

25u1bye0lpl.speaker: Narrator
25u1bye0lpl.text: Behind the driver's seat sits a man in a white shirt, upright against the door, his collar buttoned and a cravat at his throat. In his left fist, so tight that Rosli does not try to open it, a silver lighter.
25u1bye0lpl.en: Behind the driver's seat sits a man in a white shirt, upright against the door, his collar buttoned and a cravat at his throat. In his left fist, so tight that Rosli does not try to open it, a silver lighter.

dir.say: [hushed, careful] Behind the driver's seat sits a man in a white shirt, upright against the door, [break] his collar buttoned and a cravat at his throat. [long-break] [very quiet] In his left fist, so tight that Rosli does not try to open it, [break] a silver lighter.

1r52p4ujvt1.speaker: Fire Officer Rosli
1r52p4ujvt1.text: He was dead before the fire, Tuan. Look at his mouth. No soot.
1r52p4ujvt1.en: He was dead before the fire, Tuan. Look at his mouth. No soot.

dir.say: [low, certain, grave] He was dead before the fire, Tuan. [break] Look at his mouth. [break] No soot.

23s9t987w3q.speaker: Narrator
23s9t987w3q.text: Nobody at the gate says who he is. Everybody at the gate is thinking it.
23s9t987w3q.en: Nobody at the gate says who he is. Everybody at the gate is thinking it.

dir.say: [low, loaded] Nobody at the gate says who he is. [break] [almost a whisper] Everybody at the gate is thinking it.

0r0td5ytbfj.speaker: Narrator
0r0td5ytbfj.text: Before the dawn and before the crowbar: a motorbike coming fast from the Jenjarom road, and a police sergeant in a navy windbreaker with his helmet already off.
0r0td5ytbfj.en: Before the dawn and before the crowbar: a motorbike coming fast from the Jenjarom road, and a police sergeant in a navy windbreaker with his helmet already off.

dir.say: [flat, quiet, a flashback] Before the dawn and before the crowbar. [break] A motorbike coming fast from the Jenjarom road, [break] and a police sergeant in a navy windbreaker with his helmet already off.
[out of breath, ashamed, soft] Puan. [break] Maaf. [break] Saya hilang dia.

1qi4uhh0bjv.speaker: Narrator
1qi4uhh0bjv.text: Farah puts her hand on his shoulder, the way she would for anybody who had ridden through the night for her.
1qi4uhh0bjv.en: Farah puts her hand on his shoulder, the way she would for anybody who had ridden through the night for her.

dir.say: [gentle, with a hidden ache] Farah puts her hand on his shoulder, [break] the way she would for anybody who had ridden through the night for her.

1kuwc3ovpwv.speaker: Narrator
1kuwc3ovpwv.text: Deputy Public Prosecutor Hamidah Yusof, hair still wet, a flask of teh, at the door of the forensic department.
1kuwc3ovpwv.en: Deputy Public Prosecutor Hamidah Yusof, hair still wet, a flask of teh, at the door of the forensic department.

1ywyzvxkc71.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
1ywyzvxkc71.text: Sinar's lawyers have asked for a death certificate by noon. Bursa has asked for a name. I have asked for neither.
1ywyzvxkc71.en: Sinar's lawyers have asked for a death certificate by noon. Bursa has asked for a name. I have asked for neither.

dir.say: [crisp, dry, unimpressed] Sinar's lawyers have asked for a death certificate by noon. [break] Bursa has asked for a name. [break] [cool, firm] I have asked for neither.

1cn50cxfjlf.speaker: Narrator
1cn50cxfjlf.text: Two newspapers already have the headline set. They are waiting for somebody to tell them which word goes in it.
1cn50cxfjlf.en: Two newspapers already have the headline set. They are waiting for somebody to tell them which word goes in it.

dir.say: [wry, bitter, low] Two newspapers already have the headline set. [break] They are waiting for somebody to tell them which word goes in it.

1joi36kyrf8.speaker: Narrator
1joi36kyrf8.text: At half past four Sjn. Asri drives Farah home, as he has every night for four years, and carries her bag up the stairs.
1joi36kyrf8.en: At half past four Sjn. Asri drives Farah home, as he has every night for four years, and carries her bag up the stairs.

dir.say: [quiet, uneasy, almost tender] At half past four Sergeant Asri drives Farah home, [break] as he has every night for four years, [break] and carries her bag up the stairs.

0jhwsgx2uc6.speaker: Narrator
0jhwsgx2uc6.text: Hamidah Yusof writes it slowly, in capitals: the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad. She initials it, and does not look up.
0jhwsgx2uc6.en: Hamidah Yusof writes it slowly, in capitals: the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad. She initials it, and does not look up.

dir.say: [slow, heavy] Hamidah Yusof writes it slowly, in capitals. [break] The Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad. [break] She initials it, and does not look up.

2a5cw09z3vs.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
2a5cw09z3vs.text: It is on the form now, detective. By Friday it will be on a grave.
2a5cw09z3vs.en: It is on the form now, detective. By Friday it will be on a grave.

dir.say: [cold, quiet] It is on the form now, detective. [break] By Friday it will be on a grave.

00nd0ega4mj.speaker: Narrator
00nd0ega4mj.text: Exhibit P7 from the coroner's court, the cancelled note from Melaka, goes under Dr. Lim's glass beside the deed. The borrower's left thumb shows the same nine points as the man on her table. Still nine.
00nd0ega4mj.en: Exhibit P7 from the coroner's court, the cancelled note from Melaka, goes under Dr. Lim's glass beside the deed. The borrower's left thumb shows the same nine points as the man on her table. Still nine.

dir.say: [measured, clinical, low] Exhibit P7 from the coroner's court, the cancelled note from Melaka, goes under Doctor Lim's glass beside the deed. [break] The borrower's left thumb shows the same nine points as the man on her table. [long-break] [quiet] Still nine.

1qakg4gu1b0.speaker: Narrator
1qakg4gu1b0.text: Sinar Holdings Berhad announces to Bursa Malaysia, with deep regret, the death of its Chairman. The share price rises eleven sen before lunch.
1qakg4gu1b0.en: Sinar Holdings Berhad announces to Bursa Malaysia, with deep regret, the death of its Chairman. The share price rises eleven sen before lunch.

dir.say: [cool, corporate irony] Sinar Holdings Berhad announces to Bursa Malaysia, with deep regret, the death of its Chairman. [break] [bitter] The share price rises eleven sen before lunch.

036z2mw2yn4.speaker: Narrator
036z2mw2yn4.text: By three o'clock Seah & Seah of Singapore, Clarissa Seah writing, have told the High Court that under the deed of 1987 as amended, the Jugra Trust is to be directed by whoever drove him last.
036z2mw2yn4.en: By three o'clock Seah & Seah of Singapore, Clarissa Seah writing, have told the High Court that under the deed of 1987 as amended, the Jugra Trust is to be directed by whoever drove him last.

dir.say: [dry, precise] By three o'clock Seah and Seah of Singapore, Clarissa Seah writing, have told the High Court [break] that under the deed of nineteen eighty-seven as amended, [break] the Jugra Trust is to be directed by [emphasis] whoever drove him last.

0modg90ksoy.speaker: Narrator
0modg90ksoy.text: By three o'clock Sinar's lawyers have told the High Court that under the deed of 1987 as amended, the Jugra Trust is to be directed by whoever drove him last.
0modg90ksoy.en: By three o'clock Sinar's lawyers have told the High Court that under the deed of 1987 as amended, the Jugra Trust is to be directed by whoever drove him last.

dir.say: [dry, precise] By three o'clock Sinar's lawyers have told the High Court [break] that under the deed of nineteen eighty-seven as amended, [break] the Jugra Trust is to be directed by [emphasis] whoever drove him last.

1e6nu80umjo.speaker: Narrator
1e6nu80umjo.text: "On the evidence," the letter says, "whoever drove the car to the gate. Or, the court may find, on the first of December, the detective."
1e6nu80umjo.en: "On the evidence," the letter says, "whoever drove the car to the gate. Or, the court may find, on the first of December, the detective."

dir.say: [cold, reading a letter] On the evidence, the letter says, whoever drove the car to the gate. [long-break] [quiet, ominous] Or, the court may find, on the first of December, [break] the detective.

0v3sgcir47r.speaker: Narrator
0v3sgcir47r.text: Hamidah's charge against the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986 abates with the death she has just certified. She tears nothing up. She files it.
0v3sgcir47r.en: Hamidah's charge against the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986 abates with the death she has just certified. She tears nothing up. She files it.

dir.say: [low, dry] Hamidah's charge against the user of prepaid line oh one one, two six oh four, one nine eight six, abates with the death she has just certified. [break] She tears nothing up. [break] [quiet, stubborn] She files it.

1e47t8f4p2y.speaker: Narrator
1e47t8f4p2y.text: Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence because every newspaper had printed it: Arthur Seah recited the letter of wishes into an affidavit from a hospital bed, every word.
1e47t8f4p2y.en: Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence because every newspaper had printed it: Arthur Seah recited the letter of wishes into an affidavit from a hospital bed, every word.

dir.say: [measured, low] Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence because every newspaper had printed it. [break] Arthur Seah recited the letter of wishes into an affidavit from a hospital bed, [break] every word.

1konuy7ttui.speaker: Narrator
1konuy7ttui.text: Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence from the board: a copy of the letter of wishes, made at Seah & Seah before the original burned, had reached every director by January.
1konuy7ttui.en: Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence from the board: a copy of the letter of wishes, made at Seah & Seah before the original burned, had reached every director by January.

dir.say: [measured, low] Tan Sri Azhar knew the sentence from the board. [break] A copy of the letter of wishes, made at Seah and Seah before the original burned, [break] had reached every director by January.

1aanjd31s1s.speaker: Narrator
1aanjd31s1s.text: The man from the back seat is buried in plot 2741, at the far end of the public cemetery under a rain tree, in a row of numbered boards. Nobody claims him. Everybody comes.
1aanjd31s1s.en: The man from the back seat is buried in plot 2741, at the far end of the public cemetery under a rain tree, in a row of numbered boards. Nobody claims him. Everybody comes.

dir.say: [soft, elegiac] The man from the back seat is buried in plot twenty-seven forty-one, at the far end of the public cemetery under a rain tree, [break] in a row of numbered boards. [long-break] Nobody claims him. [break] [quiet wonder] Everybody comes.

1h8akyfpiyy.speaker: Narrator
1h8akyfpiyy.text: Bala Anne brings a garland of jasmine and marigold from the shop on Jalan Thambapillay, and lays it down without a word.
1h8akyfpiyy.en: Bala Anne brings a garland of jasmine and marigold from the shop on Jalan Thambapillay, and lays it down without a word.

1fbajxd8wqx.speaker: Narrator
1fbajxd8wqx.text: Pak Itam stands at the cemetery gate with his keys on their string, as if somebody had told him to keep it.
1fbajxd8wqx.en: Pak Itam stands at the cemetery gate with his keys on their string, as if somebody had told him to keep it.

dir.say: [quiet, wistful] Pak Itam stands at the cemetery gate with his keys on their string, [break] as if somebody had told him to keep it.

0g50cuilmrv.speaker: Narrator
0g50cuilmrv.text: Teoh Siew Yang paints the plot's number on its board herself, in black, with her smallest brush.
0g50cuilmrv.en: Teoh Siew Yang paints the plot's number on its board herself, in black, with her smallest brush.

1h12j5eppvj.speaker: Narrator
1h12j5eppvj.text: Two rows away, a headstone that says Ong Wei Jie.
1h12j5eppvj.en: Two rows away, a headstone that says Ong Wei Jie.

dir.say: [very quiet] Two rows away, [break] a headstone that says Ong Wei Jie.

27q3jshrlm0.speaker: Narrator
27q3jshrlm0.text: Daniel does not fold anything. He stands with his hands in his pockets until the diggers have gone.
27q3jshrlm0.en: Daniel does not fold anything. He stands with his hands in his pockets until the diggers have gone.

dir.say: [quiet, heavy] Daniel does not fold anything. [break] He stands with his hands in his pockets until the diggers have gone.

1to4lyh4pu5.speaker: Narrator
1to4lyh4pu5.text: Nurul Ain photographs the board with the number on it, and nothing else.
1to4lyh4pu5.en: Nurul Ain photographs the board with the number on it, and nothing else.

2gl7yhsh08a.speaker: Narrator
2gl7yhsh08a.text: At the cemetery gate a black Land Cruiser with a new bull bar idles three lengths behind nobody.
2gl7yhsh08a.en: At the cemetery gate a black Land Cruiser with a new bull bar idles three lengths behind nobody.

dir.say: [low, uneasy] At the cemetery gate a black Land Cruiser with a new bull bar idles [break] three lengths behind nobody.

1pw4srdxpy5.speaker: Narrator
1pw4srdxpy5.text: At Bukit Aman, Superintendent Khairul gives the press a statement about "the end of a long chapter".
1pw4srdxpy5.en: At Bukit Aman, Superintendent Khairul gives the press a statement about "the end of a long chapter".

dir.say: [dry contempt] At Bukit Aman, Superintendent Khairul gives the press a statement about [emphasis] the end of a long chapter.

0ojqcp8uzmq.speaker: Narrator
0ojqcp8uzmq.text: From his gate in Bangsar, Khairul, still suspended, gives the press a statement about "the end of a long chapter".
0ojqcp8uzmq.en: From his gate in Bangsar, Khairul, still suspended, gives the press a statement about "the end of a long chapter".

dir.say: [dry contempt] From his gate in Bangsar, Khairul, still suspended, gives the press a statement about [emphasis] the end of a long chapter.

1f5yyalhmyh.speaker: Narrator
1f5yyalhmyh.text: Farah and you sit on the steps of Restoran Bala with a glass of teh each, going cold.
1f5yyalhmyh.en: Farah and you sit on the steps of Restoran Bala with a glass of teh each, going cold.

06v9z2jip4c.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
06v9z2jip4c.text: Asri has asked for leave. Two weeks, Kota Bharu. I signed it.
06v9z2jip4c.en: Asri has asked for leave. Two weeks, Kota Bharu. I signed it.

dir.say: [tired, matter-of-fact, fond] Asri has asked for leave. [break] Two weeks, Kota Bharu. [break] I signed it.

2055htgrtmv.speaker: Narrator
2055htgrtmv.text: At a quarter past one Bala Anne pulls the shutter down behind you and goes up to bed. A few minutes later Farah drives home.
2055htgrtmv.en: At a quarter past one Bala Anne pulls the shutter down behind you and goes up to bed. A few minutes later Farah drives home.

dir.say: [low, still, the street emptying] At a quarter past one Bala Anne pulls the shutter down behind you and goes up to bed. [break] A few minutes later Farah drives home.

1ignli09knt.speaker: Narrator
1ignli09knt.text: At ten past two a black car with no plates stops outside Restoran Bala, the second of its kind. The engine is running.
1ignli09knt.en: At ten past two a black car with no plates stops outside Restoran Bala, the second of its kind. The engine is running.

dir.say: [hushed, dread building] At ten past two a black car with no plates stops outside Restoran Bala, [break] the second of its kind. [long-break] The engine is running.

0fbasklchc8.speaker: Narrator
0fbasklchc8.text: This time the back door is open. From the driver's seat, the voice.
0fbasklchc8.en: This time the back door is open. From the driver's seat, the voice.

dir.say: [almost a whisper] This time the back door is open. [long-break] From the driver's seat, [break] the voice.

203thuiwq2h.speaker: The Chairman
203thuiwq2h.text: Good evening, detective. Not the front. Tonight I drive.
203thuiwq2h.en: Good evening, detective. Not the front. Tonight I drive.

dir.say: [calm, close, intimate, like a man ordering tea] Good evening, detective. [break] Not the front. [long-break] [quietly pleased] Tonight I drive.

0xwjn4iayiz.speaker: The Chairman
0xwjn4iayiz.text: You signed. Thank you. Now nobody is looking for me except you.
0xwjn4iayiz.en: You signed. Thank you. Now nobody is looking for me except you.

dir.say: [calm, faintly amused] You signed. [break] Thank you. [long-break] [soft, intimate] Now nobody is looking for me except you.

2g5hjy8oty8.speaker: Narrator
2g5hjy8oty8.text: You get into the back. The car moves.
2g5hjy8oty8.en: You get into the back. The car moves.

dir.say: [low, slow, resigned] You get into the back. [long-break] The car moves.

1ov0ioex8oq.speaker: Narrator
1ov0ioex8oq.text: A hand in a white cuff reaches up and tilts the rear-view mirror until it holds your eyes, and his. The reading light comes on.
1ov0ioex8oq.en: A hand in a white cuff reaches up and tilts the rear-view mirror until it holds your eyes, and his. The reading light comes on.

dir.say: [hushed, slow, suspended] A hand in a white cuff reaches up and tilts the rear-view mirror [break] until it holds your eyes, [break] and his. [long-break] The reading light comes on.

23m6dokwgw5.speaker: The Chairman
23m6dokwgw5.text: You may look in the mirror as often as you like, detective.
23m6dokwgw5.en: You may look in the mirror as often as you like, detective.

dir.say: [soft, close, an old promise kept] You may look in the mirror [break] as often as you like, detective.
[barely a breath, final] You look.

2cqzbn4jj3e.speaker: Narrator
2cqzbn4jj3e.text: Hamidah Yusof writes "brother of the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad", crosses it out, and writes it again, because you asked her to.
2cqzbn4jj3e.en: Hamidah Yusof writes "brother of the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad", crosses it out, and writes it again, because you asked her to.

dir.say: [uneasy, low] Hamidah Yusof writes, brother of the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad, [break] crosses it out, [break] and writes it again, because you asked her to.

20s5626v31o.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
20s5626v31o.text: I will regret this, detective. Not today. But I will.
20s5626v31o.en: I will regret this, detective. Not today. But I will.

dir.say: [tired, reluctant] I will regret this, detective. [break] Not today. [break] [quiet certainty] But I will.

0denm93hk7z.speaker: Narrator
0denm93hk7z.text: Sinar Holdings tells Bursa Malaysia that its Chairman is well and will not be taking questions. The share price closes where it opened.
0denm93hk7z.en: Sinar Holdings tells Bursa Malaysia that its Chairman is well and will not be taking questions. The share price closes where it opened.

dir.say: [dry, weary irony] Sinar Holdings tells Bursa Malaysia that its Chairman is well and will not be taking questions. [break] The share price closes where it opened.

021bvp2110f.speaker: Narrator
021bvp2110f.text: Hamidah's charge sheet against a person unknown, the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986, stays open on her desk.
021bvp2110f.en: Hamidah's charge sheet against a person unknown, the user of prepaid line 011-2604 1986, stays open on her desk.

dir.say: [low, steady] Hamidah's charge sheet against a person unknown, the user of prepaid line oh one one, two six oh four, one nine eight six, [break] stays open on her desk.
