1aliig8v6mq.speaker: Narrator
1aliig8v6mq.text: On Hamidah's charge sheet the line under "and abetment by" stays blank.
1aliig8v6mq.en: On Hamidah's charge sheet the line under "and abetment by" stays blank.

dir.say: [flat, resigned] On Hamidah's charge sheet the line under [emphasis] and abetment by [break] stays blank.

1fyjaqc105z.speaker: The Chairman
1fyjaqc105z.text: You were nearer than the others. Not near enough.
1fyjaqc105z.en: You were nearer than the others. Not near enough.

dir.say: [calm, gently disappointed] You were nearer than the others. [break] Not near enough.

1legvnssnzc.speaker: Narrator
1legvnssnzc.text: Hamidah Yusof writes "a person employed to stand in for the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad", crosses it out, and writes it again, because you asked her to.
1legvnssnzc.en: Hamidah Yusof writes "a person employed to stand in for the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad", crosses it out, and writes it again, because you asked her to.

dir.say: [uneasy, low] Hamidah Yusof writes, a person employed to stand in for the Chairman of Sinar Holdings Berhad, [break] crosses it out, [break] and writes it again, because you asked her to.

0z4zv5telpu.speaker: Narrator
0z4zv5telpu.text: Hamidah Yusof uncaps a pen she does use, and writes in the box for a name, in capitals, saying it aloud as she writes.
0z4zv5telpu.en: Hamidah Yusof uncaps a pen she does use, and writes in the box for a name, in capitals, saying it aloud as she writes.

dir.say: [quiet, deliberate] Hamidah Yusof uncaps a pen she does use, [break] and writes in the box for a name, in capitals, [break] saying it aloud as she writes.

0ny4ms96t7q.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
0ny4ms96t7q.text: Tidak dikenali. Lelaki, lebih kurang tujuh puluh lima tahun.

dir.say: [slow, steady, reading aloud as she writes] Tidak dikenali. [break] Lelaki, [break] lebih kurang tujuh puluh lima tahun.

159lwdwg4ua.speaker: Hamidah Yusof
159lwdwg4ua.text: Henry Goh wrote "match" once. Not on my desk.
159lwdwg4ua.en: Henry Goh wrote "match" once. Not on my desk.

dir.say: [quiet, steel underneath] Henry Goh wrote [emphasis] match once. [break] [firm, final] Not on my desk.

0i024y8kjgj.speaker: Narrator
0i024y8kjgj.text: Daniel folds a kancil from a copy of the burial permit and leaves it on the turned earth.
0i024y8kjgj.en: Daniel folds a kancil from a copy of the burial permit and leaves it on the turned earth.

dir.say: [soft, warm, aching] Daniel folds a kancil from a copy of the burial permit, [break] and leaves it on the turned earth.

23akz2ry8mn.speaker: The Chairman
23akz2ry8mn.text: You would not sign. Henry Goh would have. That is why I chose you.
23akz2ry8mn.en: You would not sign. Henry Goh would have. That is why I chose you.

dir.say: [calm, approving, quiet] You would not sign. [break] Henry Goh would have. [break] [warm, almost fond] That is why I chose you.

1cut06ti73w.speaker: Narrator
1cut06ti73w.text: Hamidah Yusof leaves the box empty, and the permit goes back into its plastic sleeve.
1cut06ti73w.en: Hamidah Yusof leaves the box empty, and the permit goes back into its plastic sleeve.

04gc243rr2p.speaker: Narrator
04gc243rr2p.text: Pak Itam is charged. The gate at Jugra is chained by the police, and for the first time since 1985 nobody keeps it.
04gc243rr2p.en: Pak Itam is charged. The gate at Jugra is chained by the police, and for the first time since 1985 nobody keeps it.

dir.say: [heavy, regretful] Pak Itam is charged. [break] The gate at Jugra is chained by the police, [break] and for the first time since nineteen eighty-five, nobody keeps it.

0sxzuduxevt.speaker: Narrator
0sxzuduxevt.text: Nurul Ain is charged. She gives her camera to Farah and asks her to keep the card safe.
0sxzuduxevt.en: Nurul Ain is charged. She gives her camera to Farah and asks her to keep the card safe.

dir.say: [low, regretful] Nurul Ain is charged. [break] She gives her camera to Farah and asks her to keep the card safe.

0alnv753bok.speaker: Narrator
0alnv753bok.text: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights for the second time in three months, and asks for the same lawyer.
0alnv753bok.en: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights for the second time in three months, and asks for the same lawyer.

dir.say: [dry, weary irony] Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights for the second time in three months, [break] and asks for the same lawyer.

1zpu9y2g689.speaker: Narrator
1zpu9y2g689.text: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights in front of two photographers who were told where to stand, and asks for his lawyer by his first name.
1zpu9y2g689.en: Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights in front of two photographers who were told where to stand, and asks for his lawyer by his first name.

dir.say: [dry, cool] Tan Sri Azhar Kamaruddin is arrested at his house in Damansara Heights, [break] in front of two photographers who were told where to stand, [break] and asks for his lawyer by his first name.

28apfo9yu1f.speaker: Narrator
28apfo9yu1f.text: Sjn. Mohd. Asri bin Ghazali is arrested by Farah herself, in the D9 office, in front of the board where he pinned your photographs. She takes his handset off his belt and lays it on the desk. Neither of them says anything.
28apfo9yu1f.en: Sjn. Mohd. Asri bin Ghazali is arrested by Farah herself, in the D9 office, in front of the board where he pinned your photographs. She takes his handset off his belt and lays it on the desk. Neither of them says anything.

dir.say: [grave, low, slow] Sergeant Mohd. Asri bin Ghazali is arrested by Farah herself, in the D9 office, [break] in front of the board where he pinned your photographs. [break] She takes his handset off his belt and lays it on the desk. [long-break] [very quiet] Neither of them says anything.

0q4y4ic91aj.speaker: Narrator
0q4y4ic91aj.text: "On the evidence," the letter says, "Sergeant Asri. Or, the court may find, on the first of December, the detective."
0q4y4ic91aj.en: "On the evidence," the letter says, "Sergeant Asri. Or, the court may find, on the first of December, the detective."

dir.say: [cold, reading a letter] On the evidence, the letter says, Sergeant Asri. [long-break] [quiet, ominous] Or, the court may find, on the first of December, [break] the detective.

153asjmijn1.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
153asjmijn1.text: Four years he sat in my car.
153asjmijn1.en: Four years he sat in my car.

dir.say: [quiet, hollow, holding it together] Four years [break] he sat in my car.

06sch0j97xa.speaker: Narrator
06sch0j97xa.text: She counts it off without looking at her fingers. The last voice she heard before the divider. Her car named at 5:52, before anybody had found her purse. A question about what time an old man in Singapore would see you. A tray carried through a door.
06sch0j97xa.en: She counts it off without looking at her fingers. The last voice she heard before the divider. Her car named at 5:52, before anybody had found her purse. A question about what time an old man in Singapore would see you. A tray carried through a door.

dir.say: [low, slow, each item a weight] She counts it off without looking at her fingers. [break] The last voice she heard before the divider. [break] Her car named at five fifty-two, before anybody had found her purse. [break] A question about what time an old man in Singapore would see you. [break] A tray carried through a door.

0ogz8r5r1vq.speaker: Inspector Farah Iskandar
0ogz8r5r1vq.text: I called all of it loyalty.
0ogz8r5r1vq.en: I called all of it loyalty.

dir.say: [bitter, very quiet, almost breaking] I called all of it [emphasis] loyalty.
